31700-IXB.s: This is the Dutch 2009 budget bill for the Ministry of Finance (IXB), fixing departmental expenditure and receipts plus the budget statements for the Domeinen Roerende Zaken and Domeinen Onroerende Zaken operational services. The explanatory memorandum describes policy goals and budget figures across tax, financial markets, international finance and state assets, without granting new delegated rule-making powers.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2009 accompanying this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2009 wordt vastgesteld.

31779.s: The bill amends the Explosives for Civil Use Act to implement EU Directive 2008/43/EC by requiring unique identification marking on explosives, components, smallest packaging units and ignition devices, and by expanding record-keeping duties for industry operators. It sets a ten-year retention period for transaction records and lets the minister, in ministerial regulation, set details on marking, product location codes, exemptions and the handling and testing of registration systems.
31779.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as a means to regulate technical details of the EU-mandated identification and traceability system.
q: The bill contains a basis to set further rules by ministerial regulation on, among other things, how the unique identification must be applied or affixed.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat een grondslag om bij ministeriële regeling nadere regels te stellen over, onder meer, de wijze waarop de unieke identificatie moet worden aangebracht of bevestigd.
d: manner of applying or affixing unique identification
product location codes and exemptions from marking duty
maintenance, protection and testing of registration system
p: The minister may by regulation set product location code rules and allow deviations from the marking obligation as long as explosives remain traceable.

parties: Asks why the storage and protection of collected data and testing of the registration system are left to ministerial regulation rather than the statute itself.
They wonder why this is not regulated in the law itself.
Zij vragen zich af waarom dat niet in de wet zelf wordt geregeld.
Questions whether the measure is proportionate and whether the identification system is effective or merely creates false security; raises fraud and enforcement doubts.
Because the proposed system remains as leaky as a basket and creates false security.
Want het voorgestelde systeem blijft het zo lek als een mandje en creëert een schijnveiligheid.
Asks for justification of the 10-year retention period and whether the optional barcode weakens the labelling and registration system's effectiveness and fraud resistance.
The VVD members would like a justification for the obligation on traders and holders of explosives to retain the registered data for 10 years.
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen graag een onderbouwing van de verplichting voor handelaren en houders van explosieven om de geregistreerde gegevens van explosieven 10 jaar te bewaren.

31792-X.s: The bill amends the 2008 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Defence by changing commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles, as set out in an attached supplementary budget table. It takes effect from 1 December 2008, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
31792-X.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by reallocations for personnel safety, reorganisation of financial oversight staff, career guidance, and higher Schiphol rental costs following new negotiations.

31869.s: The bill temporarily amends the Sickness Benefits Act so that employees born before 1 July 1954 who were unemployed for at least 52 weeks before a new job can receive sickness benefit from the employer's cost-sharing scheme in the first five years of employment after thirteen weeks of illness. It adds reporting duties for employers, a ten-year sunset clause, and conforming changes to related social security laws.
31869.j: The memorandum justifies the scheme by the need to encourage return to work of long-term unemployed older workers and by the proven effectiveness of the two-year wage continuation system, while stressing caution about deviating from it.
q: The aim of the bill is to introduce a temporary compensation scheme to help employers with the costs of wage continuation during sickness of formerly unemployed workers aged 55 and over.

Het doel van het wetsvoorstel is de invoering van een tijdelijke compensatieregeling om werkgevers tegemoet te komen in de kosten van loondoorbetaling bij ziekte van voorheen werklozen van 55 jaar en ouder.

parties: Supports the no-risk policy for older long-term unemployed and asks about short-term effects in the economic crisis and whether other groups should be covered.
The CDA members support the proposal to introduce a temporary compensation scheme to meet employers' costs of sick-pay for formerly unemployed workers aged 55 and over.

De leden van de CDA-fractie ondersteunen het voorstel om door invoering van een tijdelijke compensatieregeling de werkgevers tegemoet te komen in de kosten van loondoorbetaling bij ziekte van voorheen werklozen van 55 jaar en ouder.
Asks whether the bill is overtaken by the financial crisis, what indicators justify its temporary design, and what the government will do if older workers' position does not improve.
What can be done (both within and outside this law) if it turns out that the situation for job-seeking over-55s does not structurally improve in the coming ten years?
Wat kan er gedaan worden (zowel in als buiten deze wet) als blijkt dat de situatie voor werkzoekende 55-plussers niet structureel verbetert in de komende tien jaar?
Supports the aim but asks whether alternatives were considered and requests a complete overview of exceptions to the employer sick-pay obligation.
The SP members ask whether the government has considered alternatives and on what grounds it chose the present proposal.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of de regering alternatieven heeft overwogen en op welke gronden voor het voorliggend voorstel is gekozen.
Asks for a schematic overview of instruments by age group, whether employers were consulted, the expected wage-cost effects, and how and when parliament will be informed about implementation.
Can the government state on what occasions, at what frequency and with which indicators the House will be informed about the implementation of the bill?
Kan de regering aangeven bij welke gelegenheid, met welke periodiciteit en met welke indicatoren de Kamer geïnformeerd zal worden over de uitvoering van het wetsvoorstel?
Asks whether employers would hire older workers because of the scheme and what the government will do for unemployed workers aged 50 to 55.
Since the compensation scheme is for people aged 55 or over, what happens to employees between 50 and 55 who are dismissed?
Aangezien de compensatieregeling voor mensen van 55 jaar of ouder is, wat gebeurt er met medewerkers tussen de 50 en 55 jaar die ontslagen worden?

31896.s: The bill amends the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 to introduce an alcohol-lock programme (alcoholslotprogramma) for drivers whose licences are invalidated for drink-driving, with licence-coded restrictions and a supervised two-year programme, and to revise the licence-revocation (vorderingsprocedure) procedure. It also sets out the Dienst Wegverkeer's type-approval and erkenning (recognition) regimes for alcohol locks, a new alcohol-lock register, and related amendments to driving-instruction rules and the Wahv.
31896.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for technical detail on lock specifications, fees and procedures, and the minister commits to evaluating effectiveness within five years.
d: definitions of alcohol lock and programme
cases of non-cooperation and licence invalidation
alcohol-lock programme licence procedure and rules
installation, reading and cost rules for alcohol locks
type approval requirements and testing of alcohol locks
I.FF (art. 132f, derde lid; 132g, derde lid; 132h, vierde lid; 132k, vierde lid; 132l, vijfde lid)
recognition regime, conditions and supervision of installers
timing and costs of driving-ability examinations
procedural rules for CBR decisions and blood/breath limits
data recorded on driver licence register
organisation and management of alcohol-lock register
authorities' access to and entry of register data
regulations on processing register data by Dienst Wegverkeer
surrender of licences and related procedural rules
qualifications for instructor certificates for alcohol-lock training
p: The CBR may impose the alcohol-lock programme by decision and the Dienst Wegverkeer sets the recognition and supervision rules, with appeal under the Awb available for ordinary decisions.
The CBR may repeatedly extend the programme by six months at its discretion based on evaluation, without a fixed maximum duration.
Vehicle owners must keep vehicles available for inspection by an approved installer for up to 90 minutes, enforced by the supervising authority.
A new register records driver and vehicle data and allows wide sharing with authorities, subject to Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens rules.
Non-cooperation, including non-payment of lock costs, leads to licence invalidation under rules set by ministerial regulation.
Authorised officers may require the driver or a person about to drive to show the alcohol lock or perform a breath test on demand.

parties: Asks why the NVvP advice and medical examination of alcohol-dependent drivers are not addressed, and whether the 2.1 per mille medical-testing threshold is justified and whether sanctions apply to circumvention.
Can the government respond to the NVvP's advice?
Kan de regering een reactie geven op het advies van de NVvP?

Objects that the removal of compulsory medical examination for the 1.8 to 2.1 per mille group lets large numbers of alcohol-dependent drivers into traffic, and calls the 2.1 per mille threshold arbitrary.
The PvdA members consider the 2.1 per mille limit an arbitrary limit that is nowhere clearly justified in the bill.
De leden vinden de grens van 2,1‰ een arbitraire grens die nergens in het wetsvoorstel duidelijk wordt onderbouwd.
Asks why the medical test with the option of invalidating the licence for at least one year is not maintained, and whether a medical test at the end of the ASP is considered.
The ChristenUnie members therefore ask why the medical test is not maintained with the option of invalidating the driving licence for at least one year.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen daarom waarom de medische test niet wordt gehandhaafd met de optie van ongeldig-verklaring van het rijbewijs voor minimaal 1 jaar

Doubts effectiveness, notes the ASP can be circumvented, asks whether the regular sanction should be added, and raises CBR ICT problems and whether CBR should be brought under government control with an independent complaints commission.
The ASP can be circumvented, and to prevent offenders getting off lightly by circumventing the ASP, the regular sanction should also be imposed.
Het ASP zal te omzeilen zijn en om te voorkomen dat daders er licht vanaf komen door het ASP te omzeilen, zou de reguliere sanctie daarnaast ook opgelegd moeten worden.
Doubts the effectiveness of the ASP given fraud opportunities and whether detection risk is high enough, and asks about CBR's expanded tasks and unresolved specifications.
There are many opportunities for participants to commit fraud, and it is questionable whether the chance of detection is high enough to deter fraudsters.
Er zijn veel mogelijkheden voor deelnemers om te frauderen en het is de vraag of de pakkans hoog genoeg is om fraudeurs af te schrikken.
Criticises the lenient 2.1 per mille threshold for medical testing, notes the Raad van State's point that no treatment track exists, and argues for compulsory treatment and stronger consequences.
In this regard the GroenLinks members also attach great value to the Council of State's remarks, which the government's answer does not refute.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie hechten in dit verband ook veel waarde aan de opmerkingen van de Raad van State, die door het antwoord van de regering niet weersproken worden.

Welcomes the ASP as innovative but insists alcohol-dependent drivers be excluded until medically cured or subjected to mandatory treatment, and asks why the 1.8 to 2.1 per mille group is no longer medically examined.
The SGP members therefore urge that the ASP be aimed at mandatory treatment of serious alcohol problems.
De leden van de SGP-fractie dringen er derhalve op aan om het ASP gericht te laten zijn op verplichte behandeling van de ernstige alcoholproblemen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 to introduce an alcohol lock programme and extend the light educational measure to experienced drivers, raising concerns about effectiveness (no treatment track, 0.2 limit, fraud vulnerability, overlap with criminal sanctions, costs, data attribution and the six-month extension). The minister's nader rapport accepted several points, such as making the extension unlimited and clarifying the memorandum, while rejecting others such as a 0.0 limit and intensified enforcement.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the measure will have lasting effect on heavy drinkers without a treatment track and questions the 0.2 limit; the government keeps the programme without mandatory treatment and the 0.2 limit, citing the signal value and practicality.

The Afdeling finds the system fraud-prone given the low chance of detection and asks for more analysis of fraud effects; the government says data are secured and periodic retests help, but does not intensify police checks.

The Afdeling flags complex overlap between the programme, criminal disqualifications and the recidive regime, which hampers accessibility; the government raises the threshold to 1.3 permille and promises clarification in lower regulation.

The Afdeling notes the programme's high costs and privacy impact may lower participation; the government argues the costs are a fair consequence of the offence and that privacy intrusion is justified by road safety.
The Afdeling asks what happens if a retest is missed; the government explains that non-compliance is recorded and leads to follow-up consequences, and the memorandum is supplemented.

The Afdeling finds article 132c insufficiently safeguards accurate processing of personal data under the Wbp, since all lock data are attributed to the participant; the government says the Wbp requirements are met for now and will act when reliable technology exists.
The Afdeling considers the six-month extension too limited to show learning; the government replaces the one-time extension with an unlimited number of six-month extensions.
The Afdeling makes several redactional comments, most of which are adopted, while a few are declined with reasons.

31924-III.s: This is the 2008 supplementary budget adjustment (slotwet) bill, amending the 2008 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Royal Cabinet, the Committee for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services, and the Public and Communication agency. The explanatory memorandum attributes the changes mainly to underspending and shifts of material expenditure to 2009.
31924-III.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by underspending, such as unfilled personnel positions, and shifts of material expenditure to 2009.
q: The change is a result of a personnel establishment that was not fully filled throughout the year.
De mutatie is een gevolg van een nog niet volledig bezette personele formatie gedurende het gehele jaar.

31959.s: The bill adapts Dutch and former Netherlands Antilles legislation to the new constitutional status of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba as public bodies within the Netherlands, replacing island-level and Antillean terminology and rules with Dutch equivalents. It also extends several Dutch laws (intelligence services, emergency powers, public manifestations, pensions, civil service law) to the islands and creates new delegation and inter-island cooperation provisions.
31959.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the islands' transitional status, their small scale and distance from the European Netherlands, and the need for practical, locally tailored arrangements.
q: To be able to meet this responsibility, not only an adequate legal instrument must be provided, but also an organisation to carry out the activities.
Om deze verantwoordelijkheid waar te kunnen maken dient er niet alleen te worden voorzien in een adequaat (wettelijk) instrumentarium
d: emergency law application via Royal Decree lists
minister may mandate emergency powers to gezaghebber or Rijksvertegenwoordiger
holiday, leave and other worker rules via general administrative order
appointment and rules for judges and court procedures
civil service rules, security clearance and retirement details
pension fund organisation and implementing rules
p: Court may not review secrecy claims by the minister or Commission in administrative proceedings involving intelligence information, limiting judicial control over executive refusals to disclose.
Intelligence services gain communication interception powers on the islands and general administrative law is excluded for many intelligence decisions, reducing citizens' appeal rights.
Appeal against security clearance decisions goes to the island court rather than Dutch courts; general appeal procedures are retained but the forum shifts.
For up to two years the national ombudsman covers island authorities only upon joint request of the island councils, a temporary reduction in citizen complaint oversight.
Emergency powers from Dutch law are extended to the islands through royal decree and mandates to local or central officials, with constitutional limits on derogation retained.

parties: Asks why the government did not adopt the Council of State's advice on intergovernmental cooperation and why harmonisation of financial and other rules is so limited.
Asks for clarification of the Council of State's objections on ministerial responsibility for the Rijksvertegenwoordiger and the lack of an intermediate administrative layer.
In this context these members would like further explanation regarding the lack of ministerial responsibility for the Rijksvertegenwoordiger pointed out by the Council of State.
Deze leden zouden in dit kader graag een nadere uitleg krijgen ten aanzien van het door de Raad van State aangestipte ontbreken van ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid voor de Rijksvertegenwoordiger.
Questions whether legal protection, privacy, and procedural access for residents are adequately guaranteed, and criticises the tax and investment-zone arrangements.
These members would like an overview of all companies currently established in the special economic zones on Bonaire and Sint Eustatius.</br>
Graag ontvangen deze leden een overzicht van alle bedrijven die op dit moment gevestigd zijn in de speciale economische zones op Bonaire en Sint Eustatius.
Has mixed feelings, wants the outstanding bills and the Statuut amendment before giving a final verdict, and questions the abolition of the permit regime for assembly.
Furthermore they currently lack insight into proposals on amending the Statuut, as the grounds for deviating from legislation will apparently be formulated there.</br>
Verder missen zij thans inzicht in voorstellen inzake aanpassing van het Statuut, omdat daarin kennelijk de afwijkingsgronden voor wetgeving zullen worden geformuleerd.
Supports the constitutional renewal and asks for clear information on the benefits for residents in healthcare, education and social security.
These members support the progress of renewing the constitutional relations within the Kingdom.</br>
De leden steunen de voortgang van vernieuwing van de staatkundige verhoudingen binnen het Koninkrijk.
Asks for an overview of which labour and other inspectorates are competent on the islands and whether any were deliberately excluded.
These members would like an overview citing the relevant regulation of which national inspectorates can currently be active on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.</br>
Deze leden ontvangen graag een overzicht met vermelding van de desbetreffende regelgeving van welke rijksinspecties nu actief kunnen zijn op Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba.
Asks whether the government has failed to produce a coherent bill in time, citing the Raad van State's advice on tax legislation.
Does one not have to conclude from this advice that the government has not succeeded in presenting a good, coherent bill in time?
Uit dit advies is toch de conclusie te trekken dat de regering er onvoldoende in is geslaagd om tijdig met een goed, samenhangend wetsvoorstel te komen?
Asks why the BES population administration should be brought into the Dutch system and whether same-sex partnerships will be recognised on the islands.
Is this a step towards recognition and introduction of such marriages and partnerships on the BES islands?
Is dit een stap naar erkenning door en invoering van dergelijke huwelijke en partnerschappen op de BES-eilanden?
Questions the rationale for a separate tax system on the islands, the flat rate for integrated levies, and the missing income-effect figures.
These members cannot accept the flat rate for the integrated levy of taxes and premiums.
Deze leden kunnen zich niet vinden in het vlakke tarief voor de integrale heffing voor belastingen en premies.
Objects that the Raad van State's criticism is met by patching rather than by revising the Belastingwet BES, and asks for a comparative material overview and a justification for the tax changes.
This comes across to them as legislative patchwork.
Dit komt op hen over als wettelijk plak- en knipwerk.
Agrees with the tightened financial integrity and anti-money-laundering rules following FATF recommendations.
The VVD members agree with the proposals tightened in the area of financial market integrity.
De leden van de VVD-fractie stemmen in met de op het terrein van de integriteit van de financiële markten aangescherpte voorstellen

v.summary: The Council of State advised on the draft Adaptation Act for the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, supporting its aim but raising points on applicability of Dutch law, knowability of BES legislation and sector-specific issues such as emergency powers, fundamental rights of civil servants and assembly rights. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted most points, rejected some (e.g. the emergency-law sunset clause and assembly permit regime), and revised the bill accordingly.
concerns: Council advised explicitly declaring relevant Dutch laws (Comptabiliteitswet, financial supervision laws, inspectorates) applicable to the BES, which the government largely adopted.

Council questioned the emergency-powers regime and advised removing the six-year sunset in the IBES and specifying which bodies exercise emergency powers; government partly accepted and clarified the mechanism.
Council advised aligning restrictions on civil servants' freedoms of association and expression with the Ambtenarenwet, which the government adopted.
Council advised aligning the Wet recht van vergadering BES with the Wet openbare manifestaties; government kept the permit system given transitional circumstances.

Council objected to the Rijksvertegenwoordiger's democratic legitimacy as a self-standing body and advised other allocation of powers; government adjusted some competences but kept the arrangement for dispute settlement.
Council's redactional comments were largely incorporated, with a few exceptions.

31965-V.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in thousands of euros, to reflect changes linked to the Spring Memorandum. It sets the entry-into-force date as 1 June of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2009
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2009

31968.s: The bill amends numerous Dutch statutes to align them with the Wet veiligheidsregio's, replacing references to the Wet rampen en zware ongevallen and shifting certain crisis powers from mayors to the chair of the safety region when a disaster or crisis is of supra-local significance. It also makes substantive changes to the Wet publieke gezondheid, giving the safety-region chair powers over isolation, quarantine and occupational bans for group A infectious diseases.
31968.j: The memorandum justifies the shift of mayoral powers to the safety-region chair by the need for a single command structure in supra-local disasters and crises.
q: This ensures that the crisis powers assigned to the mayor in these laws and authority over public order remain in one hand.
Aldus wordt verzekerd dat de crisisbevoegdheden die in deze wetten aan de burgemeester zijn toebedeeld en het gezag inzake de openbare orde in een hand blijven.
d: existing decrees re-based on Wet veiligheidsregio's
p: Powers to isolate, quarantine, examine persons and ban occupational activity for group A infectious diseases shift from the mayor to the safety-region chair, with some measures requiring court authorisation for internal examinations.
The minister may direct the regional chair or mayor in outbreak control, and authorises measures under the health regulations.

parties: Asks for the timeline of revising emergency powers, the consequences of delay, and who is responsible for NIFV policy decisions.
They would like to be informed about the government's planned timetable for revising the state emergency law.
Zij willen graag geïnformeerd worden over de planning die de regering voor ogen heeft om het staatsnoodrecht te herzien.
Welcomes the bill as following from the adopted Wet veiligheidsregio's and has no further questions for now.
These members currently have no further questions.
Deze leden hebben vooralsnog geen nadere vragen.
Supports clear opschaling procedures and clarity on the minister's role, and questions the handling of port safety plans and ambulance licensing alternatives.
They also believe the procedures around escalation must be crystal clear and that article 42 of the Wet veiligheidsregio's provides for this.
Zij vinden ook dat de procedures rondom opschaling glashelder moeten zijn en dat artikel 42 van het wetsvoorstel Wet veiligheidsregio's hierin voorziet.
Asks why the concept of 'crisis' is left without formal and procedural definition, and how ambiguity at provincial borders is addressed.
The ChristenUnie members would like further explanation of the considerations for not giving the concept 'crisis' a formal and procedural definition.
Graag ontvangen de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie een nadere toelichting op de overwegingen om het begrip «crisis» geen formele en procedurele invulling te geven.
Asks whether the crisis definition should be tied to security, whether the mayor's exclusive power over emergency powers is sound, and what determines the timing of the emergency-law revision.
Does the government agree with the Council of State's finding that this chairman receives an exclusive power while not being separately named in the various emergency laws?

Klopt naar de mening van de regering de constatering van de Raad van State dat die voorzitter een exclusieve bevoegdheid krijgt, terwijl hij niet in de verschillende noodwetten afzonderlijk genoemd staat?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Aanpassingswet veiligheidsregio's, which adapts existing crisis legislation to the Wet veiligheidsregio's, urging a systematic screening of crisis laws, clearer rules on escalation to the regional safety chairman, and reduced administrative burden. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks, adds consultation rights and technical changes, and rejects several proposals such as transferring planning powers to the safety region and removing provincial powers under the Wet inzake de luchtverontreiniging.
concerns: The Raad urged a clearer, formal procedure for declaring a crisis and escalating public order powers to the safety region chair, which the government addresses only via existing article 42 of the Wet veiligheidsregio's rather than a new procedural regime.

The Raad advised that planning and approval powers for port security and water works emergency plans be assigned to the safety region board, which the government declined because these are sectoral responsibilities.
The Raad flagged administrative burden and four administrative layers in nuclear accident response, leading to removal of the commissioner's consultation duty but retention of the safety region role.

The Raad advised transferring air pollution emergency powers of the commissioner of the King to the safety region chair to ensure unified command, which the government rejected as outside the scope of public order powers.
The Raad's numerous editorial remarks on terminology, cross-references and transitional provisions were largely adopted in the revised bill.

The Raad criticised the complex and unclear licensing procedure for ambulance care, which the government defended as necessary given the division of responsibilities and expanded the explanatory memorandum.

31977.s: The bill amends the Wet op de jeugdzorg to require every municipality to organise a Centrum voor Jeugd en Gezin and to coordinate cooperation among youth-care, health, education, welfare, work and justice bodies through written agreements and an escalation model. It gives the mayor a power to designate an institution to coordinate care when agreements fail and an urgent case arises, and adds joint inspectorate supervision of compliance with those agreements.
31977.j: The memorandum justifies the mayor's designation power as a means to resolve coordination bottlenecks where a young person urgently needs care, noting that a bezwaar procedure and judicial review remain available.
q: If institutions, despite the agreements made, cannot resolve bottlenecks in care coordination, the mayor has under this proposal the power to designate an institution or bureau jeugdzorg and charge it with this coordination.

Indien instanties, ondanks de gemaakte afspraken, knelpunten in de coördinatie van de zorg niet kunnen oplossen, heeft de burgemeester met dit voorstel de bevoegdheid om een instantie of bureau jeugdzorg aan te wijzen en te belasten met deze coördinatie.
d: designation of further bodies in the domains of health, youth care, education, welfare, work and income, police and justice
further rules on content of cooperation agreements between municipality and bodies
minister may give instructions to the inspectorates, with agreement of the minister concerned
p: The mayor may designate an institution to coordinate care for a young person when agreements fail and care is urgent, with a written confirmation requirement and an appealable decision.
Joint inspectorates gain supervision of cooperation agreements, and the minister may instruct them, which adds central oversight over municipal arrangements.

parties: Asks how the mayor's power to designate a coordinating body works when that body is funded by the province, and questions the lack of enforceable obligations for cooperating institutions.
It is too easy to state that institutions are obliged to cooperate in reaching agreements and fulfilling them.
Het is te gemakkelijk om te stellen dat de instellingen verplicht zijn om mee te werken aan de totstandkoming van afspraken en de nakoming daarvan.
Asks what consequences follow if institutions refuse to cooperate, since the bill imposes no sanction, and whether the minister of VWS can give instructions to underperforming municipalities.
The present bill, however, sets no sanction for not cooperating and/or not fulfilling agreements.
Het voorliggende wetsvoorstel stelt echter geen sanctie op niet meewerken en/of het niet nakomen van afspraken.
Worries that the bill increases accountability reporting and bureaucracy and that parental consent rules for case discussion block effective help.
These members ask, however, whether this will not lead to more accountability from care institutions to municipalities and thus to more bureaucracy.
Deze leden vragen echter wel of dit niet gaat leiden tot meer verantwoording afleggen vanuit de hulpverleningsinstanties naar de gemeenten en dus ook tot meer bureaucratie.
Notes that a temporary ministerial regulation already allowed funding before parliamentary treatment and asks what role remains for the House.
What role then remains for the House in this bill?
Wat is de rol van de Kamer dan nog in dit wetsvoorstel?
Sceptical that the CJG adds a new layer rather than replacing existing youth institutions and bureaucracy.
Instead of tackling the messes at, among others, bureau jeugdzorg, an extra layer is being added.
In plaats van de puinhopen bij onder meer bureau jeugdzorg aan te pakken wordt er een extra laag toegevoegd.
Asks for criteria on how many CJG per municipality and whether the bill's wording on mandatory participation is too broad.
In that light, has the wording of article 1c not been chosen too broadly, ask these members.
Is in dat licht ook de formulering van artikel 1c niet te ruim gekozen, zo vragen genoemde leden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft amendment to the Youth Care Act introducing municipal Centra voor Jeugd en Gezin and municipal coordination duties, raising concerns about context, necessity, municipal powers, target group and the choice of statute. The government's nader rapport largely accepted the advice, adjusting the memorie van toelichting and the bill (e.g. the mayor's coordination power and the abolition of parental contributions) while rejecting the move of the coordination power to the college and the narrowing of the target group.
concerns: The Raad questioned the necessity of the bill, the added bureaucracy and the overlap with the Bureaus Jeugdzorg, and advised reconsidering the bill and explaining its need; the government clarified the purpose but did not fundamentally reconsider.

The Raad advised that the coordination power be vested in the college of mayor and aldermen rather than the mayor, and that the bill require others to accept coordination; the government rejected both, citing speed and proportionality.

The Raad noted municipalities lack powers to compel institutions to make agreements; the government clarified that cooperation is voluntary with inspections overseeing compliance, without adding enforcement powers.
The Raad's redactional comments on terminology, cross-references and wording were all adopted.
The Raad asked for clarity on the target group and whether the Centra should focus on parents of young children; the government clarified the target group but did not narrow it.
The Raad advised explaining why the Youth Care Act rather than the Wmo was chosen and the relation to other policy; the memorie van toelichting was supplemented, though no long-term vision was added.
The Raad advised naming the participating institutions in the statute rather than delegating to an algemene maatregel van bestuur; the government rejected this as impractical.

32123-IXB.s: This bill formally establishes the 2010 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the budget statements for the baten-lastendiensten Domeinen Roerende Zaken and Rijksvastgoed- en Ontwikkelingsbedrijf. The explanatory memorandum extract covers the ministry's policy agenda, Belastingdienst supervision targets, financial markets, and budgetary consequences.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2010 belonging to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2010 wordt vastgesteld.

32222-IXB.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the Ministry of Finance, the second supplementary budget linked to the Autumn Memorandum, raising spending and revenue lines such as Icesave deposit guarantee payouts. It also provides that Icesave payouts relating to the third tranche under the Icelandic deposit guarantee scheme are charged to the Ministry of Finance rather than under the normal rule of the Financial Supervision Act.
32222-IXB.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the Autumn Memorandum and the need to adjust expenditure and revenue lines, not by any delegation of power.
q: Notwithstanding Article 3:259(2) of the Financial Supervision Act, the Icesave payouts under the deposit guarantee scheme relating to the third tranche are charged to the Ministry of Finance.

In afwijking van artikel 3:259, lid 2 Wft worden de uitkeringen in verband met Icesave uit hoofde van het depositogarantiestelsel die betrekking hebben op de derde tranche voor rekening genomen van het Ministerie van Financiën.

32395-X.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence by adjusting spending and revenue lines across policy and non-policy articles. It takes effect on 1 June of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence for 2010
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Defensie

32697.s: The bill amends a pending bill on the Algemene Ouderdomswet by raising the income threshold above which the reduction on the partner supplement (toeslag voor de echtgenoot jonger dan 65 jaar) applies, from 110% to 162% of the gross minimum wage including holiday allowance, and reduces the percentage of the reduction from 8% to 10%. It enters into force together with the pending bill.
q: in that bill, in article 12, first paragraph, of the Algemene Ouderdomswet, '8%' is replaced by '10%'
wordt in die wet in het in artikel I, onderdeel B, voorgestelde artikel 12, eerste lid, van de Algemeen Ouderdomswet «8%» vervangen door «10%»

parties: Asks the government how large the group newly outside the reduction is, why implementation costs double structurally, and whether the SVB can implement by 1 July 2011.
The VVD members underline the urgency of a rapid entry into force of the law.
De leden van de VVD-fractie onderstrepen de urgentie van een snelle inwerkingtreding van de wet.
Opposes the bill, arguing that budget deficits from sector funds are shifted onto older people and that the cost should be shared fairly through alternative funding.
They are of the opinion that budget deficits resulting from shortfalls in the sector funds are being shifted onto older people.
Zij zijn van mening dat tekorten op de begroting als gevolg van tekorten in de sectorfondsen afgewenteld worden op ouderen.
Asks why implementation costs would rise in 2011 when the affected group has become smaller, as the SVB's implementation test predicted.
The PVV members had expected it to be the other way round, because the group to which the amendment now applies has become smaller.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hadden verwacht dat het eerder andersom zou zijn, omdat de groep waarop de wetswijziging thans betrekking heeft kleiner is geworden.
Supports the amended bill for sparing pensioners with small pensions, while asking how the EUR 55 million savings loss from later introduction will be covered.
They can therefore agree with the proposal to have the strongest shoulders bear the heaviest burdens, more than in the original bill, so that more older people with a small pension are spared.

Zij kunnen dan ook instemmen met het voorstel om meer dan in het oorspronkelijke wetsvoorstel de sterkste schouders de zwaarste lasten te laten dragen, waardoor meer ouderen met een klein pensioentje worden ontzien.

Welcomes better protection for low-income older people but asks about the basis of the 162% income threshold, purchasing-power effects, lower savings and higher administrative costs, and how citizens will be informed in the short time before entry into force.
They also ask how the government will prevent problems in information provision and implementation, given the short time remaining before the proposed entry into force of the measure on 1 July 2011.

Ook vragen zij hoe de regering problemen in de informatievoorziening en de uitvoering gaat voorkomen, gezien de korte termijn dat rest tot de voorgestelde inwerkingtreding van de maatregel per 1 juli 2011.

32710-XI.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget (begrotingsstaten) for the housing, spatial planning and environment chapter (XI), the Waddenfonds and the baten-lastendiensten, and sets rules on the 2010 annual report and budget rounding. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The budget statements for chapter XI Housing, Spatial Planning and Environmental Management and for the Waddenfonds for the year 2010 are amended.
De begrotingsstaat van het begrotingshoofdstuk Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer (XI) en van de begrotingsstaat van het Waddenfonds voor het jaar 2010 worden gewijzigd.

32787.s: The bill amends the Wet op het financieel toezicht to implement EU Directive 2009/111/EG (CRD II) on banks affiliated with central institutions, own funds, large exposures, supervisory framework and crisis management, and also includes a provision implementing part of CRD III on enforcement of remuneration rules. It creates colleges of supervisors, significant-branch designations, information-sharing and crisis-notification duties for De Nederlandsche Bank, and a DNB power to decide on group capital adequacy after failed consultation with other supervisors.
32787.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to implement the EU directive and to improve cross-border supervisory cooperation and crisis management.
q: DNB shall in any case prescribe higher own funds where the capital held is no longer proportionate to the risk profile of the financial undertaking.
DNB schrijft in ieder geval een hoger toetsingsvermogen voor indien het aangehouden kapitaal niet meer in verhouding staat met het risicoprofiel van de desbetreffende financiële onderneming.
d: rules on DNB tasks within colleges of supervisors
supervisory measures on liquidity, own funds, remuneration of banks
p: DNB gains expanded discretion to impose capital, liquidity, risk-limiting and remuneration measures on banks that fail prudential requirements.
DNB may decide group-level own funds adequacy unilaterally if consultation with other supervisors does not reach agreement within four months.}

parties: Asks whether the proposed amendments deviate from the European directives and for an overall picture of the package.
The VVD members ask whether the proposed amendments to the Wft deviate in parts from the European directives?
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de wijzigingsvoorstellen in de Wft op onderdelen afwijken van de Europese richtlijnen?
Questions whether hybrid capital instruments create a wrong incentive and asks for details on capital requirements, with the implicit demand for clearer information to parliament.
Has a wrong incentive not arisen to use these hybrid capital instruments as much as possible?
Is er niet een verkeerde prikkel ontstaan om deze hybride kapitaalinstrumenten zo veel mogelijk te gebruiken?
Welcomes the reforms but questions why key rules such as concentration risk are only now being codified by law and asks about information exchange between supervisors of cross-border institutions.
This has after all long been part of Basel II.
Dit maakt immers al lang deel uit van Bazel II.
Objects that important matters such as the large-exposures regime, hybrid instruments and securitisation are left to lower regulation rather than statute, reducing parliamentary control.
Can the government further explain why these important subjects, despite their technical nature, nevertheless should not be regulated at statutory level?
Kan de regering nader uitleggen waarom deze belangrijke onderwerpen, ondanks het technische karakter, toch niet op wetsniveau moeten worden geregeld?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill implementing CRD II but asks the government to explain in the explanatory memorandum how it fits the wider CRD III/IV and Basel III package, and to clarify whether central banks may share emergency information with supervisors. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts the suggested changes, updates the memorandum on the EBA, adjusts the bill, and makes the drafting correction.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for a fuller explanation in the memorandum of how CRD II relates to the broader CRD III and CRD IV package and planned changes to the Bpr and supervisory rules.
The Afdeling cannot derive from the directive that central banks may warn supervisors of emergencies, and asks the government to explain and adjust the bill if needed.
A redactional correction is proposed to the cross-reference in article 3:278d, first paragraph, which the government adopts.

32859.s: The bill amends the Road Traffic Act 1994 to create a separate offence of driving under the influence of drugs, with concentration limits for named drugs to be set by general administrative order (AMvB). It also lets police require saliva tests and psychomotor/eye-speech examinations as screening tools, and allows nurses as well as doctors to take blood samples.
32859.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the scientific evidence on drug impairment, the practical difficulty of detecting some drugs, and the need to avoid zero-tolerance inequality with alcohol and medicines.
q: On the basis of the above, it is proposed to include limit values for amphetamine, methamphetamine, MDEA, MDMA, MDA, THC, cocaine, morphine and GHB in a general administrative order based on article 8, paragraph 5 of the Road Traffic Act 1994.

Op grond van het voorgaande wordt voorgesteld om voor amfetamine, methamfetamine, MDEA, MDMA, MDA, THC, cocaïne, morfine en GHB grenswaarden in een op artikel 8, vijfde lid, van de Wegenverkeerswet 1994 gebaseerde algemene maatregel van bestuur op te nemen.
d: drug names and concentration limits for drug driving offence
p: Drivers must cooperate with police saliva tests, psychomotor and eye/speech examinations on first demand by investigating officers.
Nurses may be asked to take blood samples from suspected drivers, widening the group of persons police can call on.},{

parties: Supports the bill's goal of reducing drug-related road casualties but asks whether a zero limit would send a clearer signal than tolerance thresholds.
These members share the desire and need to reduce road casualties caused by driving under the influence of drugs and see this proposal as a good basis for that.
Deze leden delen de wens en de noodzaak om het aantal verkeersslachtoffers als gevolg van rijden onder invloed van drugs terug te dringen en zien in dit voorstel een goede basis daartoe.
Asks why limit values are set by amvb for drugs but in the statute for alcohol, why police need an explicit statutory power for psychomotor tests, and what the bill adds to existing practice.
Questions the workability of limit values for polydrug use, the comparison with alcohol, and why the government did not follow German or Belgian zero-tolerance approaches.
The aforementioned members note that road safety must always come first.
Voornoemde leden merken op dat de verkeersveiligheid te allen tijde voorop dient te staan.
Regrets the government's choice against zero tolerance, asks about GHB detection, and wants new drugs added to the list quickly and the recidive scheme extended.
These members regret the government's decision not to adopt a zero tolerance approach to drugs in traffic.
Deze leden betreuren de niet gemaakte keuze van de regering voor een zero tolerance aanpak van drugs in het verkeer.

Supports the goal but worries about false positives from saliva tests (cited 16% false positive, 19% false negative), the intrusive blood-sampling consequence, and whether citizens who merely sat near smokers could be wrongly caught.
The SP members believe that too many citizens must not be wrongly subjected to the intrusive coercive measure of blood sampling, so a high number of false positives is objectionable.

De leden van de SP-fractie zijn van mening dat moet voorkomen dat teveel burgers ten onrechte aan het ingrijpende dwangmiddel van de bloedafname worden onderworpen, een te hoog aantal vals-positieven is dus bezwaarlijk.
Supports the bill but asks whether patients with structural pain who take morphine are protected, suggesting an exception on medical grounds.
They ask for the chosen limit values to be substantiated on this point and suggest making an exception for people who use morphine on medical grounds.
Zij vragen om de gekozen grenswaarden op dit punt te onderbouwen en geven in overweging om een uitzondering te maken voor mensen die op medische indicatie morfine gebruiken.

Welcomes tougher enforcement but questions why the government rejected the Raad van Korpschefs' zero-value approach, why combined use below thresholds is not punished, and whether lighter use should be treated differently for young drivers.
These members find that this creates a great deal of unclarity.
Deze leden vinden dat hiermee veel onduidelijkheid wordt gecreëerd.

Asks whether threshold-based enforcement is more workable than zero tolerance, whether scientific grounding for thresholds is sufficient, and whether frequent cannabis users could be punished without an actual danger to traffic safety.
These members believe drugs should have no place in traffic.
Deze leden vinden dat drugs geen plaats horen te hebben in het verkeer.
Asks about the reliability of the saliva tester as a pre-selection tool and about the availability of a GHB-detecting test, with limited questions overall.
The SP members would like to know from the government whether there are relevant developments in the saliva tester as a pre-selection tool.
De leden van de SP-fractie vernemen graag van de regering of er relevante ontwikkelingen zijn met betrekking tot de ontwikkeling van de speekseltester als voorselectiemiddel.

Argues that substances and their thresholds should be set in formal law rather than an algemene maatregel van bestuur to respect legality and legal certainty, and questions the reliability of saliva tests and of police impairment assessments.

In view of the legality principle in article 1 of the Criminal Code, and in particular the legal certainty for citizens it aims at, these members believe the individual psychoactive substances and the thresholds attached to them should be regulated by formal law.

Gelet op het legaliteitsbeginsel, verwoord in artikel 1 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht, en in het bijzonder op de daarmee beoogde rechtszekerheid voor de burger, dienen naar mening van deze leden de afzonderlijke psychoactieve stoffen en het stellen van de aan die stoffen verbonden grenswaarden bij formele wet te worden geregeld.

Argues that the bill and an amendment would disproportionately restrict medical morphine users' freedom of movement, and asks whether an exception for habituated users and a study of their danger to traffic should be made.

These members believe that drivers who use a small but measurable amount of morphine to treat physical pain are disproportionately restricted in their freedom of movement by the bill, and that criminal action against this group is disproportionate.

Deze leden menen dat bestuurders die een klein, maar meetbaar gehalte aan morfine ter bestrijding van de lichamelijke pijn gebruiken, door het wetsvoorstel onevenredig worden beperkt in hun bewegingsvrijheid en een strafrechtelijk optreden tegen deze groep disproportioneel is.
Asks about the reliability of the saliva tester, the extra police investment and costs, available technology, and the merits of zero tolerance.
These members ask whether additional investment in the police is needed to implement the law.
Deze leden vragen of er extra investeringen nodig zijn bij de politie om de wet uit te voeren.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an opinion on the draft bill that raised no substantive remarks, only two editorial points. The minister's nader rapport confirms that both editorial points were incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling made two editorial remarks, one on the explanatory note regarding article 160(5)(a) of the Wegenverkeerswet 1994, which the government incorporated.

32877.s: The bill amends the Dutch VAT Act 1968 to align invoicing rules with EU Directive 2010/45/EU, modernising and harmonising invoice requirements and easing electronic invoicing. It shifts electronic invoicing from technology-specific methods to business-controlled authenticity and integrity, and extends the inspector's access to electronic invoices.
32877.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to ministerial regulation as needed where trade or technical conditions make full invoices unduly burdensome, and the expanded inspector access as necessary for effective VAT control under EU Directive 249.
q: From now on, businesses themselves determine how the authenticity and integrity of the invoice, and also its legibility, are guaranteed.
Het zijn dus voortaan de ondernemers zelf die bepalen op welke wijze de authenticiteit en de integriteit van de factuur, en ook de leesbaarheid ervan, worden gewaarborgd.
d: exemption from invoicing obligation for exclusively exempt suppliers
Artikel 34d, eerste lid, onderdeel a (via 34d) / Artikel 34e
designation of businesses required to issue invoices for all supplies
simplified invoice content for certain business sectors
p: Businesses themselves determine how authenticity, integrity and legibility of electronic invoices are guaranteed, subject to later inspection by the tax authority.
Artikel I, onderdeel K (artikel 35c, tweede lid)
The tax inspector gains the right to inspect, download and use electronic invoices stored abroad where the business owes VAT in the Netherlands, regardless of where the invoices are stored.

parties: Asks whether the Belastingdienst can give advance certainty on the form of business audits and whether the ministerial policy decision will be changed before entry into force.
The PVV members ask whether it is possible to obtain advance certainty from the Tax Authority about the form of the business audit.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of het mogelijk is om bij de Belastingdienst zekerheid vooraf te krijgen ten aanzien van de vorm van de bedrijfscontrole.
Not convinced by the government's answer to the Council of State on electronic invoicing and asks how the directive affects the Tax Authority's ability to combat carousel fraud.
The CDA members are not yet convinced by the government's answer to the Council of State's question about electronic invoicing.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn nog niet overtuigd van het antwoord van de regering op de vraag van de Raad van State over de elektronische facturering.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the bill implementing the EU invoicing directive (electronic invoicing treated equally with paper) but asks the explanatory memorandum to address whether shifting authenticity and integrity checks from ex ante to ex post increases cross-border VAT fraud. The government's nader rapport adds a text block on fraud in the explanatory memorandum, rejects the fraud-increase concern on substance, and implements the redactional comments, including deleting an overlapping provision.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for explanation of whether the shift to ex post control facilitates cross-border VAT fraud; the government disagrees in substance but adds a text block on fraud to the explanatory memorandum.
Redactional comments on article references, numbering and overlapping provisions were adopted in full.

32895.s: The bill amends the Dutch Act on the allocation of temporary workers (WAADI) and the Works Councils Act to implement EU Directive 2008/104/EC on temporary agency work. It introduces equal treatment of agency workers on pay and working conditions, equal access to company facilities and vacancy notification, a ban on clauses hindering agency workers from being hired directly by the user company, and an annual reporting duty to works councils on agency workers.
32895.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary implementation of the EU directive and notes that the Council of State advice was favourable; no new executive powers are justified.
q: it is necessary to amend the Act on the allocation of workers through intermediaries and the Works Councils Act to implement this directive
het noodzakelijk is wijzigingen aan te brengen in de Wet allocatie arbeidskrachten door intermediairs en de Wet op de ondernemingsraden ter implementatie van deze richtlijn

parties: Asks how derogations from the equal treatment norm via collective agreements are limited, enforced and monitored, and when the review of existing prohibitions will be completed and reported to parliament.
They ask when the announced review must be completed and whether the government is willing to inform the House of its outcomes in good time.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen wanneer de aangekondigde heroverweging gerealiseerd dient te zijn en of de regering bereid is om de Kamer over de uitkomsten van de heroverweging tijdig te informeren.
Worries that exceptions for essential working conditions and collective-agreement derogations lower the protection level for agency workers and asks for the minimum floor to be defined.
Is this not a lowering of the protection level for agency workers? What is the floor of the minimum conditions?
Is dit geen verlaging van het beschermingsniveau van uitzendkrachten? Wat is de ondergrens van de minimumvoorwaarden?
Asks what measures follow if collective agreements nonetheless derogate from equal treatment, and what the bill means for enforcement of the Waadi.
These members also ask whether the present bill has consequences for the enforcement of the Waadi.
Deze leden vragen voorts of het onderhavige wetsvoorstel gevolgen of consequenties heeft voor de handhaving van de Waadi?
Asks for the status of the review of prohibitions in legislation and collective agreements and how the House will be informed of its results.
The CDA members ask the government to give the state of affairs of the review of prohibitions in legislation and collective agreements.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering om de stand van zaken te geven van de heroverweging van de verbodsbepalingen in wet- en regelgeving en in cao's.
Asks by which criteria the review of prohibitions and the collective-agreement derogation will be assessed, when the evaluation can be expected, and how the House will be informed.
They ask on the basis of which criteria this provision will be assessed. The D66 members are also curious when the House can expect this evaluation.
Zij vragen aan de hand van welke criteria deze bepaling wordt getoetst. De leden van de D66-fractie zijn voorts benieuwd wanneer de Kamer deze evaluatie kan verwachten.
Asks for a fuller explanation of the sanctions policy when the directive is not complied with.
The SP members ask the government for a further explanation of the sanctions policy if the directive is not complied with.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering om een nadere toelichting op het sanctiebeleid bij niet naleven van de richtlijn.

33000-VII.s: The bill formally adopts the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statements for its nine baten-lastendiensten, in thousands of euros. It sets entry into force on 1 January 2012, with retroactive effect if published later, and contains no delegation of rule-making or new executive powers.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for 2012 belonging to this act is hereby adopted.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2012 wordt vastgesteld.

33090-IV.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of Kingdom Relations (IV) to reflect the autumn budget review, changing appropriations and moving funds for border control by the Royal Marechaussee to the policy article for the Kingdom's guarantee function. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 December 2011.
33090-IV.j: The memorandum explains that the funds for border control belong under the general guarantee function rather than the operational goal of promoting Kingdom partner autonomy, so the funds are accounted for under the correct operational goal.
q: The funds for border control by the Royal Marechaussee belong under the general goal of the guarantee function, not the operational goal of promoting autonomy of Kingdom partners.

De middelen ten behoeve van de grenscontrolebewaking door de Koninklijke Marechaussee horen op het algemene doel van de waarborgfunctie thuis, niet op het operationele doel bevorderen autonomie Koninkrijkspartners.

33090-VI.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget appropriations of the Ministry of Security and Justice, adjusting spending and receipts across policy and non-policy articles following the autumn budget review (Najaarsnota). It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force on 1 December 2011.

33240-IXA.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (National Debt, IXA) for 2011, setting the adjusted budget figures in thousands of euros and making it retroactive to 31 December of the budget year. The explanatory memorandum is absent, so no justification is provided.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the National Debt (IXA) for the year 2011
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van de Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2011

33498.s: The bill amends the Dutch Criminal Code and Code of Criminal Procedure to adjust sanctions and procedures for juveniles and young adults aged 18 to 23, including extending the flexible use of juvenile sanctions and reclassification supervision, expanding conditional release, time-out measures, electronic monitoring and rules on where sentences are served. It shifts several discretionary decisions, including whether juvenile or ordinary criminal law applies and the conditions and enforcement of sanctions, toward the public prosecutor and courts while adding some supervisory safeguards.
33498.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as aligning sanctions with the developmental stage of adolescents, improving public safety and victim protection, and better connecting juvenile and adult probation.
q: The bill also assumes that custodial sanctions are carried out in a juvenile justice institution.
Het wetsvoorstel gaat er daarnaast van uit dat vrijheidsbenemende sancties worden tenuitvoergelegd in een justitiële jeugdinrichting.
d: rules on decision-making on special conditions for conditional release
rules on supervision of conditional release conditions
Artikel III, D (Beginselenwet justitiële jeugdinrichtingen, artikel 43, lid 1)
rules on admission and refusal of visits to youth detention institutions
p: Artikel I, D (artikel 77f) and Artikel II, B (artikel 257a, lid 7)
Public prosecutors may issue penalty orders to young offenders with broader conditions and longer work or learning sentences, expanding prosecutorial discretion.

Substitute youth detention or custody is applied by default for breach of a community sentence unless exceptional circumstances cause serious unfairness, shifting from prosecutorial to automatic enforcement, with courts retaining decisions on adult custody.
Expands grounds for the youth protective measure and allows extension up to seven years, with courts deciding and some safeguards.
Artikel I, N (artikel 77tc) and Artikel I, V (artikel 77cc, lid 3)

Allows conversion of youth protective measures into adult TBS-type measures and enforcement of suspended measures on prosecutorial request when safety requires, with court decision and adviser input required.
Court may order temporary admission to a youth institution of up to four weeks, twice during a measure, on prosecutorial request for non-compliance.
Artikel I, E and Artikel I, W (artikel 77ja, 77dd)
Sets clearer rules for conditional release and where sentences are served, with courts retaining decisions on placement and some exceptions.
Public prosecutor may indicate at pre-trial detention stage an intent to apply juvenile law to young adults, advised by the probation service.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion of 5 October 2012 supports the bill introducing an adolescent criminal law for 18-23 year olds but raises objections on effectiveness, the age ceiling of 23, the default application of ordinary criminal law, the doubling of youth detention, the conditions for the pij-measure, temporary crisis admission, and the duty to appear. The government's reply of 29 November 2012 accepts several points (age ceiling clarified, appearance duty added, crisis admission safeguards, visiting rules, joint trial, placement policy), while maintaining the default rule and dropping the doubling of youth detention and the new pij-condition.
concerns: The Afdeling questions the effectiveness of extending youth sanctions to 18-23 year olds and the lack of justification linking the measures to recidivism reduction; the government clarifies the aim but gives limited new empirical motivation.
The Afdeling finds the doubling of the maximum youth detention term insufficiently justified and in some cases higher than adult maxima; the government drops the doubling.

The Afdeling finds the new psychiatric condition for the pij-measure problematic because it may leave the judge unable to impose a suitable sanction; the government's reply acknowledges shifts toward other sanctions and the condition is revised.
The Afdeling questions the age ceiling of 23 and asks for adjustment to 24 given neurobiological evidence; the government keeps 23 but clarifies the reference to the age at the time of the offence.

The Afdeling questions making ordinary criminal law the default for 18-23 year olds, noting the principled justification is weak and the bill could be a transitional step; the government keeps the default rule for the stated reasons.
The Afdeling asks for procedural safeguards for minors in temporary crisis admission, such as closed-door hearings; the government adds a paragraph to Article 77ee Sr.
The Afdeling asks for clarification of differentiated placement policy for young adults in youth institutions; the government supplements the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asks for a duty to appear for adolescents in custody facing youth sanctions; the government adds this to Article 63 Sv.
The Afdeling questions the new visiting refusal ground protecting victims, lacking justification; the government removes it.
The Afdeling makes several drafting comments and corrections in an annex, which the government adopts.

33579.s: The bill amends the Wet structuur uitvoeringsorganisatie werk en inkomen and several social security and benefit laws to allow wider sharing of income and benefit data among agencies, creating a risk-indication system (SyRI) for fraud detection. It also adds provisions requiring suspension of benefit payments when a recipient is recorded in the municipal population register as having left the Netherlands to an unknown destination and does not correct the registration.
33579.j: The memorandum justifies the data sharing and the risk-indication system as necessary to prevent social security fraud, stating that a proper check on the accuracy of claims requires use of data already held by government and that privacy is safeguarded through purpose limits, time limits and secrecy duties.
q: The SyRI instrument is based on the principle that data already known to government bodies are used for implementation, prevention, supervision and investigation in social security, income-dependent schemes, taxes, premiums and labour laws.

Het in deze paragraaf beschreven instrument SyRI (Systeem Risico Indicatie) gaat uit van het uitgangspunt dat gegevens die bij overheidsinstanties bekend zijn, worden aangewend voor uitvoering, preventie, toezicht en opsporing op het terrein van sociale zekerheid, inkomensafhankelijke regelingen, belastingen, premies en arbeidswetten.
d: conditions for data processing by UWV, SVB and municipalities
other bodies designated for data provision and further processing of supervision data for criminal investigation
designating additional public bodies and persons for inter-agency data cooperation
rules on the risk indication system, processor designation and data provision
time limits and manner of meeting data provision obligations
which data are provided, manner of provision and costs
data and recipients for scientific research and statistics
conditions attached to data provision under this article
implementation of data provision on detained Dutch nationals abroad
p: Creates a system allowing government bodies to pool personal and business data to generate risk reports on individuals and companies, with report use limited to two years and secrecy obligations, but with limited judicial or parliamentary oversight of the analysis.
Obliges the tax authority, energy and water utilities and landlords to provide data to benefit bodies without request, widening executive access to personal information.

Authorises suspension of benefit payments after a set period where the municipal register shows departure to an unknown destination, with suspension lasting until residence abroad or a Dutch address is established.
Extends the term 'data' in the law to cover personal data within the meaning of the Dutch data protection act, broadening the scope of permitted processing.

parties: Supports faster fraud detection but insists privacy be closely watched, questions proportionality of data sharing with private insurers and pension funds, and asks why enforcement officers need not act on risk reports.
However, the privacy aspect of the measures must be closely monitored.
Wel moet het privacy-aspect bij de maatregelen goed in de gaten worden gehouden.
Asks when the minister may refuse SyRI data requests and under what criteria municipalities conduct address investigations.
They also ask whether the government can illustrate in which situations the minister is expected to decide not to honour a request to process data in SyRI.
Kan de regering illustreren in welke situaties te verwachten valt dat de minister beslist om het verzoek om verwerking van gegevens in SyRI niet te honoreren?
Supports tackling fraud but insists on objectively justified suspicion before investigation and guaranteed privacy, and asks whether the list of participating bodies may expand later.
For the SP members it is essential that persons are investigated where there is an objectively substantiated suspicion of fraud.
Voor de leden van de SP-fractie is het van wezenlijk belang dat personen worden onderzocht waarbij een objectief onderbouwd vermoeden van fraude bestaat.

Notes the government did not adopt the Council of State's advice on discretion in the SyRI provision and asks for clarity on the 'other bodies' and on the broad scope of the child-care register data provision.
The CDA members note that the government did not adopt the Council of State's advice to include a discretionary power in Article 65(1) of the SUWI Act.

De leden van de CDA-fractie constateren dat de regering het advies van de Raad van State om in artikel 65, eerste lid, van de Wet SUWI een discretionaire bevoegdheid op te nemen niet heeft overgenomen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the SUWI Act to allow data exchange for fraud prevention (the SARI/SyRI risk-indication system), raising serious concerns about vague purpose limitation, the broad 'increased risk' criterion, undefined participating bodies, and insufficient safeguards. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, narrowing the purpose, specifying supervisors, adding safeguards, and clarifying the other points, while rejecting the discretionary-power and algemene maatregel van bestuur suggestions.
concerns: The purpose of data processing in SyRI was too broad and vague and had to be specified concretely, which the government accepted by listing legal obligations and narrowing the wording.
The 'increased risk of misuse' criterion was too broad and could impose disproportionate intrusion on privacy; the government clarified it with examples.

Participating bodies were insufficiently defined; supervisors are now listed, while other bodies are still designated by ministerial regulation rather than by algemene maatregel van bestuur as advised.
The Council advised turning the minister's obligation to honour requests into a discretionary power; the government declined, stating that the minister weighs requests as part of the procedure.
Safeguards such as anonymisation, use limitation and feedback of risk-report results were insufficiently anchored in the statute and have been written into the bill.
Disclosure of data on prisoners abroad to UWV and SVB raised doubts on added value and data protection; the bill now limits the use and the BSN and birth date, with clarification of added value.
The suspension of benefits for persons registered as 'vertrokken onbekend waarheen' raised questions; the government adjusted the fourth paragraph but kept the mechanism.
Several redactional and technical remarks on the statute and naming of the system were accepted.

33597.s: The bill amends the Wet gemeenschappelijke regelingen (Wgr) to adapt intergemeentelijke cooperation to the dualisation of municipal and provincial government, introduce a new business-operations organisation with legal personality, and replace the former catch-all of article 33 with self-contained rules on allocation and delegation of powers, dismissal of board members, schorsing, vernietiging, taakverwaarlozing (indeplaatsstelling) and publication of general binding rules. Together these provisions strengthen the general board of joint bodies relative to the executive board and expand central and provincial intervention powers.
33597.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to remove the catch-all function of article 33 after dualisation, to clarify and modernise the Wgr, and to strengthen the democratic control of the general board over joint bodies.
q: The lapse of article 33 of the Wgr also means that, apart from dualisation, a number of powers of the public body are made explicit as a result of legal development.

Het vervallen van artikel 33 van de Wgr brengt voorts met zich dat, los van de dualisering, een aantal bevoegdheden van het openbaar lichaam worden geëxpliciteerd als gevolg van de rechtsontwikkeling.
d: establishing a business-operations organisation with legal personality
general board may delegate its powers to the executive board
executive board members may authorise others to exercise powers
rules on systematic information provision on delegated tasks, via AMvB or provincial ordinance
rules on how general binding texts are made available
designation of electronic medium and exempt categories of decisions
p: Gedeputeerde staten, and in certain cases a minister, may take over decisions of a joint body's organ that fails to perform its legally required tasks, including by enforcing results at the cost of the joint body or participants.
A minister may require provincial executives to intervene or take over the intervention power directly for matters of overriding national interest.
Decisions of joint-body boards can be suspended or annulled by royal decree, with a minister proposing suspension and the Crown able to set provisional arrangements or direct new decisions.
The general board may dismiss a member of the executive board and the court may not review the grounds for dismissal, which strengthens the general board relative to the executive board.
The general board may amend the joint arrangement and receives default allocation of powers, though it may not transfer participants' powers and must consult councils on new companies.

parties: Asks how the tasks and powers differ between the public body, the joint organ and the proposed business-operations organisation, and whether execution tasks remain with public bodies.
To what extent are the public body or joint organ intended for executive tasks, these members ask.
In hoeverre zijn het openbaar lichaam c.q. het gemeenschappelijk orgaan bedoeld voor uitvoerende taken, zo vragen deze leden.

Asks how the bill strengthens individual municipal councils' control over joint arrangements, questions the lack of a strict definition of execution versus support, and asks whether council oversight of effectiveness and efficiency is sufficient and whether local audit committees should get more powers.
These members find no precise definition in the law of the terms execution and support, as the Council of State requested, and wonder whether this is not desirable after all.
Deze leden lezen geen precieze afbakening in de wet van de begrippen uitvoering en ondersteuning zoals de Raad van State heeft gevraagd en vragen zich af of dit niet toch wenselijk is.

Doubts that the line between policy and business operations is always clear, notes budget cuts could carry policy choices, and questions how democratic legitimacy is ensured when representative bodies disagree on the budget.
Policy choices belong with a municipality or public body.
Beleidsmatige keuzes horen thuis bij een gemeente of een openbaar lichaam.

Supports strengthening municipal council influence over budgets and accounts, asks whether audit committees lack powers over joint arrangements compared with the municipal audit office, and proposes that joint arrangements publish in their own gazette.
Is it correct that an audit committee has no powers regarding joint arrangements, unlike an audit office under article 184 of the Municipalities Act?
Is het juist, dat een rekenkamercommissie geen bevoegdheden heeft inzake gemeenschappelijke regelingen zoals een rekenkamer die heeft op grond van artikel 184 Gemeentewet?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the Wgr amendment bill introducing a legal-personality business-operations organisation without a tiered board, but raises concerns about accountability to municipal councils and the Wet veiligheidsregio's reference to the Gemeentewet dereliction-of-duty regime.
