The government's reply accepts the accountability and scope clarifications in the explanatory memorandum and rejects the removal of the Gemeentewet annex reference, arguing the choice was made deliberately in an earlier amendment.
concerns: Lack of internal tiered accountability in the bedrijfsvoeringsorganisatie requires that political accountability to the municipal council be guaranteed, which the government addressed by clarifying external accountability in the memorandum and the bill.

Scope of the organisation's tasks must be limited to execution and support so that policy choices stay with municipalities; the government clarified the limits and mandating possibilities but did not add a statutory restriction beyond explanation.

The reference to the Gemeentewet dereliction-of-duty regime for the Wet veiligheidsregio's should be dropped to avoid a lex specialis conflict; the government retained it because the choice to designate the minister was already made in the earlier revitalisering amendment.
Numerous redactional comments on article wording, numbering, cross-references and terminology were largely incorporated, with a few exceptions explained.

33669.s: The bill amends the Natuurbeschermingswet 1998 to establish a formal programmatic approach to nitrogen deposition, under which a programme sets reduction measures, development space per Natura 2000 area, reservations for priority projects and a threshold value exempting small-impact projects from permit requirements. It also shifts several decisions to ministerial regulations and clarifies provincial competence and appeal rights.
33669.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers as necessary for efficient adoption and effective implementation of the programme and to meet EU obligations under the Habitats and Birds Directives.
q: The bill provides a ministerial power to regulate how development space is determined, allocated and reserved, and how this is registered.
Het wetsvoorstel voorziet in een ministeriële bevoegdheid om te regelen hoe de ontwikkelingsruimte wordt bepaald, toegedeeld en gereserveerd en hoe dit wordt geregistreerd
d: adopt the nitrogen programme jointly by the two ministers
rules on determining, allocating and reserving development space
threshold value and distance categories exempting projects from permit requirement
amend or replace programme measures, including by ministers and provinces or municipalities
designate projects for which development space is reserved
rules on registration of allocations and reservations of development space
competent authority imposes preventive, restorative or cessation obligations
p: Development space may be allocated by the competent authority in permits and plans, with binding reservations, limiting the basis for individual assessment of nitrogen effects.
Competent authority need not assess nitrogen deposition below the threshold value, removing a substantive review step for many projects.
Authorities may impose binding obligations on operators, after giving interested parties a chance to comment where urgency allows.
Appeal against the programme is opened for project exemptions, partly restoring judicial review of programme decisions.

parties: Asks how provincially reserved development space relates to ministerial allocation and how over-reservation is prevented, and seeks a single permitting point for entrepreneurs.
The VVD members note that the core of the bill is to create development space for projects and other activities that cause nitrogen deposition.
De leden van de VVD-fractie merken op dat de kern van het wetsvoorstel is om ontwikkelingsruimte te creëren voor projecten en andere handelingen die stikstofdepositie met zich meebrengen.
Questions whether the AERIUS model is a transparent 'black box' and how its validation and cross-border effects are handled.
According to the SP members, AERIUS is a 'black box' to outsiders, comparable to the model on which the National Air Quality Cooperation Programme is based.
Volgens de leden van de SP-fractie is voor de buitenstaander AERIUS een «black box», vergelijkbaar met het model waarop het Nationaal Samenwerkingsprogramma Luchtkwaliteit is geënt.
Supports rapid entry into force for legal certainty, but asks about socio-economic weighing in management plans and whether objections and appeals are possible against them.
Questions whether allocation rules should be set by AMvB rather than ministerial regulation, whether the decoupling from management plans creates risks, and fraud sensitivity without external checks.
The D66 members believe the rules for allocating and reserving development space are so important that they should be set by AMvB (general administrative order) rather than ministerial regulation.

De leden van de D66-fractie zijn van mening dat de regels voor de toedeling en reservering van de ontwikkelingsruimte van dusdanig belang zijn, dat ze niet bij ministeriele regeling, maar bij AMvB zouden moeten worden vastgesteld.
Stresses legal soundness and feasibility of measures, and asks how development space is safeguarded against simultaneous large-scale applications and how measures are monitored.
The said members attach great value to the legal soundness of the programme.
Genoemde leden hechten zeer veel waarde aan de juridische houdbaarheid van het programma.
Asks whether pending preliminary questions to the European Court of Justice affect the PAS, and how risks from unimplemented measures and changing scientific insights are handled.
The SGP members have the impression that answering these questions is relevant to the durability of the PAS system.
De leden van de SGP-fractie hebben de indruk dat de beantwoording van deze vragen relevant is voor de houdbaarheid van de PAS-systematiek.

Argues the bill allocates development space before measures are proven effective, undermining nature protection and the Habitats Directive's deterioration ban, and demands accountability and withdrawal of the PAS.

These members believe the government achieves the opposite with the bill, because a theoretical decline in nitrogen deposition is filled with actual nitrogen deposition without guarantees that deposition will actually decline.

Deze leden menen dat de regering het tegenovergestelde bereikt met de Wijziging van de Natuurbeschermingswet 1998 (programmatische aanpak stikstof), omdat een theoretische daling van de stikstofdepositie wordt opgevuld met werkelijke stikstofdepositie zonder borging dat de depositie daadwerkelijk zal dalen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft amendment of the Natuurbeschermingswet 1998 introducing the programmatische aanpak stikstof (PAS), finding that several provisions (vergunning exemptions for pre-2005 activities, art. 19kd, the grenswaarde, plan exemptions) gave incomplete implementation of art. 6(3) Habitatrichtlijn and recommending adjustments. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, dropped the pre-2005 exemption and art. 19kd, and addressed the grenswaarde, ministerial regulation, rechtsbescherming and consultation.
concerns: Pre-2005 exemption from the permit requirement for existing businesses was an incomplete implementation of Habitats Directive art. 6(3); government dropped it.
Art. 19kd exemptions from permit and plan assessment leave gaps in implementing art. 6(3) Habitats Directive; government deleted art. 19kd.
Grenswaarde should be set by algemene maatregel van bestuur rather than ministerial regulation; government did not follow this advice.
Grenswaarde criterion should be anchored in the statute to ensure it meets the best scientific knowledge standard; government followed.
Practical usability and effectiveness of the grenswaarde and reservation of development space need clarification; government clarified in the memorie van toelichting.
Rechtsbescherming: appeal against PAS parts should be regulated by amending Bijlage 2 Awb; government followed.
Consultation of IPO, VNG and UvW under the Code Interbestuurlijke Verhoudingen was incomplete; government reports consultation took place.

33687.s: The bill phases out the AOW partner allowance (partnertoeslag) for married pensioners whose spouse is below pension age when the couple's combined income exceeds a threshold, with the reduction applied fully from 2018 after a three-year transition. It also extends the income test to the pensioner's own income changes and sets the threshold by reference to the statutory minimum wage.
33687.j: The memorandum justifies the measure by the sustainability of public finances, the ageing population and a fair sharing of the crisis burden, and says proportionality has been weighed.
q: With this bill the right to the partner allowance under the General Old Age Act (AOW) will be phased out over three years from 2015 for the highest income categories.
Met onderhavig wetsvoorstel wordt het recht op de partnertoeslag op grond van de Algemene Ouderdomswet (AOW), voor de hoogste inkomenscategorieën vanaf 2015 in drie jaar afgebouwd.
d: definition of income from work and other income for AOW allowance rules

parties: Asks how the phase-out between EUR 46,000 and EUR 54,000 is calculated and how the post-2015 transition period is justified.
In 1995 it was agreed that the AOW partner allowance for new entrants would end as of 1 January 2015.
In 1995 is afgesproken dat de AOW-partnertoeslag voor nieuwe instroom eindigt per 1 januari 2015.
Supports the measure because higher incomes are asked for an extra contribution, but wants a table showing how the reduction works and how the range is legally fixed.
These members support the proposal because higher incomes are asked to make an extra contribution.
Deze leden steunen het voorstel vanwege het feit dat van hogere inkomens een extra bijdrage wordt gevraagd.
Calls the measure another blunt cut that will affect many AOW recipients and questions its leveling effect and impact on existing rights.
These members note that this can only be seen as yet another blunt cut that will affect a large group of AOW recipients.
Deze leden merken op dat dit niet anders kan worden gezien dan als een zoveelste botte bezuiniging die een flinke groep AOW'ers zal gaan raken.

Criticises the bill as adding to financial strain on over-50s, questions fairness given rising unemployment, and asks whether one-off income should count and whether SVB's hardship-clause advice is adopted.
Does the government consider it reasonable and fair to reduce people's income so sharply in times of rising unemployment, when there are few alternatives to replace income from paid work?

Vindt de regering het redelijk en billijk om in tijden van oplopende werkloosheid het inkomen van mensen zo fors te verlagen, terwijl er weinig alternatieven zijn om het inkomen met betaalde arbeid weer aan te vullen?
Asks whether the phase-out can be softened, whether one-off payments should be excluded, whether the allowance can revive, and how the transition and self-employed incomes are calculated.
These members find that effect unfair and therefore have some questions for the government.
Deze leden vinden dat effect onbillijk en hebben daarom enkele vragen aan de regering.
Asks for the government's motivation given that recipients were long told they would keep the allowance, and for the legal basis and calculation of the reduction and information campaign costs.

How has the government weighed the fact that people in this group have always been told since 1995 that they would be entitled to and keep the AOW partner allowance, and have always planned around it?

Hoe heeft de regering hierin meegewogen dat personen uit de onderhavige doelgroep vanaf 1995 altijd is voorgehouden dat zij recht zouden hebben en houden op een AOW- partnertoeslag, en daar ook altijd mee hebben gerekend?

Warns of cumulative effects of government measures on AOW recipients, questions equal treatment between cohorts with different phase-out periods and the relevant European human rights case law, and asks for an overview of cumulative effects.
These members ask the government why it has chosen this timeline. From the perspective of legal equality, can the government defend such a distinction in time periods?

Deze leden vragen de regering waarom zij voor dit tijdspad heeft gekozen. Is het vanuit het oogpunt van rechtsgelijkheid volgens de regering te verdedigen dat een dergelijk onderscheid in termijnen wordt gehanteerd?

33759.s: The bill amends the Dutch Criminal Code and the Extradition Act to implement the 2010 Beijing Convention and Supplementary Protocol on unlawful acts against civil aviation, extending offences such as endangering aviation and violence at airports. It also adds these offences to extradition and jurisdiction provisions, including a political-motive exception clause.
33759.j: The memorandum justifies the jurisdiction provisions by reference to treaty obligations and the seriousness of the offences, and notes that jurisdictional rules will be placed in a general administrative order.
q: The articles of this law enter into force on a date to be set by royal decree, which may be set differently for different articles or parts of them.
Artikel V De artikelen van deze wet treden in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip, dat voor de verschillende artikelen of onderdelen daarvan verschillend kan worden vastgesteld.
d: entry into force by royal decree, possibly differing per article

parties: Asks the government to clarify whether the terms 'luchtvaartvoertuigen' and 'luchtvaartuigen' are used inconsistently between the bill's title and explanatory memorandum.
These members ask the government to resolve the confusion that has arisen for them and to indicate which term should be regarded as correct.
Deze leden vragen de regering de bij hen ontstane onduidelijkheid weg te nemen en aan te geven welke term als de juiste dient te worden gekenschetst.

Asks what legal remedies exist against extradition when the complaint is politically motivated or false, and how the treaty fits with human rights protections such as against torture or the death penalty.
The aforementioned members ask what the possibilities are for appeal against extradition when the charge and the extradition request are politically motivated or based on a false accusation.
Voornoemde leden vragen wat de mogelijkheden zijn voor beroep op uitlevering wanneer de aanklacht en het verzoek tot uitlevering politiek gemotiveerd zijn of op een valse aanklacht berusten.

33777.s: The bill amends the Electricity Act 1998 to let grid operators apply a volume correction of up to 90% on transport tariffs for large energy-intensive firms meeting set operating-time and consumption thresholds, with the correction applying retroactively in 2014. It also abolishes the separate system-services tariff from 1 January 2015 and folds those costs into the transport tariff, with the ACM setting the methodology for the national high-voltage grid operator.
33777.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for technical operational detail and by the administrative burden of a separate system-services tariff.
q: Detailed rules implementing paragraphs seven through ten are laid down by ministerial regulation.
Bij ministeriële regeling worden nadere regels gesteld ter uitvoering van het zevende tot en met het tiende lid.
d: detailed rules implementing the volume correction (off-peak hours, calculation)
ACM methodology for tariff discount, quality term and volume of transport tariffs
p: Grid operators are given a formula-based discretionary volume correction of up to 90% for large consumers, applied on the basis of statutory thresholds and calculations.
The ACM may retroactively correct tariffs for lost revenues from the 2014 volume correction, with appeal available to the business appeals tribunal.

parties: Asks how the Dutch scheme compares with Germany's and whether the 90 percent maximum can be reached more easily; also notes that the state-aid conclusion is stated but not confirmed by the Commission.
Has the government received this in writing from the European Commission or another EU institution?
Heeft de regering dit zwart-op-wit medegedeeld gekregen van de Europese Commissie of een andere EU-instelling?
Asks whether the correction is justified by grid stability and whether housing corporations face connection-cost barriers to decentralised energy.
Is it correct that this bill complies with EU legal requirements, ask the PvdA members.
Klopt het dat dit wetsvoorstel in overeenstemming is met de Europeesrechtelijke eisen, vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie.
Insists network tariffs must be cost-oriented and asks for a cost-structure analysis and justification of the tariff structure under the polluter-pays principle.
The SP members are of the view that network tariffs must be cost-oriented.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn van mening dat de nettarieven kostengeoriënteerd dienen te zijn.
Does not support the bill; questions its justification, asks whether the ACM was given adequate time for its feasibility review and whether the bill intrudes on the regulator's tariff powers.
These members do not support this bill, as the motives appear insufficiently substantiated.
Deze leden steunen dit wetsvoorstel niet, gelet op het feit dat de beweegredenen onvoldoende onderbouwd lijken
Asks about consequences for business customers and consumers, the relative contribution of large users versus cooperatives, and the effects of retroactive application.
These members value a good competitive position for Dutch industry and employment, and also ask about the relationship between large users, business customers and consumers.

Deze leden hechten aan een goede concurrentiepositie voor de Nederlandse industrie en behoud van werkgelegenheid, zij stellen daarnaast vragen over de verhouding tussen grootverbruikers, zakelijke afnemers en consumenten.
Considers the bill necessary but doubts its effectiveness given restrictive conditions and the complex operating-time calculation, and asks for worked examples and cost figures.
These members consider this bill necessary for keeping Dutch energy-intensive industry, but have doubts about the extent to which it contributes to that.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vinden dit wetsvoorstel noodzakelijk voor het behoud van de Nederlandse energie-intensieve industrie, maar hebben wel hun bedenkingen over in hoeverre dit wetsvoorstel daaraan een bijdrage levert.

Asks whether the scheme is temporary pending EU harmonisation, whether the formula weights match actual grid-stability contributions, and whether it complies with EU non-discrimination and cost-orientation rules.
To what extent are customers rewarded in a fair, non-discriminatory way for their contribution to grid stability through this amendment?
In hoeverre worden afnemers door deze wetswijziging op een eerlijke, non-discriminatoire wijze beloond voor hun bijdrage aan netstabiliteit?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division supports a bill introducing a volume correction on network tariffs for energy-intensive consumers, but asks the explanatory memorandum to better justify the size of the correction under cost-orientation and non-discrimination rules. The minister's reply states the memorandum was supplemented to explain how the correction is shaped, including the concept of operating time, and makes several technical amendments.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for quantified justification of the cost structure of grid management and the cost-efficiency of energy-intensive consumers' stable consumption, which the government addressed by supplementing the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling notes that cost-orientation and non-discrimination requirements under EU rules make it difficult to assess the size of the volume correction, and the government supplemented the memorandum accordingly.

Technical corrections were made, including merging the transport and system service tariff provisions in the Elektriciteitswet 1998 and refining the correction formula so it applies across a full calendar year.

33786.s: The bill abolishes the municipality of Maasdonk and adds its territory to 's-Hertogenbosch and Oss through boundary changes, effective the day after publication in the Staatsblad. It designates 's-Hertogenbosch as the successor for various transitional matters and adjusts court and safety-region boundaries and election timing.
33786.j: The memorandum justifies immediate entry into force to avoid disproportionate disadvantages to the municipalities from delay, not a new executive power.
q: This deviation is permissible, since postponement, given the municipalities' wish for reorganisation as of 1 January 2015, would lead to disproportionate disadvantages for the municipalities.
deze afwijking is geoorloofd, nu uitstel – gelet op de wens van de gemeenten tot herindeling per 1 januari 2015 – zou leiden tot buitensporige nadelen voor de gemeenten.

parties: Supports the merger as requested by the three municipalities and sees no reason for comments or questions.
The bill gives the VVD members no reason to make comments or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
Asks how many households and people are affected by the new boundary and what the consequences are for village ties and associational life in Nuland.
The PvdA members first want to know from the government how many households are located in this area and how many people are involved.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie willen allereerst graag van de regering weten hoeveel huishoudens zich in dit gebied bevinden en hoeveel mensen hierbij betrokken zijn.
Asks why no referendum or representative survey was held and argues that a merger should only proceed if inhabitants in a majority want it.
The PVV is of the view that a merger should only go ahead if it is what the inhabitants of the municipalities concerned want by majority.
De PVV is van mening dat er pas tot herindeling moet worden overgegaan als dit is wat de inwoners van de betreffende gemeenten in meerderheid willen.
Questions the boundary chosen despite many objections, the lack of representative research into public support, and the unexplained financial shortfalls for the receiving municipalities.
The SP members believe it is important to know what the support among inhabitants is and therefore regret that this was not thoroughly researched.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn van mening dat het belangrijk is te weten wat het draagvlak onder de inwoners is en betreuren het om die reden dat dit niet grondig is onderzocht.
Asks why the former Nuland-Geffen boundary was not chosen, given dissatisfaction among some Maasdonk inhabitants with the proposed boundary.
The CDA members ask this question because some inhabitants of Maasdonk appear dissatisfied with the proposed boundary.
De leden van de CDA-fractie stellen deze vraag, omdat er bij een deel van de inwoners van Maasdonk onvrede blijkt te bestaan over het voorgestelde grensbeloop.
Sees a careful procedure but doubts whether the boundary corrections fully meet the wishes of Maasdonk residents, given the departure from pre-1993 boundaries.
They do, however, ask to what extent the boundary corrections included in the proposal during the merger process now fully meet the wishes alive in Maasdonk.
Wel vragen zich af in hoeverre de grenscorrecties die tijdens het herindelingstraject in het voorstel zijn opgenomen, nu volledig tegemoetkomen aan de in de gemeente Maasdonk levende wensen.

33805-III.s: The bill amends the 2013 budget statutes of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King and the Commission for Supervision of the Intelligence and Security Services, adjusting spending by a few thousand euros in supplementary budgets. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 December 2013 with retroactive effect where publication falls later.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2013 to the budget statutes of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King and the Commission for Supervision of the Intelligence and Security Services (III).

Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2013 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken, het Kabinet van de Koning en de Commissie van Toezicht betreffende de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (III).

33849.s: The bill implements the EU Capital Requirements Directive IV and Regulation 575/2013 into the Dutch Wft, tightening prudential rules, capital and liquidity requirements, governance, remuneration, supervision and sanctions for banks and investment firms. It also adds new supervisory powers such as suspending voting rights and banning individuals from functions, plus temporary macroprudential measures by DNB.
33849.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers as necessary to implement the EU directive and regulation and to strengthen financial stability.
q: The directive and regulation aim to strengthen the financial soundness, stability and resilience of banks and investment firms.
De richtlijn en de verordening beogen daarmee te komen tot een versterking van de financiële soliditeit, stabiliteit en weerbaarheid van banken en beleggingsondernemingen.
d: further rules on suspending voting rights
further rules on banning individuals from functions
significance criteria and suitability rules for bank boards
remuneration policy rules by reference to directive
temporary DNB macroprudential rules for up to two years, extendable
publication obligations for banks and investment firms
rules on resolution plans and information
significance and suitability rules for investment firm boards
exemptions from liquidity requirements and annex amendments
exceptions to distribution bans on capital buffers
p: Gives the supervisor power to suspend shareholders' voting rights in a bank or investment firm for infringements, with duration set by the decision itself.
Allows the supervisor to ban natural persons from holding functions in banks and investment firms for up to a year, renewable once.
Lets DNB, in consultation with the Minister, impose temporary stricter prudential rules in case of systemic risk, for up to two years renewable by one year.
Leaves criteria for significance and board suitability to general administrative orders.
Gives DNB discretion to prepare resolution plans, in agreement with the Minister for plans affecting buffers.
Lets DNB set a conduct policy and prohibits distributions and bonuses when capital buffer requirements are not met, with exceptions set by general order.

parties: Asks about lender discretion in buffers, the relationship between DNB and the Minister on macroprudential measures, and whether the ECB will enforce national rules.
What is the reason the government advocates an exceptional position for BNG and NWB?
Wat is de reden dat de regering pleit voor een uitzonderingspositie van BNG en NWB?
Supports higher capital and bonus caps but asks the government to stay critical on leverage ratio impacts and to clarify supervisory competences of the ECB and national supervisors.

These members therefore support the government's ambition to pursue an unweighted capital ratio of at least 4% for Dutch systemically relevant banks, where possible at European level and where necessary nationally.

Deze leden steunen dan ook de ambitie van de regering om waar mogelijk in Europees verband en waar nodig nationaal met een lidstaatoptie binnen het flexibiliteitspakket een ongewogen kapitaalratio van minimaal 4% na te streven voor Nederlandse systeemrelevante banken.
Asks whether parliamentary inquiry committees can receive confidential supervisory information and about fine limits and recidivism.
Is explicit consent from foreign supervisors required before DNB and AFM may provide supervisory-confidential information to a parliamentary inquiry committee, as is the case with the Court of Audit?

Is expliciete toestemming van buitenlandse toezichthouders nodig, voordat DNB en AFM toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie mogen verstrekken aan een parlementaire enquêtecommissie, zoals het geval is bij de Algemene Rekenkamer?
Asks about share issuance enforcement, buffer instruments, and the leverage ratio's effects on lending.
What are the possible consequences of this for the Netherlands and for Dutch banks, and are they positive or negative?
Wat zijn de mogelijke gevolgen hiervan voor Nederland en voor de Nederlandse banken en zijn deze positief of negatief?
Asks about level playing field, the leverage ratio as an absolute minimum, and maatwerk for cooperative credit unions.
To what extent is the Netherlands legally free to impose a higher leverage ratio on the banking sector domestically than the CRR requirements, asks the CDA group?
In hoeverre staat het Nederland juridisch vrij om in eigen land een hogere «leverage ratio» op te leggen aan de bankensector dan de vereisten in CRR, vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie?
Supports higher capital requirements but questions the bonus cap's design, board-composition rules, and whether fines should come before other supervisory measures.
These members ask which measures the supervisor can enforce against a bank before the fine instrument must be used.
Deze leden vragen welke maatregelen de toezichthouder bij een bank kan afdwingen, alvorens het boete-instrument moet worden ingezet.
Supports tighter capital and bonus rules but questions heavy reliance on delegated lower regulation and asks how circumvention of bonus caps will be prevented.

They ask the government whether this is indeed the appropriate route for implementing underlying far-reaching European legislation, especially as important tasks and powers will also move to the ECB in future.

Zij vragen de regering of dit wel de geëigende weg is voor de implementatie van onderliggende ingrijpende Europese wet- en regelgeving, waarbij in de toekomst ook nog eens belangrijke taken en bevoegdheden bij de ECB komen te liggen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division endorsed the bill implementing the EU capital requirements directive and regulation but raised objections on the wording of implementation and enforcement, the lack of a maximum duration for the temporary professional ban, the bonus cap's interference with existing contracts, preventive enforcement thresholds, and the equivalence requirement for third-country banks, advising adaptation. The minister's reply accepts most points: a one-year maximum for the ban, clarification of enforcement, and expansion of the explanatory memorandum, while defending the bonus cap as necessary and proportionate.
concerns: The Council advised clarifying that the parallel solvency and liquidity provisions cannot serve as enforcement basis, and the government clarified enforcement runs via the EU regulation.
The Council found the temporary ban under the new Wft article lacked safeguards such as a maximum duration for proportionality, and the government added a one-year maximum.

The Council asked for an explicit balancing against property rights under ECHR Protocol 1 and Charter Article 17 for the bonus cap, which the government addressed by defending necessity and proportionality in the memorandum.

The Council asked clarification of the 'significant risk' preventive enforcement threshold versus the Awb 'klaarblijkelijk dreigend gevaar' standard, and the government revised the wording and aligned the provisions.
The Council noted overlap between preventive enforcement grounds in article 3:111a and asked for clarification, which the government resolved by merging the criteria.

The Council questioned the burden of proof for equivalence of supervision in third-country banks and the scope of the equivalence requirement, and the government deleted one provision and clarified the explanatory memorandum.

The Council raised the issue of inspection powers for foreign supervisors needing a power to enter premises under Awb 5:15, and the government clarified that DNB-designated persons exercise Awb powers.
The Council made redactional comments and textual suggestions, largely followed by the government.

33867.s: The bill adds statutory fee bases to the Medicines Act, the Blood Supply Act, the Medical Devices Act and the Act on Safety and Quality of Human Tissue, allowing the government to charge applicants and license holders for the costs of administrative handling. The fee amounts and annual charges are to be set by ministerial regulation rather than by general administrative order.
33867.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial-regulation delegation by the need to adjust fees quickly to inflation and cost changes.
q: The ministerial regulation instrument is desirable so that the tariffs for individual activities can be adjusted within a relatively short time to inflation or changes in costs.

Het instrument van de ministeriële regeling is wenselijk om de tarieven voor de afzonderlijke werkzaamheden binnen relatief korte tijd te kunnen aanpassen aan de inflatie of een verandering in de kosten.
d: amounts of fees and annual charge for pharmacy licences
fee amounts for certificates for manufacturers and wholesalers
Artikel II (art. 18 lid 3 Wet inzake bloedvoorziening)
fee amounts and annual charge for blood supply designations and licences
Artikel III B (art. 10g lid 2 Wet op de medische hulpmiddelen)
fee amounts for work and documents under the Medical Devices Act
Artikel IV (art. 13 lid 3 Wet veiligheid en kwaliteit lichaamsmateriaal)
fee amounts and annual charge for recognition
p: Removes the earlier power to set fee rules for medical device licence applications by general administrative order, moving the fee basis into the statute itself.

parties: Asks how the delegation of fee-setting to a ministerial regulation fits existing practice and whether fees charged by CIBG and IGZ are reasonable given no market discipline.
Since stakeholders cannot turn to other bodies than CIBG and IGZ for the same work, it is necessary to consider whether the amount charged is reasonable, as there is no market discipline.

Aangezien de veldpartijen niet voor dezelfde werkzaamheden terecht kunnen bij andere instanties dan het CIBG en de IGZ is het noodzakelijk stil te staan bij de redelijkheid van het in rekening gebrachte bedrag; daar er immers geen sprake is van tucht van de markt.
Accepts full cost recovery in principle but asks whether fees can be raised easily on repeated overruns and whether they will be lowered if costs fall, and whether public funds cover shortfalls.
Can the fee set by ministerial regulation easily be increased in case of repeated overruns?
Kan het per ministeriële regeling vastgestelde tarief makkelijk worden opgehoogd bij herhaalde overschrijding?

Worries that fees set by ministerial regulation undermine legal certainty for citizens and businesses, asks for the principles of the maat houden framework, and questions the broad concept of cost recovery and 'special benefit'.
They also believe citizens and businesses must have a degree of legal certainty regarding the level of fees.
Zij vinden echter ook dat burgers en bedrijven een bepaalde rechtszekerheid moeten hebben als het gaat om de hoogte van de tarieven.
Worries that cost-recovery fees could deter GPs from keeping a pharmacy in shrinking regions and asks whether the government will evaluate the law's effects.
These members are concerned that the costs that may be charged in this context will be so disproportionately high for the GP that they will refrain from keeping a pharmacy.

Deze leden maken zich zorgen dat de kosten die in dit kader in rekening zullen kunnen worden gebracht zulke onevenredig hoge kosten voor de huisarts zullen meebrengen dat deze zal afzien van het houden van een apotheek.

33885.s: The bill amends the 2009 prostitution regulation bill by raising the minimum age for prostitutes to 21, criminalising clients who have sex with prostitutes under 21, and deleting several articles including the municipal registration provisions. It narrows inspectors' powers to enter homes without consent to cases of suspected offences involving under-21s and commercial prostitution, and sets transitional and entry-into-force rules.
33885.j: The memorandum justifies the home-entry power by the necessity requirement and by the need to make oversight of licensed establishments effective, while narrowing the power to offences and commercial prostitution.
q: The power to enter a home without the occupant's consent, for investigation purposes, is limited to situations where prostitution is carried on in the home by one or more persons under 21.

De bevoegdheid tot binnentreden in een woning zonder toestemming van de bewoner wordt in het kader van de opsporing in het eerste lid beperkt tot de situatie dat in de woning prostitutie wordt bedreven door een of meer personen onder de 21 jaar
d: Artikel II / implementing general administrative order referred to in article 24
information obligations for exploiters toward prostitutes
p: Inspectors may enter a home without the occupant's consent in defined circumstances involving prostitution with persons under 21 or commercial prostitution, widening executive access to private homes.
Artikel I, onderdeel J (repeal of article 151a Gemeentewet)
Removes a specific statutory power of municipalities to set rules on prostitutes, relying instead on general municipal regulatory competence.

parties: Doubts whether clients can verify the age of prostitutes in practice, raising privacy and enforceability problems, and asks for a workable verification method.
Without an acceptable enforcement method, this criminalisation is problematic.
Zonder een acceptabele handhavingsmethodiek is deze strafbaarstelling problematisch.
Worries that the dropped registration reduces informing prostitutes of their rights and the monitoring of the sector, and questions the feasibility of the age provisions and transition period.

The PvdA members share the concerns of the College of Procurators-General and the NRM that the opportunity to inform prostitutes of their rights during registration contacts disappears with the dropping of the registration duty.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie delen de zorgen van het College van p-g OM en de NRM dat de mogelijkheid om prostituees tijdens de contactmomenten bij de registratie te informeren over hun rechten, door het vervallen van de registratieplicht, verdwijnt.
Questions the practical enforceability of the age norm, the risk that young prostitutes go underground, and asks for consultation with prostitutes and their organisations.
How realistic is it to expect the prostitute to show her passport or ID in such a way that only the photo and date of birth are visible, as the government suggests?
Hoe realistisch is het om te verwachten dat de prostituee haar paspoort of ID-bewijs zodanig toont dat alleen pasfoto en geboortedatum zichtbaar zijn, zoals de regering suggereert?
Questions whether the bill still forms a coherent whole after dropping registration, and whether municipalities can keep oversight of the sector and the illegal circuit.
Has the original bill not substantially lost strength now that the prostitute registration duty and the related client verification duty have been dropped?

Heeft het oorspronkelijke wetsvoorstel niet substantieel aan kracht ingeboet nu de daarin opgenomen registratieplicht voor prostituees en de daarmee samenhangende vergewisplicht voor klanten zijn geschrapt?

Asks how the government will assess the effects of the age increase on sex workers' position and prevent them disappearing into illegality, and whether entry into homes without consent still requires judicial authorisation.
The D66 members assume that under the adjusted power to enter a home without the occupant's consent, authorisation from the investigating judge or public prosecutor is still required.

De leden van de D66-fractie gaan ervan uit dat bij de aangepaste bevoegdheid tot het binnentreden in een woning zonder toestemming van de bewoner, nog steeds toestemming van de rechter-commissaris of van de officier van justitie nodig is.
Regrets dropping registration and fears greater variation in municipal policy; asks whether municipalities can still introduce their own registration duty under the Municipalities Act.
Can municipalities, on the basis of articles 121 and 149 of the Municipalities Act, still introduce a municipal registration duty?
Kunnen gemeenten op basis van de artikelen 121 en 149 Gemeentewet alsnog een gemeentelijke registratieplicht invoeren?
Finds dropping registration a serious weakening against trafficking and argues for stronger enforcement and a duty for municipalities to help women exit the sector.
With the dropping of the registration duty an effective means disappears both to contact the women involved and to hinder traffickers in quickly moving women to other municipalities.
Het vervallen van de registratieplicht vervalt immers een effectief middel om zowel in contact te komen met de betrokken vrouwen als een middel om mensenhandelaren te belemmeren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill raising the minimum age for prostitution from 18 to 21 and removing the registration obligation, flagging problems with how clients can verify age, the proposed penalty level, a broad power to enter homes without consent, and income effects on 18-to-21-year-old sex workers. The minister's reply largely adopts the advice: clarifies the client's age-verification risk, lowers the penalty to twelve months' detention or a third-category fine, narrows the entry power to suspected offences, and adds a transitional arrangement.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned how a client can verify that a prostitute is over 21 without asking for an identity document, and the government clarified the risk lies with the client and left practical solutions to the parties, adding explanation to the memorandum.

The Afdeling considered the proposed maximum penalty for clients of 18-to-21-year-olds too high given the legal adult status and consensual nature, and the government reduced it to twelve months' detention or a third-category fine and moved the offence to the Penal Code's separate regime.

The Afdeling held that the power to enter homes without consent under Article 12 of the Constitution and Article 8 ECHR needs a demonstrated necessity and should be tied to a suspected offence, and the government now links the power to violations of the stated offences.
The Afdeling noted uncertainty about when the bill takes effect given the phased entry-into-force provision, and the government clarified the timing and the effect on amended provisions.
The Afdeling flagged the sudden loss of income for current 18-to-21-year-old sex workers and advised phased entry into force, which the government adopted via a transitional arrangement.

33940-III.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King and the Oversight Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services by small supplementary amounts, effective from 1 June 2014. It is a routine budgetary adjustment with no new executive powers.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2014 to the budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King and the Oversight Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services.

Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2014 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken, het Kabinet van de Koning en de Commissie van Toezicht betreffende de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten.

33948.s: The bill amends the Dutch Education and Vocational Training Act (WEB) to require vocational institutions to report plans to start or end programmes, to ensure labour-market prospects and efficiency of their programme offerings, and to give prospective students standardized information. It empowers the Minister to withdraw funding or diploma rights for programmes after warnings, advised by an independent advisory committee under ministerial policy rules.
33948.j: The memorandum justifies the Minister's discretionary power to withdraw rights by the state's responsibility for a demand-matched, efficient vocational programme offering, and limits its use with policy rules and a warning procedure.
q: That intervention may ultimately consist of withdrawing the rights, referred to in Article 1.3.1 of the WEB, regarding a vocational programme that an institution provides.
Dat ingrijpen kan ultiem bestaan uit het ontnemen van de rechten, genoemd in artikel 1.3.1 van de WEB, ten aanzien van een beroepsopleiding die een instelling verzorgt.
d: form of reporting planned programme start or end
specifications of student information content and form
ministerial policy rules on withdrawing programme rights
Art. III C (art. 7.2.1a WEB BES), para 2
specifications of student information for Caribbean Netherlands
p: The Minister may withdraw funding and diploma rights from programmes at his discretion, after a warning and with advice from an independent committee, with policy rules to guide the decision.
The Central Bureau of Statistics may publish linked employment data about individual schools and programmes for statistical purposes.

parties: Asks why a separate committee is needed alongside the SBB committee and whether the study leaflet should be mandatory, and how the ministry's system responsibility will be used.
To what extent is a separate committee needed if the SBB already sets up a committee?
In hoeverre is een aparte commissie nodig als de SBB al een commissie instelt.
Supports the duty of care for efficiency but asks how overlap between the advisory committee and the dispute committee is justified and whether the two can be merged.
What considerations justify having both this new advisory committee and the dispute committee set up by SBB exist side by side?
Welke overwegingen rechtvaardigen dat naast elkaar zowel deze nieuwe adviescommissie als de geschillencommissie, die zal worden ingesteld door de SBB, zullen bestaan?
Worries that the 120 million euro cut will harm quality and small programmes, and asks how the balance between expertise and independence of committee members is kept.
These members fear the opposite will be achieved with the proposed cut.
Deze leden vrezen dat het tegendeel zal worden bereikt met de voorgestelde bezuiniging.
Questions whether a national statutory instrument is the right tool given regional differences, and asks why the measures cannot be taken within existing law and self-regulation first.
Together with the Council of State, these members very much doubt whether a bill is the appropriate instrument to reach this goal.
vragen zich ten sterkste af samen met de Raad van State, of een wetsvoorstel het geijkte middel is om dit doel te halen.

Notes the Council of State's critique of the bill's necessity and vague norms, and asks how the advisory and dispute committees relate and why ministerial discretion is set out in policy rules rather than the statute.
Why is this not simply laid down in the law, these members ask.
Waarom wordt dit niet gewoon vastgelegd in de wet, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks for justification of the new rules and burden, the proportionality of the budget cut, and whether pluralism and institutional identity are protected against a monopoly in regions.

Can the government further address the concern that the pursuit of macro-efficiency comes at the expense of pluralism and diversity in regional provision and may lead to a monopoly of one institution in a region, they ask.

Kan de regering nader ingaan op de zorg dat het streven naar macrodoelmatigheid ten koste gaat van pluriformiteit en diversiteit in het regionaal aanbod en mogelijk leidt tot een monopolie van één onderwijsinstelling in een regio, zo vragen zij.
Questions the proportionality of the information duty, the overlap of the new advisory committee with the Inspectorate, and the risk of administrative burden without added value.
These members find it important that new obligations, alongside administrative burden, also clearly add value compared with existing instruments.
Deze leden vinden het belangrijk dat nieuwe verplichtingen naast administratieve belasting ook duidelijk meerwaarde opleveren ten opzichte van de bestaande middelen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the bill on macro-efficiency in vocational education (MBO) is insufficiently justified, adds no substantively new steering rules, and would raise administrative burdens, recommending reconsideration. The government's nader rapport rejects the conclusion on necessity but accepts several specific changes, such as deleting the consultation duty and adding a ministerial notification and publication mechanism.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the necessity of the bill not demonstrated, as it adds no substantively new steering rules to existing duties of care, whereas the government considers the package necessary.

The Afdeling warns that the consultation duty and new rules would cause considerably more administrative burden and that financial cuts could endanger small unique programmes; the government drops the consultation duty and adds measures to protect small programmes.

The Afdeling finds the criteria 'risico op onvoldoende arbeidsmarktperspectief' and 'risico op ondoelmatige verzorging' too vague, and the government addresses this partly by introducing policy rules and an advisory commission.
The Afdeling questions the need for regulation by ministerial regulation for further determining labour-market prospects; the government removes this delegation and replaces it with policy rules.

The Afdeling argues that a consultation duty and a dispute committee are unlikely to resolve competition-driven problems and that the dispute committee's status is unclear; the government keeps the dispute committee as self-regulation and disagrees on the need for the consultation duty to be legislated.
The Afdeling notes the information duty already exists and questions its usefulness; the government maintains it but clarifies the scope and cost estimates.
The Afdeling asks for clarity on the inspectorate's role and enforcement; the government revises the explanatory memorandum to specify the inspectorate's role and the advisory commission's function.

33957.s: The bill amends the Wet bekostiging financieel toezicht to abolish the government contribution to financial supervision costs, shifting costs to supervised firms, and to adjust cost allocation, fee structures and treatment of fines and penalty payments. It also moves large Dutch banks into a separate cost category to fund new European banking supervision by the ECB, and sends penalty revenue above 2.5 million euro per supervisor to the state.
33957.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for technical, annually adjusted fee setting and by the cost-recovery and group-benefit principles of Maat Houden 2014.
q: The amount of the annual fee referred to in the first paragraph is determined on the basis of the criteria laid down in annexes II and III.
De hoogte van een jaarlijks in rekening te brengen bedrag, bedoeld in het eerste lid, wordt bepaald aan de hand van de maatstaven zoals vastgelegd in bijlage II en III.
d: annual fee bandwidths and tariffs per supervisory category
further rules on the fee charged under paragraph 1
further rules on passing on ECB-related supervision costs to banks
p: Joint ministerial regulation sets annual fee bandwidths and tariffs on the supervisor's proposal, taking into account the amounts allocated to each category.

parties: Asks how smaller firms will be spared, how costs are allocated, and how the Council of State's objection to full cost recovery is addressed.
To what extent was the Council of State involved in drafting the revised version?
In hoeverre is de Raad van State betrokken geweest bij het opstellen van de herziene versie?
Asks how the government ensures supervision costs do not grow too fast and whether the Council of State's criticism on publicly borne costs is answered.
How does the government ensure that supervisory costs do not grow too far?
Hoe borgt de regering dat de toezichtkosten niet te ver doorgroeien?
Questions whether supervisors become dependent on the sector and whether the funding model could influence them, and asks who judges unforeseen circumstances justifying budget overruns.
If supervision or supervisors become dependent on the sector itself, can the government explain why it considers the chance of influence through the proposed levy system to be nil?

Als toezicht c.q. toezichthouders afhankelijk worden van de sector zelf, kan de regering dan toelichten waarom zij meent dat de kans op beïnvloeding door het voorgestelde omslagstelsel nihil is, vragen genoemde leden.
Asks why the Council of State's advice on public financing was not followed and how increases in supervision costs can be democratically controlled.
These members also ask the government how it can be prevented that the proposed amendment allows supervision costs to rise without democratic control.
Deze leden vragen de regering ook hoe kan worden voorkomen dat door de voorgestelde wetswijziging de toezichtlasten kunnen stijgen zonder dat daar een – democratische – controle op plaatsvindt
Asks whether the 'in principle' wording allows deviations from cost allocation and percentage shares, and what criteria apply.
The PVV members would like to know whether the phrase 'in principle' implies that deviation is possible.
De leden van de PVV-fractie zouden graag willen weten of de zinsnede «in principe» impliceert dat hiervan afgeweken kan worden.
Asks whether reduced government stake weakens incentives to control costs, and how Parliament can be involved in the budget process and overruns.
Are there additional options to safeguard the risk of expansionary drive at DNB and AFM?
Zijn er additionele mogelijkheden waarmee het risico op expansiedrift van DNB en AFM kan worden geborgd?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against abolishing the government contribution to AFM and DNB financial supervision without adequate justification, arguing supervision serves the public interest and must be partly publicly funded, and advised deleting the retroactive charging of ECB-transfer preparation costs. The Minister's reply largely rejected these points, citing the revised cost-recovery framework, but accepted deleting the charge on branch supervision and reworked the retroactive provision.
concerns: Abolishing the government contribution to financial supervision lacks adequate motivation, and the rapid, thinly justified change undermines stable and consistent legislation.
Group benefit cannot justify fully transferring supervision costs to the financial sector since supervision primarily serves the public interest.
Charging preparatory ECB-transfer costs retroactively is a burdensome measure that the Council advises deleting absent exceptional circumstances.
The charge on branches of EU-passport holders may conflict with EU directives barring additional conditions, requiring explanation in the commentary.
No clear legal basis or allocation criterion exists for charging EU-passport holders not active mainly in the Netherlands.

33975.s: The bill inserts a new article 18b into the Wet werk en bijstand allowing the municipality to reduce social assistance benefits, in stages up to 100 percent, when a claimant is reasonably presumed not to master Dutch sufficiently for work, after a language test. It also extends this to spouses via article 47c, requires evaluation within four years, and sets transitional rules.
33975.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the importance of Dutch for labour market participation and the aim of reducing benefit dependence, and says the rules on the test will be set by general administrative order.
q: The council reduces the assistance, in accordance with paragraphs nine, ten and eleven, if in its judgment there is a reasonable presumption that the claimant does not or insufficiently master the Dutch language.

Het college verlaagt de bijstand, overeenkomstig het negende, tiende en elfde lid, indien naar zijn oordeel een redelijk vermoeden bestaat dat belanghebbende niet of niet in voldoende mate de Nederlandse taal beheerst
d: rules on the Dutch language test (components, method, assessor qualifications, conditions)
p: Allows municipalities to reduce benefits up to full benefit loss on a reasonable presumption of insufficient Dutch, based on discretionary test results, with some exemptions and an evaluation duty.
Extends the benefit reduction to the spouse of the claimant, applied by the Sociale verzekeringsbank.

parties: Asks whether the 1F level matches the Van Nieuwenhuizen bill and what 'any form of blameworthiness' means, which bears on how the hardship clause is applied.
The members of this faction ask the government what is meant by the phrase 'any form of blameworthiness'.
De leden van deze fractie vragen de regering wat er met de zinsnede «elke vorm van verwijtbaarheid» wordt bedoeld.
Worried about proportionality and effects on specific groups, and opposes reversal of the burden of proof; asks for concrete case analysis of possible discriminatory effects.
The members do have questions about the proportionality of this proposal and concerns about its effects on specific groups of people.
Wel hebben de leden vragen over de proportionaliteit van dit voorstel en hebben zij zorgen over de uitwerking voor specifieke groepen mensen.
Questions whether the measure is needed given existing municipal tools and asks about available language education infrastructure and free courses for those who cannot pay.
The government is introducing a further tightening of the WWB that is superfluous, since municipalities already have instruments to get the unemployed to learn Dutch.
Het regering komt met een verdere aanscherping van de WWB 1 die overbodig is, aangezien gemeenten nu al instrumenten in handen hebben om werklozen ertoe te bewegen de Nederlandse taal te leren.
Asks whether the bill gives municipalities individual discretion on language level, blameworthiness and hardship, and about risks of appeal procedures from non-uniform testing.
They point to the risk of objection and appeal procedures in the absence of nationally guaranteed uniformity and validity of the test.
Zij wijzen op het risico van bezwaar en beroepsprocedures bij afwezigheid van het landelijk waarborgen van de uniformiteit en validiteit van de toets.
Asks what discretion municipalities have on reasonable time limits, how benefit reductions are set and whether reductions can be appealed or waived under the hardship clause.
Can the government indicate whether the person concerned can object and appeal if a municipality finds no or insufficient progress?
Kan de regering aangeven of voor de betrokkene bezwaar en beroep openstaat indien een gemeente geen of onvoldoende voortgang constateert?
Doubts the necessity of the bill since existing WWB rules already cover the obligation to acquire needed skills, and questions the ex-ante exemptions and the differing sanction regimes.
These members have doubts about the necessity of this bill.
De genoemde leden hebben twijfels bij de noodzaak van dit wetsvoorstel.

Questions why illiterate native Dutch recipients are exempted while immigrant recipients are not, raising possible discrimination under the Constitution and international treaties, and questions the proportionality of 100 percent reductions.
These members also ask the government for further justification of how this would be compatible with the prohibition of discrimination on grounds of race in Article 1 of the Constitution.
Tevens vragen deze leden de regering om een nadere onderbouwing hoe dit verenigbaar zou zijn met het verbod op discriminatie op grond van ras in artikel 1 Grondwet.
Sees the bill as an obvious elaboration of existing obligations and asks about the level 1F relation to other Dutch-as-second-language exams and availability of courses and test feedback.
They regard the proposal as an obvious elaboration of the obligations already resting on welfare recipients.
Zij beschouwen het voorstel als een voor de hand liggende uitwerking van de verplichtingen die reeds op bijstandsgerechtigden rusten.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the Wet taaleis WWB but advises clarifying the hardship clause, that the language requirement is an inspanningsverplichting, and that the participatiebudget will disappear under the Participatiewet and sociaal deelfonds. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport accepts these points and amends the explanatory memorandum and the bill's wording accordingly.
concerns: The hardship clause (hardheidsclausule) needed clearer explanation of its scope, given EU proportionality law and municipal discretion; the government redrafted the clause into separate subsections.
The language requirement should be explicitly framed as an inspanningsverplichting, and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented to say so.
The participatiebudget will disappear with the Participatiewet and sociaal deelfonds, so the explanatory memorandum had to be adjusted to reflect this.
Several redactional remarks on the wording of articles 18b and 18 were adopted in the bill.

33993.s: The bill moves the assessment of leerwegondersteunend onderwijs (lwoo) and praktijkonderwijs (pro) eligibility from regional referral committees to school-board partnerships (samenwerkingsverbanden) and integrates these forms of education into the passend onderwijs system. It also lets partnerships opt out of national criteria and procedures, adapts funding rules, and sets transitional provisions.
33993.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation as allowing partnerships to experiment and organise support efficiently, and the opting-out as a chance to adapt to local needs.
q: It is up to the partnerships to avoid unnecessary bureaucracy and to shape the allocation of support as efficiently as possible.
Het is aan de samenwerkingsverbanden om geen onnodige bureaucratie te creëren, en de ondersteuningstoewijzing zo efficiënt mogelijk vorm te geven.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 17a, elfde lid)
procedures and criteria for assessing lwoo placement and pro eligibility
Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 17a1, eerste-derde lid)
partnership may set its own lwoo/pro criteria, procedures and duration (opting out)
Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 17a1, vijfde lid)
further rules on the application of opting-out powers
Artikel I, onderdeel G (artikel 85b1, tweede-vierde lid)
per-pupil amounts for lwoo, pro and regional support funding
Artikel I, onderdeel G (artikel 85b1, vierde lid)
rules on determination and payment of regional support funding
Artikel I, onderdeel A (artikel 10e, vierde lid) and B (artikel 10g, vijfde lid)
Artikel I, onderdeel J (artikel 89a1) and K (artikel 89b1)
per-pupil material funding amounts for lwoo and pro
Artikel I, onderdeel O (artikel 118v, eerste lid)
transitional first support plan with lwoo and pro provisions
p: Artikel I, onderdelen A en B (artikel 10e, 10g)
Eligibility decisions move from regional referral committees to school-board partnerships, shifting assessment power to local bodies rather than a national committee.
Partnerships may set their own criteria, procedures and duration for lwoo and pro placement, departing from national rules, with consent of school boards only.
Artikel I, onderdeel O (artikel 118y, 118v) and Artikel I, onderdeel H
The appeal procedure before the commission for disputes is suspended for the first support plan, limiting a route of review for parents and schools.

parties: Asks about causes of learning delays, school positioning across cooperation bodies, and how the Inspectie can supervise use of care funds after opting out.
They ask what the cause of this is.
Zij vragen wat de oorzaak hiervan is.
Worries that opting out and dropping national criteria in 2018 could undermine quality and access to practical education.
Given the government letter of 19 September 2014 speaking of dropping national criteria in 2018, the members have become even more worried.
Gelet op de brief van de regering van 19 september 2014 8 , waarin gesproken wordt over het loslaten van landelijke criteria in 2018, zijn de leden nog bezorgder geworden.
Questions whether care is guaranteed under opting out and whether funds placed with cooperation bodies will actually support these pupils.
Can the government dispel the concern that the money will not be used for supporting these pupils if funding runs through the cooperation bodies?
Kan de regering de zorg wegnemen dat het geld niet gebruikt zal worden voor de ondersteuning van deze leerlingen, als de financiering gaat lopen via de samenwerkingsverbanden?
Asks for guarantees of expertise and independent advice in allocating lwoo and pro, possibly in the AMvB.
Seeks clarification on whether budgets for light and heavy support may be mixed.
Can the government indicate whether this picture is correct, these members ask.
Kan de regering aangeven of dit beeld klopt, zo vragen deze leden.
Objects that separating indication from funding lets budget shape placement decisions, and asks how expert placement is ensured.
Is it not vitally important for pupils' futures that the best-fitting place is determined on the basis of expertise, without the budget being a deciding factor?

Is het niet juist van groot belang voor de toekomst van leerlingen dat op basis van deskundigheid de best passende plek voor een leerling wordt bepaald, zonder het budget als bepalende factor te laten meewegen?
Supports ending the separate framework but asks how existing expertise and quality frameworks are preserved in the new allocation system.
They ask whether safeguards have been included, for example a quality framework, ensuring adequate personnel are deployed.
Zij vragen of waarborgen zijn opgenomen, bijvoorbeeld een kwaliteitskader, waarmee voorzien is in de inzet van adequate personen.

34479.s: The bill amends Book 5 of the Dutch Civil Code to clarify and strengthen owners' associations (VvE) by requiring a minimum annual reserve contribution for maintenance and by expressly allowing associations to take out loans. It also divides liability for such loans among apartment owners and successors, with transitional rules for existing associations.
34479.j: The memorandum justifies the minimum reserve and the loan power as necessary to guarantee adequate maintenance and to clarify the existing concept of 'beheer', without removing existing powers.
q: To guarantee sufficient maintenance and to support VvE board members and members who wish to reserve adequately, it is therefore necessary to make a lower limit on the annual contribution to the reserve fund mandatory.

Om voldoende onderhoud te kunnen waarborgen en om VvE-bestuurders en VvE-leden die wel voldoende willen reserveren te ondersteunen, is het daarom noodzakelijk dat een ondergrens aan de jaarlijkse afdracht in het reservefonds verplicht wordt.

parties: Asks whether owners retain freedom to deviate from the reserve obligation by mutual agreement and who may enforce the new article, and asks about tax and bank implications.
The VVD members understand the need to reserve, but attach importance to owners' freedom to deviate from the obligation by mutual agreement.
De leden van de VVD-fractie begrijpen de noodzaak van reserveren, maar hechten aan de vrijheid van eigenaren om in goed overleg af te wijken van de verplichting daartoe.

Supports the borrowing clarification and the reserve norm, but questions whether guarantees give the VvE real control over reserves and asks about box 3 taxation and whether municipalities can use the norm.
The PvdA members consider it important that the VvE can dispose of its reserves in full freedom and therefore doubt the desirability of reserving through guarantees.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vinden het van belang dat de VvE juist in alle vrijheid moet kunnen beschikken over de reserves en twijfelt daarom aan de wenselijkheid van reserveren door middel van garanties.
Asks how non-functioning and dormant VvE's and missing board members will be dealt with, how the rules are enforced since 2008, and what the government expects in effect.
The SP members ask how many of the 121,000 VvE's have no reserve fund although this is mandatory.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen hoeveel van de in totaal 121.000 VvE's geen reservefonds hebben terwijl dit wel verplicht is.
Asks about professionalisation of VvE managers, follow-up to the Companen report, and the financial burden on apartment owners, including box 3 taxation of reserve shares.
These members point out that this tax levy has long been a problem because the share in a VvE's assets is not freely disposable income.
Deze leden wijzen erop dat deze belastingheffing al jaren een probleem is, omdat het aandeel in het vermogen van een VvE geen vrij besteedbaar inkomen is.
Questions whether a mandatory minimum reserve is necessary when better information or a non-statutory norm could work, and argues it may force owners to save more than homeowners outside a VvE.
Does the government share the view that reserving a mandatory amount within the VvE reserve fund in effect forces members to reserve more than homeowners in comparable circumstances outside a VvE?

Deelt de regering de mening dat het reserveren van een verplicht bedrag binnen het reservefonds van de VvE in feite de leden dwingt meer te reserveren dan huiseigenaren in vergelijkbare omstandigheden
Argues the reserve norm and borrowing power infringe property rights and create liability risks for owners, and that the burden on small VvE's outweighs the benefit.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises the bill to be sent to parliament after taking its remarks into account, but asks for better justification of the effectiveness of the mandatory minimum reserve fund and of the clarified borrowing powers for owners' associations. The government's reply addresses enforcement concerns by proposing a concrete norm and guidance, rejects the cap on reserve contributions, and adopts the redactional remarks.
concerns: The Council questions whether the mandatory minimum reserve will be complied with, given existing unmet obligations and absent enforcement provisions, and asks for reasoned justification of its effectiveness.
The Council finds the expected effect of clarifying and expanding VvE borrowing powers insufficiently motivated given banks' reluctance and lack of security.
The Council suggests capping the reserve obligation linked to rebuilding value, which the government declines because VvEs can choose their own percentage and a maintenance plan is preferred.
The Council makes redactional remarks on article 5:126 and the citation title in article II, which the government adopts.

34485-V.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, adjusting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros as part of the spring memorandum. It sets the effective date of the amendment as 1 June 2016 with retroactive effect where publication falls later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V)

34497.s: The bill sets higher per-unit rates for the sustainable energy levy (opslag duurzame energie) on electricity and natural gas for 2017, raising the amounts for several consumer and business categories. It also departs from the usual entry-into-force rule under the Consultative Referendum Act so the change applies from 1 January 2017.
34497.j: The memorandum justifies the departure from the Consultative Referendum Act's entry-into-force period by the need to align business levy distribution with the Tax Plan 2016, but it does not justify any delegation or new executive power.
q: For this reason the bill provides for the possibility of deviating from the Consultative Referendum Act.
Om deze reden is in het wetsvoorstel voorzien in de mogelijkheid om af te wijken van de Wet raadgevend referendum.

parties: Asks why the government wants to study merging the surcharge with the energy tax, when results are expected, and whether effects on citizens' and businesses' costs will be central.
The VVD members ask why the government wishes to study that.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen waarom de regering de wens heeft om dat te onderzoeken.
Asks how the budget reserve funds are legally bound, how earmarking for renewable energy after 2017 is guaranteed, and when the SDE+ evaluation reaches parliament.
To what extent are the funds in the renewable energy budget reserve legally bound?
In hoeverre zijn de middelen in de begrotingsreserve duurzame energie juridisch gebonden?
Questions the timing of the bill before the SDE+ evaluation, the tariff calculations, and the burden on households, and asks why the bill is not handled with the evaluation included.
They ask whether the proposed tariffs were only set to match the ex ante expenditure for 2017 for the SDE+.
Zij vragen zich af of de voorgestelde tarieven slechts zijn ingegeven om te komen tot de ex ante uitgaven voor 2017 voor de SDE+.
Asks how the Chamber can verify that surcharge revenues are used only for renewable energy, requests an itemised breakdown of the budget reserve, and questions the growing reserve.
How can the Chamber check that funds raised through the renewable energy surcharge are used only to finance the promotion of renewable energy?
Hoe kan de Kamer controleren dat middelen geheven met de opslag duurzame energie enkel voor de financiering van de stimulering van duurzame energie gebruikt wordt
Opposes subsidising renewable energy, asks for forecasts of future tariffs for 2018-2023 and explanations for revenue shortfalls and tariff increases.
These members therefore urgently request the government to give the Chamber insight into the estimated SDE+ surcharge tariffs for 2018 through 2023.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering dan ook met klem om de Kamer inzicht te geven in de geraamde tarieven voor de SDE+-opslag voor de jaren 2018 tot en met 2023.
Doubts whether the transparency goal was achieved, requests detailed tables of revenues, expenditures and tariffs per band, and asks whether the budget reserve plays a role in the tariff decision.

Supports investment in the energy transition but asks why the law must be adopted before the evaluations, questions the Chamber's room to amend the bill and its budget right, and asks why tariffs rise while large sums sit unspent.
Does it not fit the Chamber's budgetary right to have room to make changes when adopting this law and to include the evaluations?
Past het niet bij het budgetrecht van de Kamer om de ruimte hebben om bij de vaststelling van deze wet nog wijzigingen aan te brengen en de evaluaties te kunnen betrekken?
Asks how the government can guarantee that surcharge money remains available for renewable energy after the budget reserve is emptied, and raises the burden on low-income households.
They therefore would like to hear how the government can guarantee that the money coming in through the energy bill surcharge remains guaranteed available for renewable energy production.
Zij horen daarom graag hoe de regering kan garanderen dat het geld dat via de opslag op de energierekening binnenkomt gegarandeerd beschikbaar blijft voor duurzame energieproductie.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises sending the bill setting 2017 tariffs under the Wet opslag duurzame energie to parliament, but asks the government to better justify fixing 2017 tariffs before the planned 2016 SDE+ and Energieakkoord evaluations. In its nader rapport the minister accepts the point, adds discussion of the evaluations to the explanatory memorandum, and notes that the evaluation will not affect 2017 cash expenditure because it is tied to already issued decisions.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should justify setting 2017 tariffs before the announced SDE+ and Energieakkoord evaluations are completed.

34578.s: The bill amends the Participatiewet, the Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen, the Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein and the Ziektewet to tighten how municipalities provide sheltered work (beschut werk) and banenafspraak placements for people who cannot earn the minimum wage. It requires municipalities to offer sheltered jobs when UWV advises it, lets ministerial regulation set per-municipality job targets, and lets the municipal council add further places by ordinance.
34578.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial powers and the minister's instruction power (aanwijzing) by the need to guarantee the statutory provision of sheltered work despite the decentralised system, and notes that interbestuurlijk toezicht may be used.
q: With this amendment, failing to offer sheltered work where it is required is a serious shortcoming in the lawful implementation of the Participatiewet.
Met de onderhavige wetswijziging is het niet aanbieden van beschut werk waar dat wel geboden is, een ernstige tekortkoming in de rechtmatige uitvoering van de Participatiewet.
d: rules for UWV assessment of sheltered-work eligibility
annual minimum number of sheltered jobs per municipality
municipal council sets additional sheltered jobs and allocation order by ordinance
p: Eligibility for sheltered work is decided on UWV advice, which the municipality must follow except where the advice is defective, narrowing municipal discretion.
The minister may set binding per-municipality placement targets by ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks whether municipalities remain free in how they fill sheltered workplaces and how the simultaneous entry into force of the measures will be ensured.

How does she ensure, given the difference between the date of consideration and entry into force, that the proposed changes take effect simultaneously and that their implementation also starts simultaneously?

Hoe borgt zij dan, gelet op het verschil tussen de behandeldatum en de inwerkingtreding, dat de voorgestelde wijzigingen gelijktijdig in werking treden en ook de uitvoering hiervan gelijktijdig ingaat?
Asks whether the financial risks for municipalities of UWV-determined numbers are acceptable and what happens if costs turn out higher.
To what extent does this create the risk that individual municipalities are confronted afterwards with lower or higher costs than they accounted for in advance?
In hoeverre leidt dit tot het risico dat individuele gemeenten achteraf met lagere of hogere kosten geconfronteerd worden dan waarmee vooraf door hun is rekening gehouden?
Questions the adequacy of funding for municipalities, the 33-year timeframe with long waiting times, and possible unequal treatment of people left out when municipal quotas are met.

Is it correct that people may be left out because municipalities have already realised the maximum number of sheltered workplaces imposed by central government and have not included additional places or funding in the municipal ordinance?
