Klopt het dat er mensen buiten de boot kunnen vallen omdat gemeenten al het maximaal door het rijk opgelegde beschutte werkplekken hebben gerealiseerd en geen aanvullende plekken en/of financiering in de gemeentelijke verordening hebben opgenomen?
Objects that the obligation infringes on municipal policy freedom contrary to the decentralisation logic of the Participatiewet and ignores practical problems such as financial risks.
The proposal infringes on the policy freedom of municipalities.
Het voorstel maakt inbreuk op de beleidsvrijheid van gemeenten.
Questions whether a direct obligation reverses the intended decentralisation, notes the Raad van State's view, and flags possible appeal and objection procedures for people left out.
Does the government not consider it somewhat premature to move directly to an obligation?
Acht de regering het niet wat prematuur direct tot een verplichting over te gaan?

Welcomes the practice route and accepts an obligation under conditions, but asks for the government's weighing in light of the Raad van State's sharp criticism and tension between rights of individuals and municipal discretion.
Can it give the ChristenUnie members more insight into the weighing made on this point, also in light of the Raad van State's strong criticism of this point?
Kan zij de leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie wat meer inzicht geven in de afweging die op dat punt is gemaakt, ook in het licht van de forse kritiek van de Raad van State op dit punt?

Questions the fundamental change of course before any integral evaluation, the justification for the 30,000 target not anchored in the law, and the broad discretion left to municipalities that may amount to gross carelessness by the legislature.

They ask whether there is not gross negligence on the part of the legislature when, despite the evident intention regarding sheltered work, so much room is given to municipalities to deviate from that intention.

Zij vragen of niet van een grove onachtzaamheid van de wetgever sprake is wanneer in weerwil van de klaarblijkelijke bedoeling inzake beschut werk zoveel ruimte wordt geboden aan gemeenten om van deze bedoeling af te wijken.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against imposing a mandatory beschut werk (sheltered work) obligation on municipalities, citing insufficient need for unilateral intervention, neglect of municipal practice problems, the employment-contract requirement, cost coverage and an individually enforceable right. The government's reply largely rejects these objections, defending the obligation as necessary and promising to examine specific grounds for terminating employment and adjustments on cost coverage.
concerns: The Afdeling is not convinced of the necessity of unilaterally intervening in municipal practice to impose the sheltered work obligation, which the government rejects given the deliberate non-provision by over a quarter of municipalities.
Imposing the obligation infringes on the policy freedom and decentralisation principles of the social domain, which the government counters by pointing to a persistent gap in provision.

The employment-contract requirement is experienced as a obstacle by municipalities and the bill ignores these problems, prompting the government to examine specific grounds for terminating employment.
Creating an individually enforceable right to sheltered work is impossible for municipalities to guarantee, which the government does not accept as a reason to change the bill.
Cost coverage under Financiële-verhoudingswet article 2 is not shown to be complete, and the government defends the funding as sufficient while promising further attention.

34596.s: The bill harmonises the rules for childcare centres and playgroups by folding the playgroup chapter of the Wet kinderopvang en kwaliteitseisen peuterspeelzalen into the Wet kinderopvang, so former playgroups become registered childcare centres under the national childcare register. It adds transitional provisions letting the college withdraw or re-issue operating permits after a supervisor inspection, and amends several related statutes.
34596.j: The memorandum justifies the new and transitional powers mainly as necessary to harmonise regulation and ensure timely inspection and transition of former playgroups.
q: After adoption of this bill, chapter 2 lapses and article 1.52 will also apply to current playgroup care.
Na aanvaarding van dit wetsvoorstel vervalt hoofdstuk 2 en zal artikel 1.52 ook voor het huidige peuterspeelzaalwerk gelden.
d: I (Art. 1.68 Wet kinderopvang, deleted) and Art. 1.6/1.7/1.8/1.50/1.56/1.87 references in Art. 3.4
detailed childcare quality and registration rules
Art. 3.2 (ministerial regulation on screening data transfer and fee timing)
timing of personal register entries and fee exemption
rules on data and information supplied to the minister
application of chapter 1 rules to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba
p: Art. 1.45 (new sixth paragraph) and Art. 1.46 in combination with Art. 2.3 transitional provisions
Makes the general administrative law procedure part for permit applications inapplicable under the Dienstenwet exception, limiting a procedural protection for applicants.
Art. XXVI Overgangsbepaling beschikking toestemming tot exploitatie
Lets the college withdraw existing operating permits and remove centres from the register after an inspection, without a fresh full assessment of former playgroups beforehand.
Art. XVIII Overgangsbepaling nadere onderzoeken toezichthouder
Keeps the supervisor's power to conduct follow-up investigations for shortcomings found before the bill takes effect.
Requires the minister to report to parliament within three years on effectiveness of the bill.

parties: Asks whether harmonised financing undermines parental choice between childcare and playgroups and asks for justification of necessity.
The VVD members want to ask the government whether equalising the financing of pre-school provision does not stand in the way of parents' freedom of choice in the form of care.

Achtergrond en aanleiding De leden van de VVD-fractie willen de regering vragen of het gelijktrekken van de financiering van voorschoolse voorzieningen de keuzevrijheid van ouders in de vorm van opvang niet in de weg staat.
Asks about financial accessibility for non-working parents and whether the bill risks segregation.
These members also ask how this bill relates to the financial accessibility of pre-school provision for non-working parents.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen ook hoe dit wetsvoorstel zich verhoudt tot de financiële toegankelijkheid van voorschoolse voorzieningen voor niet-werkende ouders.
Asks how municipalities can fit centrally regulated childcare into local provision and whether tailoring remains possible.

The SP members ask how, at a time when responsibility for care and welfare increasingly lies with municipalities, municipalities can be enabled to fit centrally regulated childcare facilities into local provision.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen hoe, in een tijd dat de verantwoordelijkheid voor zorg en welzijn steeds meer bij gemeenten komt te liggen, gemeenten in staat worden gesteld om met het centraal regelen van opvangvoorzieningen voor kinderen die voorzieningen in te passen in het lokale aanbod.
Opposes a comprehensive provision and worries the bill reduces municipalities' steering room and ability to tailor local provision.
The CDA members fear that with this bill, delivering tailored provision for pre-school education in particular becomes harder for municipalities.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn bang dat met dit wetsvoorstel met name het leveren van maatwerk in het kader van de voorschoolse educatie lastiger wordt voor gemeenten.
Supports a level playing field but asks whether municipalities keep enough steering powers for education-lag policy and why no universal provision is pursued.
Can the government explain whether, with this change, municipalities still have sufficient steering powers to implement education-disadvantage policy?
Kan de regering toelichten of gemeenten met deze wijziging nog voldoende sturingsmogelijkheden hebben om het onderwijsachterstandbeleid uit te voeren?
Objects to the childcare allowance tied to paid work, questions the justification for distinguishing working parents, and asks for evidence behind the policy's assumptions.
The SGP members missed in the explanatory memorandum a definition of the term working parents and a clear justification for the distinction between so-called working and non-working parents.

De leden van de SGP-fractie hebben in de toelichting een definitie van het begrip werkende ouders gemist alsmede een duidelijke rechtvaardiging van het onderscheid tussen zogenaamde werkende en niet-werkende ouders.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised against sending the bill (harmonising childcare and playgroup rules and financing) to parliament without revisions, citing unclear need, weak motivation for equalising financing, and insufficient municipal steering and funding. The minister's reply largely disagrees, arguing the harmonisation aligns with existing practice and agreements with the VNG, while adding clarifications and technical amendments.
concerns: The Council found the need for harmonising financing alongside quality rules insufficiently motivated; the government explained the equal-treatment rationale but largely maintained the bill.

The Council found the bill a step toward a universal provision the government did not intend, and that its timing was unexplained; the government clarified the relation to the SER and Onderwijsraad advice.
Municipalities' steering room and independence in early childhood provision and education-disadvantage policy would be reduced; the government argued steering remains possible.
Insufficient analysis of cost increases and whether the allocated funds suffice for municipal supply for children without childcare allowance; the government added explanation on funding flows.
Technical adjustments were made on transitional provisions, the lex silencio positivo exclusion, and cross-references to other laws.

34620-IV.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget statements for Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES fund (H) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts per budget article. It takes effect on 1 December 2016, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES fund for the year 2016.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) en het BES-fonds voor het jaar 2016.

34620-VI.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget (second supplementary budget) of the Ministry of Security and Justice, both the departmental budget statement and the statement for its executive agencies. It changes appropriations and revenues across policy and non-policy articles, adjusting spending on police, legal aid, the judiciary and prisons.
q: We ... have found it necessary to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie

34677.s: The bill strengthens governance of audit firms that perform statutory audits of public-interest entities by requiring suitability tests for daily policymakers and internal supervisory bodies, mandatory independent internal supervision, and sharing of AFM inspection findings with audit committees. It also expands AFM information-sharing powers with other Dutch enforcement and intelligence bodies, and restricts the executive board of a client from appointing the auditor.
34677.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the public-interest importance of audits and by poor AFM inspection results, and notes that routine technical rules are left to a general administrative order.
d: procedures and data for reporting changes in suitable persons
rules on independent internal supervision structure and information duties
Artikel I, F (art. 22a, lid 7 sub d Wta)
additional tasks and powers of internal supervisory body
p: AFM may grant exemptions from the requirement that a majority of supervisory body members be independent, subject to conditions and revocation.
AFM may share confidential information with intelligence, tax, police and prosecution bodies where useful for market integrity, subject to purpose and safeguard limits.
The client's executive board loses primary power to appoint the auditor and is only competent if no supervisory board exists.

parties: Asks how the AFM will shape the open suitability norm, whether suitability is retested, and how compliance costs will be prevented from being passed on to clients.
In what way will both the individual and collective suitability of the persons who determine the daily policy of the institution or organisation be tested?
Op welke wijze wordt zowel de individuele als de collectieve geschiktheid van de personen die dagelijks beleid van de instelling of organisatie bepalen getoetst?
Supports the bill but asks about evaluation criteria, the treatment of small housing corporations, the oath, and whether the audit committee can request extra information.
Does the government intend to evaluate this legislation and, if so, what criterion will the government use to consider the legislation sufficient?
Is de regering voornemens om onderhavige wetgeving te evalueren en zo ja, wat is dan voor de regering het criterium om de wetgeving als voldoende te beschouwen?
Questions the use of an open suitability norm instead of statutory main lines as the Council of State advised, and asks how the AFM's policy rules and appeal arrangements will work.
Why is it not chosen, in line with the advice of the Council of State, to anchor the main lines in rules and an AMvB, after which the AFM can further elaborate the rules through policy rules?
Waarom wordt er niet voor gekozen om, conform het advies van de Raad van State, de hoofdlijnen in regels en amvb te verankeren, waarna de AFM de regels verder kan inkleuren middels beleidsregels?

Views the measures as steps in the right direction but doubts they are enough, warns the bill may create a false sense of firmness while the financial dependence of auditors on clients is untouched, and asks about the audit business model and public-sector oversight.
The SP members are concerned that this bill unintentionally fails to address the core of the problem, namely that a financial dependence exists as long as the auditor is paid by the party he audits.

De leden van de SP-fractie zijn er bezorgd over dat er onbedoeld via dit wetsvoorstel wordt vergeten in te grijpen op de kern van het probleem, namelijk dat er een financiële afhankelijkheid bestaat zolang de accountant wordt betaald door degene die hij controleert.

Strongly supports the bill and asks how the general meeting or supervisory board will actually make an independent choice of auditor, the status of implementation, and how cross-border dagelijks beleidsbepalers are covered.
In what way is it ensured that the general meeting or the supervisory board can actually make an independent choice?
Op welke manier wordt ervoor gezorgd dat de algemene vergadering of de Raad van Commissarissen ook daadwerkelijk een onafhankelijke keuze kan maken?

Asks about proportionality of remediation duties, the sharing of findings with the audit committee and shareholders, the extension of the disciplinary limitation period, and the reach of the appeal and information-sharing rules.
What does the government think of the possibility that in serious cases the findings must also be shared with the general meeting of shareholders?
Wat vindt de regering van de mogelijkheid dat bij ernstige gevallen de bevindingen ook met de algemene vergadering van aandeelhouders (AvA) gedeeld moeten worden?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the Wet aanvullende maatregelen accountantsorganisaties, raising major objections to the open fitness-test norm, the internal supervision regime (appointment, suspension and dismissal of daily policymakers), and the broad sharing of confidential information with other authorities, and advised adaptation before proceeding. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, adopting binding nomination by the supervisory body, minimum board size, a statutory basis for information sharing with conditions, and a more limited scope, while noting some points on the fitness test were addressed by AFM guidance.
concerns: The open fitness-test norm left to AFM guidance is insufficiently knowable and foreseeable, and the council advised laying down main lines in law and, where needed, in an AMvB; the government kept the open norm and pointed to an AFM policy rule.

Detailed rules on the powers and structure of internal supervision should be set in law, with subdelegation limited to technical elaboration; the government added statutory provisions on tasks, composition and independence.

Appointment, suspension and dismissal of daily policymakers by the internal supervisory body needs substantive justification given the disruption of owners' relationship with the firm; the government adopted binding nomination but gave less detailed reasoning for the rest.

Sharing of confidential audit-file information with other supervisors risks undermining the trust between auditors and audited entities and should be limited to situations where financial-sector integrity is at stake; the government narrowed the provision accordingly.
Scope of Article 12c reference to Article 16 Wta should be limited so that third-country policymakers are not subject to fitness testing; the government adopted this.

34767.s: The bill introduces a mandatory pre-start notification for new care providers, requiring them to report to the Minister before providing care, with information on care type, organisation and quality conditions. It also replaces the existing WTZi licensing regime with a new toelatingsvergunning for institutions providing medical specialist care or employing more than ten care workers, adding governance and quality checks, and grants the health inspectorate new fine and order powers.
34767.j: The memorandum justifies the notification duty and new licensing as necessary to make inspection of new providers effective and to ensure providers know quality requirements before starting care.
q: This bill therefore introduces a notification duty for all new providers of care as defined in the Quality, Complaints and Disputes in Healthcare Act.
Dit wetsvoorstel voorziet daarom in een meldplicht voor alle nieuwe aanbieders van zorg als bedoeld in de Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg.
d: electronic notification method and data categories for care provider notification
exempting categories of care providers from notification duty
further governance requirements for care providers
exempting categories of care providers from governance requirements
application procedure and documents for licence
exempting categories of care providers from licence requirement
quality standard requirement for certain categories of providers
categories and cases requiring certificate of conduct (VOG)
administrative fines set by minister for notification and licence breaches
p: The minister may refuse or revoke licences based on certificates of conduct and Bibob integrity assessments, widening discretion over who may provide care, subject to general administrative law review.
The minister may share provider data with insurers and process criminal personal data for licence decisions.
The inspectorate gains power to impose penalty orders and administrative fines on care providers, reviewable by the administrative courts.

parties: Asks how the ten-caregiver threshold is counted and whether governance requirements scale with size, and asks about accreditation of healthcare board members.
These members support the premise that for larger institutions good governance plays a greater role in the quality of care.
Deze leden ondersteunen het uitgangspunt dat bij grotere instellingen het belang van goede governance voor de kwaliteit van zorg een grotere rol speelt.
Supports stricter oversight but fears the ten-caregiver threshold invites fraud via subcontractors, and asks for a certificate of good conduct (VOG) in licensing.
The members ask, however, whether the threshold of ten caregivers is not susceptible to fraud.
De leden vragen echter of de grens van tien zorgverleners niet fraudegevoelig is.
Asks for justification of the renewed licensing requirement and the notification duty, whether it adds regulatory burden, and how enforcement via administrative fines is chosen.
These members also ask for further justification of the need for a renewed licensing procedure.
Deze leden vragen tevens een nadere onderbouwing van de noodzaak om tot een vernieuwde vergunningsprocedure te komen.
Asks why the Council of State's view on delimiting the notification duty by care type rather than by funding framework was not followed, and why delegated regulation is used for some points.
Why was it chosen to make the statutory insurance or provision framework central, and not the nature of the act?
Waarom is er voor gekozen het wettelijke verzekerings- of voorzieningenkader centraal te stellen, en niet de aard van de verrichting?
Welcomes the notification and licensing duties but asks that refusing licences after mergers or changes in legal form be re-examined and questions the proportionality for small providers.
The GroenLinks members therefore ask the government why care providers that merge or choose another legal form are excluded from the licensing procedure.
Daarom vragen de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie de regering waarom zorgaanbieders die fuseren of een andere rechtsvorm kiezen uit te sluiten van de vergunningsprocedure.

Doubts the notification duty will be effective, fears questionnaires can be gamed with lawyers, questions IGZ capacity and the exclusion of subcontractors and Wmo/Jeugdwet providers, and asks about fraud-tainted founders.
They fear that the notification duty threatens to become a paper fig leaf.
Zij vrezen ervoor dat de meldplicht een papieren wassen neus dreigt te worden.

Asks how existing providers will be brought under risk-based IGJ supervision, why a ministerial regulation rather than an AMvB is used, and whether small providers face lighter governance requirements.

These members ask the government whether this ministerial regulation is already in preparation and whether it can already indicate which forms of medical specialist care are intended to require a licence.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering of deze ministeriële regeling reeds in voorbereiding is en of zij al kan aangeven welke vormen van medisch specialistische zorg beoogd vergunningsplichtig zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against the third amendment to the Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders, criticising the extension of the notification duty to subcontractors and youth-care providers and of financial transparency requirements to all care providers as adding little value while raising administrative burden, and noting unclear exemptions and forthcoming further measures. The minister's reply defends the extensions as necessary to strengthen IGJ and NZa information positions, accepts the need for justification of the administrative burden, and adds clarifications on exemptions and the relation to later proposals.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the added value of extending the notification duty to subcontractors and youth-care providers given that IGJ supervision targets the main contractor, and the government maintains the duty is necessary for effective supervision.

The Afdeling finds the extended financial transparency requirements unjustified given the administrative burden and unchanged NZa supervision approach; the government contests this but accepts that proportionality must guide exemptions.

The Afdeling notes that unclear exemption categories in forthcoming AMvB's prevent assessment of necessity, effectiveness and feasibility, and asks for clarity; the government added indicative categories to the explanatory notes.
The Afdeling questions whether the amendments should be considered together with announced further measures given foreseeability and consistency concerns for providers.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on 2 May 2017 against sending the Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders bill to parliament until remarks were addressed, mainly objecting that the notification duty's scope, tied to the Wkkgz, is not suitable or meaningful and that key elements were delegated to lower regulation. The Minister's reply of 29 August 2017 accepted most remarks, clarifying scope, adding statutory elements and exemptions, while defending a broad notification duty and retaining some flexibility via administrative orders.
concerns: The scope of the notification duty, tied to the Wkkgz definition of care, is not suitable or meaningful for the intended targeting of quality risks; the government defended the broad scope while adding possible exemptions by administrative order.
The bill's text does not express that the duty excludes providers acting solely under the Wmo 2015 or Jeugdwet; the government declined to change this now, pointing to a later Wkkgz evaluation.

Main elements such as notification data, governance requirements and quality standards were delegated to lower regulation; the bill now sets these elements at statutory level and specifies exemption categories.
Concern about the IGZ's capacity to supervise the large group of notifying providers; the government responded that the notification improves risk-based supervision without extending the IGZ's tasks.

34775-IIB.s: This bill sets the 2018 budget for the other High Colleges of State (Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman), the Governors' cabinets of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and the Kiesraad, in thousands of euros. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no change to the powers or oversight of these bodies.
q: Article 1: The budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2018 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

34785.s: The bill sets the 2018 tax parameters for income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, gaming tax, VAT, environmental taxes and collection rules, including a new 10% partner-departure rule in the income-dependent schemes act. It also adds a pledge-holder liability for VAT and adjusts several tariffs, with some changes taking effect later by royal decree or ministerial regulation.
34785.j: The memorandum justifies the ILT decision and ministerial regulation powers as needed because the Tax Authority lacks the environmental expertise to verify waste quantities and treatment abroad.
q: The background to this design is that the Tax Authority lacks the environmental expertise to assess the quantities and treatment methods reported by the notifier for plausibility.
Achtergrond van deze opzet is, dat de Belastingdienst niet beschikt over de milieuexpertise om de door de kennisgever opgegeven hoeveelheden en verwerkingswijze te beoordelen op aannemelijkheid
d: timing of waste-transfer tax provisions by royal decree
ARTIKEL IX, D (artikel 25, vijfde lid Wbm)
rules on application and content of ILT decisions for waste export tax
correcting conflicts and errors in tax laws by ministerial regulation
ARTIKEL IX, H (artikel 28, tweede lid Wbm)
rules for calculating tax on waste transfers at a lower rate
p: ARTIKEL IX, D (artikel 25, derde lid Wbm)
Quantities and treatment of exported waste are fixed by an ILT decision that is excluded from the General Tax Act, limiting the usual tax-law procedure for the taxpayer.
Pledge holders and executants become jointly liable for VAT on sales of goods they enforce, extending state collection reach to private creditors.

parties: Asks the government to respond to the RB and NOB comments and to explain the VAT medicines definition and effects on the Waddenveren.
The VVD members have taken note of the bill and ask the government to respond to the points in the Register Belastingadviseurs (RB) reaction.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en vragen de regering een reactie geven op de punten in de reactie van het Register Belastingadviseurs (RB).
Worries that abolishing the inkeerregeling raises the threshold for taxpayers to correct errors for fear of penalties.
The CDA members fear that for taxpayers wanting to correct an error the threshold becomes higher, because they must fear a fine.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vrezen dat voor de categorie belastingplichtigen die een fout willen herstellen de drempel hoger wordt om dit te doen, omdat zij moeten vrezen voor een boete.
Says the purchasing-power picture is unbalanced and that the 10% rule can cause people to lose toeslag because of a small income rise of an ex-partner.
Does the government acknowledge this? If so, does the government accept that people lose their toeslag because of this efficiency threshold?
Erkent de regering dit? Zo ja, accepteert de regering dus dat mensen hun toeslag verliezen vanwege deze doelmatigheidsgrens?
Welcomes the reparation of the double business test but worries about unintended effects of the medicines definition on care costs.
Nevertheless they are concerned about undesirable side effects of this measure.
Niettemin maken zij zich zorgen over ongewenste neveneffecten van deze maatregel.
Asks for quantified details on the tweetaks, the Wet Hillen abolition and the tariff increase in box 2.
Can the government provide an overview of the use of the Wet Hillen by age category?
Kan de regering een overzicht geven van het gebruik van de Wet Hillen op basis van leeftijdscategorieën?
Regrets the widening gap between single- and dual-earner households and asks for updated marginal tax rate tables.
The SGP members deeply regret this.
Dat betreuren de leden van de SGP-fractie ten zeerste.
Asks why only products with an RVG number are not kept in the low VAT rate and how the Waddenveren rate change works in the EU.
Why was it not chosen to keep only products with an RVG number in the low VAT rate, these members ask.
Waarom is er niet voor gekozen om alleen producten met een RVG-nummer in het lage btw-tarief te houden, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks why the bill emphasises abuse of the automatic suspensive effect of objections and how the VAT medicines change will work in practice.
These members ask the government why it therefore emphasises the improper use of lodging an objection.
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom zij daarmee de nadruk legt op het oneigenlijke gebruik van het aantekenen van verzet.
Asks what the EU rule on open sea is meant to achieve and what the environmental impact is of the shipping exemption.
Has the impact on the environment also been considered here?
Is hier ook gekeken naar de impact op het milieu?
Asks why car tax is based on CO2 emissions while van tax is based on value, and raises kerosene taxation.
Has convergence of both to CO2 emissions been investigated?
Is een convergentie van beiden naar CO 2 -uitstoot onderzocht?
Asks whether benefits of the box 3 wealth tax change reach larger fortunes and whether further regeerakkoord fiscal measures should enter the Belastingplan 2018 earlier.
The letter states that both changes to the wealth yield tax are mainly a benefit for the small saver.
In de brief wordt gesteld dat de beide wijzigingen van de vermogensrendementsheffing voornamelijk een voordeel voor de kleine spaarder zijn.
Asks for specification of the 'more current' return figures used in box 3 and how the savings percentages are calculated and adjusted.
The PVV members wish this specified further: to what extent do 'more current figures' deviate from actual figures?
De leden van de PVV-fractie wensen dit nader gespecificeerd: in welke mate wijken «meer actuele cijfers» af van feitelijke cijfers?
Welcomes the box 3 changes but asks about legal risks where taxpayers may have to pay more than 100% of their return, and about the leegwaarderatio ruling.
These members point out that there may be taxpayers who must pay more than 100% of their return as wealth yield tax.
Deze leden wijzen erop dat er belastingplichtigen kunnen zijn die meer dan 100% van hun rendement moeten afdragen als vermogensrendementsheffing.

Questions the distributional effects of the measures, the lack of data on wealth inequality, and the absence of an analysis by income group for each measure, asking for more information to Parliament.
Could the government indicate for each of these six measures in the amendment note what the effects are on purchasing power of different income groups?
Zou de regering voor elk van deze zes maatregelen in de nota van wijziging kunnen aangegeven wat de gevolgen zijn voor de koopkracht van verschillende inkomensgroepen?
Asks whether the Belastingdienst can implement all changes, questions the low contribution of wealth to tax revenue, and asks why the box 3 measures are not financed by more progressive taxation.
Welcomes the speed of the measures but asks whether they have been translated into legislation with sufficient care, given that tax legislation must not sacrifice care for speed.
After all, especially with tax legislation, the desired and necessary speed must not come at the expense of care.
Immers, zeker bij belastingwetgeving, mag de gewenste en benodigde snelheid niet te koste gaan van de zorgvuldigheid.
Asks about the logic of the chosen time periods for box 3 return calculation and the rationale for different periods for the tax brackets.
The SGP members wonder what the logic is of the proposed period in article 10.6bis, second paragraph.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen zich af wat de logica is van de voorgestelde termijn in artikel 10.6bis, tweede lid.
Asks why the box 3 plans were not placed in a separate bill given their complexity and size, and questions the budget derailment and the choice of a 7% innovation box rate.
The PvdA members ask why it was not chosen to place the box 3 plans in a separate bill.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen waarom er niet voor gekozen is de plannen voor box 3 onder te brengen in een apart wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Belastingplan 2018, asking that the August coalition tax measures be included, that the tightened pharmaceutical VAT definition receive a reasoned justification with fuller consultation reporting, and that the CPB-certified budget appendix be provided at advice stage. The government's reply accepted the first two points in amended form, and on the CPB appendix committed to providing it in future while stating that timing may not always allow it.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the August 2017 purchasing-power measures (elderly tax credit and general tax credit) be included in the bill, and the government added them.

The Afdeling found that the justification for tightening the pharmaceutical VAT definition was lacking and asked for a fuller consultation report; the government expanded the explanatory memorandum but maintained that the justification was sufficient.
The Afdeling asked that the CPB-certified budget estimates appendix be attached at advice stage; the government will aim to do so next year but cannot guarantee timing.

34794.s: The bill amends Book 7 of the Dutch Civil Code and the Seafarers Act to implement 2014 amendments to the Maritime Labour Convention, requiring ship managers and shipowners to maintain insurance covering repatriation and abandonment costs, unpaid wages and compensation for death or long-term disability of seafarers. It also obliges ship managers to ensure these obligations are met and to keep insurance certificates on board, with insurers subject to ministerial approval and notification duties.
34794.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rules as implementation of binding international obligations under the Maritime Labour Convention and explains the minimum insurance requirements.
q: Article 738c: the agreement is concluded with an insurer whose financial capacity to provide coverage under article 738a is judged sufficient by the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment, after consultation with the Minister of Finance

de overeenkomst is aangegaan met een verzekeraar van wie Onze Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu, na overleg met Onze Minister van Financiën, de financiële draagkracht tot het geven van dekking uit hoofde van artikel 738a voldoende oordeelt;
d: minister approves insurer financial capacity and designates supervisory authority
Artikel II, A (art. 48c Wet zeevarenden, lid 3 onder e)
rules on documents proving compliance with insurance requirements

parties: The VVD asks why an insurance obligation on the ship manager was chosen over a sector fund, how repatriation works within and beyond thirty days, and who is liable in the worst case, citing Raad van State warnings about insolvency risks.
The Council of State warns in its advice of a possible problem in reimbursing repatriation costs by the insurer in case of the employer's insolvency.
De Raad van State waarschuwt in haar advies voor een mogelijk probleem in het vergoeden van de kosten voor repatriëring door de verzekeraar bij insolventie van de werkgever.
The PVV has taken note of the bill and has no further questions for now.
The PVV members have taken note of the bill and for the time being have no further questions.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben vooralsnog geen verdere vragen.
The CDA can agree with the bill and has no questions.
The CDA members can agree with this bill and have no questions.}
De leden van de CDA-fractie kunnen instemmen met dit wetsvoorstel en hebben geen vragen.
The D66 asks how the amendments have been implemented in neighbouring countries' legislation.
The D66 members ask how the proposed amendments to the Code and appendices to the Maritime Labour Convention 2006 have been implemented in neighbouring countries' legislation.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen op welke manier de voorliggende wijzigingen van de Code en aanhangsels bij het Maritiem Arbeidsverdrag 2006 zijn geïmplementeerd in wetgeving bij buurlanden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division recommends sending the bill implementing amendments to the Maritime Labour Convention 2006 to parliament, but asks for justification or amendment of the mandatory insurance for repatriation costs on employer insolvency, particularly where premium non-payment could leave the obligation unmet. The minister's reply explains the 30-day notice rule, alternative protections via the flag state and UWV, and P&I club practice, and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
concerns: Whether insurance covers repatriation costs when premium payment is interrupted by employer insolvency; the reply explains the 30-day notice period and alternative safeguards but rejects advance premium payment as inconsistent with P&I practice.
Redactional points on the preamble reference, implementation of Guideline B2.5.3, redundant passages and the absence of need for parliamentary approval were incorporated.

34845-V.s: This bill amends the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by adjusting appropriations (commitments, expenditure and receipts) following the Najaarsnota. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 December of the budget year.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2017 to the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V).
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2017 wijzigingen aan te brengen in: de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V)

34848.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet voorkoming misbruik chemicaliën to align it with updated EU regulations on drug precursors, updating definitions and references to EU instruments. It adds a delegation allowing the Minister to make minor implementing rules by ministerial regulation and recasts the designation of supervisory officials.
34848.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial delegation by legislative economy, since a fixed statutory list of EU articles would require new amendments each time the EU regulations change.
q: From considerations of legislative economy this is an undesirable situation, especially since the necessary limit can also be found by expressly stating in the proposed new paragraph that the relevant regulations expressly provide a basis for setting implementing rules of a minor nature.

Vanuit overwegingen van wetgevingseconomie is dit een onverkieslijke situatie, temeer omdat de noodzakelijke begrenzing ook kan worden gevonden door met zoveel woorden in het voorgestelde nieuwe lid op te nemen dat de relevante verordeningen uitdrukkelijk een grondslag geven voor het stellen van uitvoeringsvoorschriften van ondergeschikte aard.
d: minor implementing rules where EU regulations expressly allow member state requirements
amending references to EU legal acts in article 2 if non-substantive
p: Allows amendment of statutory references to EU acts by general administrative order, limited to non-substantive changes, bypassing parliament for those adjustments.
Gives the Minister power to set minor implementing rules by ministerial regulation where EU regulations expressly permit member state requirements.

parties: Asks why the bill came so late, what the risks were, and why delegation via ministerial regulation rather than AMvB is used; opposes too easy parliamentary consent to delegation.
The VVD members believe the House of Representatives should not too easily, and on too many matters without clear reason, consent to delegation via AMvB's or ministerial regulations.

De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn van mening dat de Tweede Kamer niet te gemakkelijk en bij te veel zaken, zonder duidelijke aanleiding, moet instemmen met delegatie via AMvB's of ministeriële regelingen.
Asks how micro-enterprises' competitive position was taken into account, why implementation was delayed, and about administrative burden not discussed in the explanatory memorandum.
These members ask the government to estimate the administrative burden arising from the broader registration obligation and the information obligations to the European database.

Genoemde leden vragen de regering een inschatting te geven van de administratieve lasten die voortkomen uit de uitgebreidere registratieplicht en uit de informatieverplichtingen aan de Europese databank.

Asks whether police and customs can act against legal precursors held for synthetic drug production, whether the definition of non-registered substances is too narrow, and whether customs' lack of seizure powers and workload are adequate.
These members ask whether the workload at customs is already considerable even without the 'limited amount of extra work'.
Deze leden vragen of het niet zo is dat de werkdruk bij de douane nu al aanzienlijk is, ook zonder de «beperkte hoeveelheid extra werk».

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill amending the Wet voorkoming misbruik chemicaliën may proceed but needs two changes: limiting the power to amend statutory references by AMvB to non-substantive changes, and narrowing the ministerial regulation delegation to subordinate implementing rules. The minister's nader rapport states that both points were adopted and the bill and explanatory memorandum were amended accordingly.
concerns: The delegation allowing statutory references to be changed by AMvB was too broad and should be limited to non-substantive, technical changes to EU legal acts.
The ministerial regulation delegation was too broad and should be narrowed to subordinate administrative and implementing rules.
The Afdeling suggested editorial improvements, including listing the four regulations in the preamble and adding a transposition table.

34857.s: The bill re-introduces a delegation allowing the national government, by general administrative order (AMvB), to compel municipalities to cooperate regionally under the Youth Act and the Wmo 2015, after the existing power was set to lapse in 2018. It also adds ministerial power to set rules limiting administrative burdens on providers, data exchange and accountability, and lets the minister approve or restrict Zorginstituut activities outside its statutory tasks.
34857.j: The memorandum justifies the permanent cooperation power by the Rijk's stewardship responsibility and the risk that regional cooperation fails, arguing its preventive effect makes further regulation unnecessary.
q: A permanent delegation basis was chosen rather than a temporary one, as the delegation basis is considered permanently necessary as a usable instrument for the national government's stewardship responsibility.

Er is gekozen voor een permanente delegatiegrondslag en niet voor een tijdelijke delegatiegrondslag, aangezien de delegatiegrondslag permanent noodzakelijk wordt geacht als bruikbaar instrument voor de stelselverantwoordelijkheid van het Rijk.
d: designate areas where municipalities must cooperate and set forms of cooperation
rules on financing, data exchange and accountability to reduce administrative burden
designate areas where municipalities must cooperate and set forms of cooperation
rules on financing, data exchange and accountability to reduce administrative burden
p: ARTIKEL I A and II A (Jeugdwet art. 2.8 lid 2; Wmo art. 2.6.1 lid 2)
The national minister may by AMvB compel municipalities to cooperate in designated areas, after consultation and publication, removing a sunset that would have ended this power in 2018.
The minister must approve Zorginstituut activities outside its statutory tasks, may withhold approval, impose obligations, or order termination of such activities.

parties: Asks who decides whether regional cooperation is necessary and whether consultation has failed, and what room municipalities keep to propose their own solutions before coercion.
Who decides whether the cooperation is necessary?
Wie bepaalt of de samenwerking noodzakelijk is?
Warns that imposed regional cooperation could sideline local democracy and asks for guarantees that obligations will not increase administrative burdens.
Forced regional cooperation may also sideline local democracy.
Gedwongen regionale samenwerking kan ook leiden tot het buitenspel zetten van de lokale democratie.
Argues a temporary delegation basis is preferable to a permanent one, and asks how parliament can debate or weigh objections to the AMvB after the consultation period.
With the Council of State, these members believe that reinstating a temporary delegation basis for compelling cooperation between municipalities is preferable to a permanent one.

Met de Raad van State zijn deze leden van mening dat opnieuw een tijdelijke delegatiegrondslag instellen op grond waarvan samenwerking tussen gemeenten kan worden verplicht de voorkeur heeft boven een permanente delegatiegrondslag.
Asks why the rules are set in an AMvB rather than in statute and how the government will intervene if cooperation fails.
Asks whether municipal councils, not only executives, will be involved in any compulsory cooperation, given democratic control.
These members ask to what extent municipal councils, alongside the executive, will be involved in a possible obligation to cooperate.
Genoemde leden vragen in hoeverre naast het college ook gemeenteraden worden betrokken bij een mogelijke verplichting tot samenwerking
Asks under what circumstances compulsory cooperation may be imposed and how often AMvB-based cooperation has been used in past years.
These members ask whether the government can clarify under which circumstances compulsory cooperation may be imposed.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering kan verduidelijken onder welke omstandigheden tot een verplichte samenwerking overgegaan kan worden.
Asks whether bureaucratic pressure is sufficient and whether a delegation provision should now be followed by an actual AMvB.
Has the moment not come, these members ask, to actually draft an AMvB after including a delegation provision?
Is niet het moment gekomen, zo vragen deze leden, om na opname van een delegatiebepaling, ook daadwerkelijk over te gaan tot het opstellen van een AMvB?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised proceeding with the bill only after making the mandatory inter-municipal cooperation power temporary rather than permanent, and after justifying or narrowing the ministerial-regulation powers on administrative burden reduction. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely rejected the temporariness demand, accepted narrowing the financing-method wording and the discretionary/imperative issue partly, and defended the choice of ministerial regulation over an AMvB.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the delegation power to mandate municipal cooperation be made temporary rather than permanent, but the government kept it permanent as a discretionary power.
The Afdeling said the 'wijze van bekostiging' delegation was too broad and could touch municipal procurement policy; the government narrowed it to financing methods and administrative processes.
The Afdeling advised that the administrative-burden rules be set by AMvB rather than ministerial regulation, which the government refused.

The Afdeling questioned the necessity of central intervention in a decentralised system where municipalities and providers are already standardising, and asked for a reasoned justification; the government argued the rules are needed to force adoption of standard workflows.

The Afdeling asked for a discretionary rather than imperative delegation for standardisation rules; the government kept the imperative form, explaining that some parties do not use the templates consistently.
The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to explain why comparable rules are not extended to other social-domain laws such as the Participatiewet; the memorandum was supplemented.

34893.s: The bill amends the Foetal Tissue Act so that foetal tissue may be stored and used for criminal investigation and prosecution of serious sexual offences that may have caused the pregnancy, and allows storage and use without consent for victims under sixteen or who are incapable of reasoned judgement or deceased. It also amends the Code of Criminal Procedure so that DNA-relationship testing can use cell material obtained under other laws.
34893.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to protect victims of serious sexual offences from repercussions and by the lack of an otherwise available means of evidence, and argues the measure is proportionate given the limited scope and the doctor's retained professional secrecy.
q: The bill merely removes the statutory restriction on doctors storing and providing tissue for investigating and prosecuting serious sexual offences where they suspect such an offence.

Het wetsvoorstel neemt slechts de wettelijke beperking voor artsen weg om het weefsel voor de opsporing en vervolging van ernstige zedenmisdrijven te mogen bewaren en verstrekken indien hij een vermoeden van een dergelijk misdrijf heeft.
p: Art. I A (art. 2, lid 1 Wet foetaal weefsel)
Adds a new purpose allowing foetal tissue to be stored and used for investigating and prosecuting an enumerated list of sexual offences, limited to those offences listed exhaustively.
Art. I B (art. 7a Wet foetaal weefsel)

Disapplies consent requirements and data protection provisions so that tissue from minors, incapacitated or deceased women may be stored and used without consent when a sexual offence is suspected.},{

parties: Asks how physicians can reliably judge whether medical confidentiality must be breached and whether they are adequately protected against errors.
Does this not place too great a responsibility on the physician?
Komt hiermee niet een te grote verantwoordelijkheid bij de arts te liggen?
Asks whether physicians must answer truthfully when women ask about storage, and how the safety of women fearing repercussions is guaranteed.
These members would like to see again how this is adequately safeguarded.
Graag zouden deze leden nog een keer nader toegelicht willen zien hoe dit op een goede wijze geborgd is.
Questions how young women are protected from pressure by perpetrators and from avoiding care, as raised by the Raad van State.
However, there is no discussion of the risk that the young woman is pressured by someone who knows of this possibility and has an interest in preventing its use.

Er wordt echter niet ingegaan op het risico dat de jonge vrouw onder druk gezet wordt, door iemand die wel van deze mogelijkheid op de hoogte is en er zelf belang bij heeft om te voorkomen dat van deze mogelijkheid gebruik gemaakt wordt.
Not fully convinced on whether medical confidentiality is breached; asks for clarity, monitoring of care avoidance, proportionality, and reactions of the Autoriteit persoonsgegevens and OM.
These members are still not fully convinced on this point.
Genoemde leden zijn toch nog niet volledig overtuigd op dit punt.
Questions the inspectorate's oversight of the Wfw, which evaluation found did not take place, and asks why under-16 women need no consent and how risks of unsafe abortion are addressed.
These members ask the government whether this oversight has improved by 2018 and how the IGJ i.o. will supervise implementation of this Act.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering of dit toezicht anno 2018 is verbeterd en hoe de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd in oprichting (IGJ i.o.) toezicht zal houden op de uitvoering van deze wet.
Asks why storage duration and retention limits are not fixed in the law and why oversight of the Wfw has not occurred, and questions the legitimacy of unregulated storage.
Does the government agree with the SGP members that this oversight is indeed necessary, especially since demand for fetal tissue may increase in future?

Is de regering het met de leden van de SGP-fractie eens dat dit toezicht wel nodig is, zeker in het licht van het feit dat niet uitgesloten is dat in de toekomst de vraag naar foetaal weefsel zal toenemen?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised in May 2017 against sending the bill to parliament until its remarks were addressed, chiefly that the explanatory memorandum needed to clarify the abortion doctor's role, the practice of storing tissue and DNA testing, the risk of women avoiding regular care, and how to protect vulnerable women from retaliation. The government's reply of February 2018 states that the advice was followed by supplementing the explanatory memorandum in paragraphs 3, 3.1, 3.2 and 4, and by justifying the wording of the Code of Criminal Procedure amendments.
concerns: The Council asked for clarification of the abortion doctor's role and the criteria for storing foetal tissue without consent, and the government added this to paragraph 3 of the explanatory memorandum.
The Council asked that the benefit of using tissue without consent be weighed against the risk that vulnerable women avoid regular medical care, and the government addressed this in paragraph 3.1.
The Council asked for clarity on how tissue storage and transfer to the NFI would work, including timing and retention periods, and the government supplemented paragraph 3.2.
The Council asked how the safety of women at risk of retaliation from their environment would be guaranteed, and the government clarified the protective measures in the explanatory memorandum.

The Council asked that the Code of Criminal Procedure reference refer to the specific laws rather than 'another law', and the government explained its choice of wording by reference to comparable provisions instead of changing the text.

34929.s: The bill keeps the mandatory health insurance deductible (verplicht eigen risico) fixed at 385 euros per insured person for 2019, 2020 and 2021 by suspending the indexation provisions of the Zorgverzekeringswet. It also adds a rule allowing insurers to charge the deductible where the insured person is responsible for late submission of a claim, and repeals the 2018 freeze law.
34929.j: The memorandum justifies the freeze as a policy commitment in the coalition agreement and explains that the indexation and ministerial-regulation delegation in article 19 paragraphs 2 and 3 are set aside for the period.
q: The second and third paragraphs remain inapplicable for the years 2019, 2020 and 2021.
Het tweede en derde lid blijven buiten toepassing voor de jaren 2019, 2020 en 2021.
d: date for submission of invoices set by general administrative order (AMvB)

parties: Asks what further measures the government sees to reduce care costs such as waste, red tape, and information exchange, without addressing checks on the executive.
If there are possibilities to further limit and dampen care costs, without compromising accessibility and quality, the VVD members are in favour of that.
Indien er mogelijkheden zijn om de zorgkosten verder te beperken en te dempen, zonder dat de toegankelijkheid en kwaliteit in het geding is, zijn de leden van de VVD-fractie daar voor.
Asks technical questions about the basis for the expected 5 euro rise in the care allowance and rounding of the income-related contribution.
The CDA members ask whether the government can further explain the basis for the expectation that the care allowance will rise by five euros (in 2021).
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering nader kan aangeven waarop de verwachting is gebaseerd dat de zorgtoeslag met vijf euro (in 2021) zal stijgen.
Asks about additional care use from the freeze, the post-2021 system, and the Raad van State remarks on the generic character of the measure.
The D66 members ask whether the remarks of the Council of State on the generic character of the measure can be addressed in more detail.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of nader ingegaan kan worden op de opmerkingen van de Raad van State over het generieke karakter van de maatregel.
Questions whether the compensation mechanism means the affordability claim does not hold for insured persons who do not reach the deductible, and whether the deductible will keep rising.

Does the government agree with the GroenLinks members that such a compensation mechanism in effect means the group of insured persons who do not fully reach the deductible will face a net rise in individual care expenditure?

Is de regering het met de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie eens dat een dergelijk compensatiemechanisme er in feite voor zorgt dat de groep verzekerden die het eigen risico niet vol maakt netto te maken krijgt met een stijging van de individuele zorguitgaven?
Argues the deductible is a barrier and penalty for illness, wants it abolished or cut by at least 100 euro, and asks why financial incentives are used instead of medical judgement.
These members ask the government why financial incentives are used at all to encourage or discourage care use, since this judgement should be left to the medical professional.

Deze leden vragen de regering waarom er überhaupt financiële prikkels gebruikt worden om zorggebruik aan te moedigen of af te remmen, aangezien dit oordeel aan de medisch professional gelaten moet worden.
Supports the freeze as contributing to solidarity and affordability, but asks for justification of the 15 euro difference and of how the premium link could be broken.
These members consider it very important that care remains affordable, but also that affordability goes hand in hand with solidarity.
Deze leden vinden het van groot belang dat de zorg betaalbaar blijft, maar ook dat betaalbaarheid hand in hand gaat met solidariteit.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises the Tweede Kamer to receive the bill freezing the mandatory own risk (eigen risico) in health insurance through 2021, but warns that the generic measure does not match its aims of affordable care and reducing stacked out-of-pocket costs, and suggests more targeted alternatives. The minister's reply (nader rapport) rejects the targeting critique, explains the measure as part of a broader package, and reports that the text was adjusted to clarify the aims and regulatory burden.
concerns: The Afdeling argues the generic freeze reaches far more insured persons than the target groups and that a more targeted approach (allowances, poverty policy, long-term care rules) would be more efficient; the government rejects this, saying the measure is targeted at high-cost insured and fits a broader package.

The Afdeling notes the sizeable structural budgetary effects against the government's aim to control collective care spending; the government lowers the estimated effect to 560 million euros and points to other cost-control measures, and the text was clarified.
The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to explain its aims and income effects more fully; the explanatory memorandum was amended to clarify the aims and the regulatory burden.

34956.s: The bill adds a deactivation mechanism to the quota levy (quotumheffing) for employers of workers with disabilities, allowing a ministerial regulation to switch off the levy for the public or non-public sector once the employment target is met, and provides a one-year exemption after activation. It also extends the definition of disabled worker in the Wfsv, Ziektewet and Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein to certain former beschut workers.
34956.j: The memorandum justifies the deactivation power by the need to avoid levies on employers when the target is met and the October 1 deadline, and explains that prior submission to parliament is omitted because of the summer recess and time constraints.
q: To prevent employers receiving incorrect information, the levy for the previous year already being imposed, and both implementing bodies doing unnecessary work, it is therefore necessary that the ministerial regulation on deactivation is published and in force by 1 October.

Om te voorkomen dat de werkgevers onjuiste informatie krijgen, de quotumheffing over het voorgaande kalenderjaar al is opgelegd aan werkgevers en beide uitvoeringsinstanties onnodig werk verrichten is het derhalve noodzakelijk dat de ministeriële regeling tot deactiveren voor 1 oktober is gepubliceerd en in werking is getreden.
d: ARTIKEL I, D.3 (artikel 122n, tweede lid Wfsv)
deactivation of the quota levy for public or non-public sector
ARTIKEL I, E (artikel 122na, eerste lid Wfsv)
no levy in first calendar year after activation
p: ARTIKEL I, D.3 (artikel 122n, tweede lid Wfsv)
The minister may by ministerial regulation, after Council of Ministers consent, deactivate a statutory levy without prior submission to parliament, a deviation from the regular voorhang practice.

parties: Asks whether the government can justify the separate market and government targets and how deactivation decisions are based on criteria, and warns against rules with counterproductive effects.
Can the government justify how the current distinction between the market (100,000 jobs) and government (25,000 jobs) contributes to the necessary movement toward an inclusive labour market?

Kan de regering onderbouwen hoe het huidige onderscheid tussen markt (100.000 banen) en overheid (25.000 banen) bijdraagt aan de noodzakelijke beweging op de arbeidsmarkt om tot een inclusieve arbeidsmarkt te komen?
Argues that the government should set a good example and that structural difficulties do not excuse failing to meet its own targets; asks about the feasibility of enforcing the levy.
However, these reasons are no excuse for the government not to meet its own stated targets regarding the jobs agreement.
Echter zijn deze redenen geen excuus voor de overheid om niet te voldoen aan de eigen gestelde doelen wat betreft de banenafspraak.
Asks whether the rental tool gives government employers enough guidance and how the UWV's concerns about the lease administration will be handled, and wants concrete agreements from ministers.

The D66 members are very curious about the announced concrete agreements and actions the responsible ministers will come up with to still achieve the number of jobs, including in the government sector.

De leden van de D66-fractie zijn erg benieuwd naar de aangekondigde concrete afspraken en acties waar de verantwoordelijke Ministers mee zullen komen om alsnog het aantal banen, ook in de overheidssector, te behalen.
Notes progress in government jobs but asks for the government's response to APE recommendations and warns that contracting out may reduce social procurement once the levy applies.
With the introduction of the quota levy there is a risk that government organisations will procure less socially, because the result does not count anyway.
Met de invoering van de quotumheffing ontstaat het risico dat overheidsorganisaties minder sociaal gaan inkopen, omdat het resultaat toch niet meetelt.
Strongly criticises the postponement as self-granted leniency for government and repeats the Council of State's harsh critique that the amendment undermines credibility.

The Division notes that these adjustments are therefore not aimed at getting the government to meet its obligations under the jobs agreement in the short term, but mainly at giving the government itself further postponement in meeting that obligation.

De Afdeling merkt op dat deze aanpassingen er derhalve niet op zijn gericht om de overheid er toe te brengen thans op korte termijn alsnog aan haar verplichtingen in het kader van de banenafspraak te voldoen, maar met name om de overheid zelf opnieuw uitstel te geven voor het nakomen van die verplichting.
Doubts the approach will get the government to meet its target, warns the postponement undermines the levy as a real sanction, and asks for a broad rethink as the Council of State recommended.
These members note that earlier substantial amendments were already made to the Jobs Agreement Act and quota levy, making activation of the quota levy less likely.

Deze leden constateren dat reeds eerder ingrijpende aanpassingen zijn doorgevoerd van de Wet banenafspraak en quotumheffing, waardoor het activeren van de quotumheffing minder waarschijnlijk is geworden.

Asks for a response to the Council of State's criticism that the levy risks becoming a bookkeeping exercise with heavy administrative burdens, and whether the government would abolish the levy if evaluation shows little result.

Following the Council of State's advisory division, these members believe that postponing sanctions for failing to meet the targets fundamentally undermines the credibility of the quota levy instrument.

In navolging van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State zijn deze leden van mening dat uitstel van sancties wegens het niet behalen van de doelen de geloofwaardigheid van het instrument van de quotumheffing in de kern aantast.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill allowing deactivation of the quota levy and a one-year postponement of its first levy under the Banenafspraak, questioning whether the overheid can meet targets after postponement and urging a full evaluation of the Wet banenafspraak. The government's nader rapport defends the bill as a temporary postponement, not a waiver, and largely rejects the call for a broader rethink while promising monitoring and evaluation.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned why the government will succeed after postponement when earlier measures failed, and asked for an analysis; the government explained the causes and pointed to sector plans and studies, and added detail to the memorie van toelichting.

The Afdeling concluded the target group expansions and postponements undermine the Wet's goal and advised a full evaluation and rethinking of the law; the government does not endorse this conclusion and says the amendments were needed and monitoring is underway.

The Afdeling noted that the credibility of the quota levy and target group register is eroding and that the law may become a bookkeeping exercise; the government responded that monitoring and possible further adjustments remain open.

34960-X.s: The bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence by raising expenditure and revenue estimates, adding €1.247 billion in expenditure mutations mainly from the coalition agreement funds, end-of-year margins and wage and price adjustments. It is a budget-amending law that sets the amended appropriations in thousands of euros and takes effect from 1 June 2018.
34960-X.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increase by pointing to NATO capability requirements, the Geïntegreerde Buitenland- en Veiligheidsstrategie and the constitutional tasks of the armed forces, without any new executive powers.
q: These investments are necessary for carrying out our constitutional tasks and the deployment required for this in the Netherlands and, among others, within NATO, EU and UN frameworks.
Deze investeringen zijn noodzakelijk voor de uitvoering van onze grondwettelijke taken en de inzet die daarvoor in Nederland en onder andere in NAVO-, EU- en VN-verband nodig is.

35095-X.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence, adjusting expenditure, commitments and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It also records interdepartmental budget transfers and a repayment of a pension financing arrangement with ABP, and sets the amounts in thousands of euros with effect from 1 December 2018.
q: We, with joint consultation of the States General, have approved and resolved
Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

35289.s: The bill amends the Dutch vocational education act (WEB) and its Caribbean Netherlands version (WEB BES) so the minister may add supplementary funds to institutions' lump-sum grants for exceptional circumstances or developments in the vocational education system. It also allows the minister to set a funding ceiling and to issue ministerial regulations on the allocation and reduction of such funds.
35289.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to ministerial regulation by saying the rules would cover general matters such as application, granting, accountability and advance payment, and that individual decisions must meet the General Administrative Law Act.
q: Ministerial regulations may be issued on the granting and reduction of the supplementary funds.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen voorschriften worden gegeven over de verstrekking en vermindering van de aanvullende middelen.
d: rules on granting and reducing supplementary funds
allocation rules when a funding ceiling is set
allocation rules when a funding ceiling is set
p: ARTIKEL I, A (Art. 2.2.3, lid 1 en 2 WEB)
The minister may add funds to institutions' grants for exceptional circumstances and reduce later grants, with individual decisions stating amounts or criteria.
The minister may introduce a funding ceiling, with allocation details left to ministerial regulation rather than the statute.
Removes the words allowing the minister to impose obligations when granting funds, widening the minister's discretion.

parties: Asks for annual information to the Chamber on use of the new legal possibility and past use of ad hoc funding under article 4.
These members want the Chamber to be informed every year, when drawing final conclusions on adding the funds to the state contribution of all institutions, about the use of this legal possibility.

Deze leden willen graag dat elk jaar bij het trekken van de eindconclusies over het toevoegen van de middelen aan de rijksbijdrage van alle instellingen de Kamer geïnformeerd wordt over het gebruik van deze wettelijke mogelijkheid.
Supports the reserve for predictability but asks whether unspent funds paid out in December create unpredictable state funding and whether the diploma indicator creates a performance incentive.
These members ask the government whether this does not lead to unpredictable state funding on the part of the institutions.
Deze leden vragen de regering of dit niet leidt tot onvoorspelbare rijksbekostiging aan de kant van de instellingen.

Worries that clawback from state contribution in later years could create a sliding scale harming financially vulnerable institutions and asks how growth-based eligibility will be distinguished and whether requests will be public.
The aforementioned members are very concerned about the proposal to fully or partly deduct the extra funds provided from the state contribution in later years.
De voornoemde leden maken zich grote zorgen over het voorstel om de verstrekte aanvullende middelen geheel of gedeeltelijk in mindering te brengen op de rijksbijdrage in latere jaren.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs (and its BES version) to provide additional funds in exceptional circumstances. The Afdeling made no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer, so no government reply was needed.

35298.s: The bill abolishes the option for municipalities and provinces to set up a self-designed audit function (rekenkamerfunctie), requiring instead an independent rekenkamer or joint rekenkamer. It also extends the audit powers of these bodies over contracted private suppliers, subsidised or guaranteed entities, and jointly owned public entities and their subsidiaries, and aligns the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 accordingly.
35298.j: The memorandum justifies abolishing the self-designed audit function by the inadequate functioning of such functions in about fifty municipalities and the need for a uniform, independent audit body everywhere.
q: The core of this bill is that the statutory option to choose a self-designed audit function is abolished.
De kern van dit wetsvoorstel is dat de wettelijke mogelijkheid vervalt om te kiezen voor een naar eigen inzicht in te richten rekenkamerfunctie.
p: Artikel I G / Artikel II E
Local and provincial audit bodies gain expanded powers to examine private contractors, subsidies, guarantees and joint public shareholdings, strengthening checks over the executive.
Artikel I A-C / Artikel II A-C
Municipalities and provinces lose the option to structure their audit function by ordinance; an independent rekenkamer becomes mandatory.

parties: Asks why the review function is abolished, how this fits municipal autonomy, whether budgets are sufficient, and why water boards are excluded.
The VVD members ask the government to further justify why the 'rekenkamerfunctie' is being abolished.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering nader te motiveren waarom de «rekenkamerfunctie» wordt geschrapt.
Supports strong review but wants to keep the rekenkamerfunctie option for municipalities where it works, and proposes clarifying the scope of investigative powers and safeguards for independence.
Accepts the goal of an active rekenkamer everywhere but asks about proportionality, subsidiarity, the role of councillors on rekenkamers and risks for the many well-functioning ones.
How does the government intend to prevent this bill from unintentionally harming municipalities that already have a functioning rekenkamer?
Hoe wil de regering voorkomen dat dit wetsvoorstel niet, onbedoeld, schade toebrengt aan gemeenten die al wel een functionerende rekenkamer hebben?

Stresses the importance of strong rekenkamers for decentralised oversight, asks why water boards are excluded and what the effect is on joint regulations, and requests data on active and dormant rekenkamers.
These members consider it very important that rekenkamers are strengthened at the decentralised level because this contributes to the quality of decentralised governance.
Deze leden vinden het zeer belangrijk dat op decentraal niveau de rekenkamers versterkt worden omdat dit bijdraagt aan de kwaliteit van het decentrale bestuur.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Wet versterking decentrale rekenkamers, which abolishes the optional rekenkamerfunctie and makes local audit offices mandatory, while raising questions about outdated data, the advisory role for council members, and the scope of investigative powers. The minister's reply accepts the data update, drops the raadslid-adviseur figure, and adds limits and procedural rules to the investigative powers, largely following the advice.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for updated data on inactive local audit offices and on the effect of mergers, which the minister addressed through the working group report and an updated memorie van toelichting.
The Afdeling asked for a more substantiated reason for the raadslid as adviseur, given the mixed experience and alternatives such as a klankbordgroep; the minister dropped the figure entirely.
The Afdeling raised concerns that a council member as advisory member of the audit office could compromise its independence, and the minister removed the proposal from the bill.

The Afdeling advised aligning the investigative powers with the relevant procedural and substantive rules of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016, and the minister added the restriction on financial undertakings and procedural rules to the bill.

35469.s: The bill adds administrative fines to the enforcement tools of the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport against slot misuse at coordinated airports, setting fixed fine amounts for violations of the slot-allocation rules in the Wet luchtvaart. It also extends the list of provisions in article 11.16 that can be sanctioned, including the nadere regels under article 8a.52 on slot use.
35469.j: The memorandum justifies the fines by the need to sanction slot misuse effectively, and states that the fine must be proportionate and open to objection and appeal.
q: The administrative fine must further be proportionate and is open to objection and appeal to the administrative court.
De bestuurlijke boete moet verder proportioneel zijn en is vatbaar voor bezwaar en beroep bij de bestuursrechter.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel 1 (art. 11.16, eerste lid, onderdeel e, sub 5°)
nadere regels on use of slots at coordinated airports
p: Adds fixed administrative fines of 74,000 and 670,000 euro for slot misuse, a new sanction tool for the inspectorate that is subject to objection and appeal to the administrative court.

parties: Asks how the EUR 670,000 maximum fine is built up, when sanctions apply, and which definitions of slot misuse are used, including whether they follow worldwide standards.
The VVD members ask whether it can be made clear for which form of "slot misuse" a sanction is imposed, and when not.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of helder kan worden gemaakt bij welke vorm van «slotmisbruik» een sanctie wordt opgelegd, en wanneer niet.
Asks how the fine levels were set, whether they are proportionate, whether the fines are subject to objection and appeal before the administrative court, and how they fit the ILT intervention ladder.
Can the government further confirm that the administrative fine is open to objection and appeal to the administrative court?
Kan de regering verder bevestigen dat de bestuurlijke boete vatbaar is voor bezwaar en beroep bij de bestuursrechter?
