Supports stronger action against slot misuse and asks about the ILT's enforcement capacity and how the intervention ladder will apply.
The D66 members support the government's decision to act more strongly against slot misuse so that scarce capacity is used as well as possible.
De leden van de D66-fractie staan achter het besluit van de regering om sterker op te treden tegen slotmisbruik, zodat de schaarse capaciteit zo goed mogelijk benut kan worden.

Supports effective sanctions, asks whether fines can be raised or tied to unlawful gains, and whether repeat offenders can be sanctioned more heavily, and calls for the rules to serve the public interest rather than sector interests.
These members also want to know whether the sanction can or will be increased for repeated offences in order to sanction revolving-door slot misusers more effectively.
Deze leden willen ook graag weten of de sanctie bij herhaling van de overtreding kan of zal worden verhoogd om draaideurslotmisbruikers effectiever te sanctioneren.
Asks whether the system can also be used to fine or incentivise other airline conduct, in particular avoidance of Dutch employment conditions for staff based in the Netherlands.

These members therefore want to know whether, through (part of) the system in this Act, action can be taken more effectively against airlines that, through tricks, do not offer their Netherlands-based staff Dutch employment conditions.

Deze leden willen daarom weten of via (een deel van) de systematiek in deze wet beter opgetreden kan worden tegen luchtvaartmaatschappijen die hun in Nederland gevestigd personeel met trucs geen Nederlandse arbeidsvoorwaarden aanbieden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises on a bill amending the Aviation Act to allow administrative fines for slot misuse at coordinated airports, and raises no remarks. The minister's reply (nader rapport) only confirms that the advice is noted and that the bill is submitted to the Tweede Kamer.

35470-III.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statements (slotwet) for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services (CTIVD), and the agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie. It adjusts appropriations and realised spending figures, with a closing law effective from publication and retroactive to 31 December 2019.
q: The surplus in the Cabinet of the King's expenditure is mainly caused by lower personnel costs due to vacancies and partly by lower material expenses.
Het overschot bij de uitgaven van het Kabinet van de Koning wordt met name veroorzaakt door lagere uitgaven aan personeel als gevolg van vacatures en deels door lagere materiële uitgaven.

35478.s: This is an incidental supplementary budget bill amending the 2020 budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, adding funds for measures to rebuild after the COVID-19 crisis and for compensating funeral transport costs. The bill makes no delegation of rule-making power and only adjusts budget figures effective from 2 June 2020.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2020
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2020

35496.s: The bill adds a deemed regular benefit (fictief regulier voordeel) to the income tax act for the excessive part of loans a substantial-interest holder has with his own company above EUR 500,000, with transitional, partner and emigration rules. It also ends payment deferral in the collection act when such a benefit is enjoyed, with an exception where debts are reduced.
35496.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the bill by avoiding costly Belastingdienst audits of whether loans are disguised profit distributions, and it explains that no rebuttal option is included for specific loan types because of implementation complexity.
q: With the proposed measure, these discussions about debt relationships exceeding EUR 500,000 no longer need to be conducted.
Met de voorgestelde maatregel hoeven deze discussies over schuldverhoudingen van meer dan € 500.000 niet langer te worden gevoerd.
d: rules on determining the maximum amount when the taxpayer does not have the same partner all year
rules on determining the maximum amount for taxpayers who previously ceased Dutch residence or were non-resident substantial-interest holders
p: Ends payment deferral on emigration-related tax claims when a deemed benefit is enjoyed, with a taxpayer-proof exception for reduced debts.

parties: Asks why the measure was submitted before the building-blocks report, why transitional rules are limited, and whether legitimate business loans are caught.
Why did the government choose to submit the bill to the Council of State at the end of 2019, before the results of the study into building blocks for a better tax system were published?

Waarom heeft de regering ervoor gekozen het wetsvoorstel eind 2019 in te dienen bij de Raad van State, nog vóór de resultaten van het onderzoek naar de bouwstenen voor een beter belastingstelsel zijn gepubliceerd?
Asks how the measure works for partners and whether affected persons could evade the rules, and requests an assessment of exempting business loans with a reversed burden of proof.
Has the government examined the extent to which that target group (the 3%) has possibilities to evade these rules fiscally or otherwise?
Heeft de regering onderzocht in hoeverre die doelgroep (de 3%) mogelijkheden heeft om deze regelgeving fiscaal dan wel anderszins te ontlopen?
Doubts effectiveness and proportionality, notes the bill may legitimise loans up to the threshold, and asks the government to respond to the Council of State's criticism of technical complexity.

The CDA members ask whether the government can now provide more insight and, following the advice of the Council of State, further justify the purpose, scale of the problem and effectiveness of the bill.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen zich af of de regering hierin inmiddels meer inzicht kan geven en in navolging van het advies van de Raad van State het doel, de omvang van de problematiek en de effectiviteit van het wetsvoorstel nader kan motiveren.
Supports the anti-avoidance aim but asks detailed questions on data, verification of arm's-length terms, macro-financial risks and monitoring by DNB and AFM.
These members ask how supervision is exercised over the possible adverse consequences of loans from shareholders with a substantial interest to their own company.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen op welke wijze toezicht wordt gehouden op de mogelijke nadelige gevolgen van leningen van AB-houders bij de eigen vennootschap.
Argues the government ignores its own officials' advice for a EUR 17,500 threshold and asks why exceptions are not reduced.
Why does the government not follow the advice of the Finance civil servants to apply a threshold of EUR 17,500?
Waarom volgt de regering niet het advies van de ambtenaren van Financiën om een grens van 17.500 euro te hanteren?
Argues the bill still exempts large amounts, including owner-home loans, and calls for uniform treatment and simpler rules to prevent avoidance.
These members note that in this way many billions in tax will still be evaded and request that the bill be amended so that all loans from own companies to directors are subject to the same regime.

Deze leden constateren dat op deze manier nog steeds vele miljarden aan belasting gaat worden ontweken en verzoeken de regering het wetsvoorstel dusdanig aan te passen dat alle leningen vanuit eigen vennootschappen aan bestuurders onderworpen worden aan hetzelfde regime.
Asks whether alternatives such as a full ban or treating loans as box 2 benefits were considered, and why the owner-home exception and EUR 500,000 threshold were chosen.
The PvdA members ask whether and which other options were considered to solve the problem and why these were not chosen.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of en welke andere mogelijkheden zijn overwogen om het probleem op te lossen en waarom daar niet voor is gekozen.
Endorses the principle of tackling unjust tax deferral while raising several further questions on the measure's design.
They acknowledge that it is unjust when DGAs can defer or even waive tax by withdrawing excessive liquid funds as loans from their own company.
Zij erkennen dat het onrechtvaardig is wanneer DGA’s door excessief liquide middelen als lening aan de eigen vennootschap te onttrekken belastingheffing kunnen uit- of zelfs afstellen.
Asks for precise objectives, measurable effectiveness, estimates of avoided tax, and justification of the threshold and timing.
These members ask what the precise objectives of the bill are.
Deze leden vragen wat de precieze doelen van het wetsvoorstel zijn.
Questions why business loans are targeted, the lack of transitional rules for legal certainty, and the risk of loan carrousels and dependence on banks.
Member Van Haga notes that there is hardly any transitional arrangement.
Het lid Van Haga constateert dat er nauwelijks sprake is van een overgangsregeling.
Questions the bill's enforceability and proportionality, and asks why the government ignored the Raad van State's advice to investigate effects first and to respect existing debts.
The VVD members still have difficulty with the ease with which the government dismisses the Council of State's negative advice.
De leden van de VVD-fractie blijven tevens moeite hebben met het gemak waarmee de regering het negatieve advies van de Raad van State van de hand wijst.
Asks for better justification of the bill's effectiveness, the retroactive effect and the legal certainty of existing loans, and questions the double taxation effects.
These members therefore ask the government whether the legislation, because of its retroactive effect, is not in conflict with legal certainty and whether that is justified at this time.
Deze leden vragen de regering daarom dan ook of de wetgeving vanwege de terugwerkende kracht niet in strijd is met de rechtszekerheid en of dat in deze tijd gerechtvaardigd is.
Asks technical questions about possible tax advantages of dividends, rechtsvormneutraliteit and interactions between box 2 and box 3.
The D66 members ask whether there may also be advantages to paying out dividends instead of borrowing from one's own company.</evidence_en>
De leden van de fractie van D66 vragen of er mogelijk ook voordelen bestaan voor het uitkeren van dividenden in plaats van het lenen van de eigen bv.
Argues the EUR 500,000 threshold is arbitrary and that mortgages should be included, and points to an unequal treatment between private and business wealth.
The SP members note that the EUR 500,000 limit appears mainly to be a financial choice, with a large amount borrowed by a small number of individuals to avoid tax.</evidence_en>

De leden van de SP-fractie merken op dat de begrenzing op 500.000 euro vooral een financiële keuze lijkt waarbij een groot bedrag dat door een klein aantal individuen is geleend om belasting te ontwijken.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised against proceeding with the bill on excessive loans from one's own company (Wet excessief lenen bij eigen vennootschap) until the results of the dga capital-income study are known, and raised concerns about its purpose, effectiveness, and retroactive effect on existing debts. The government's reply accepts the timing advice in part by pointing to the bouwstenen study, defends the EUR 500,000 threshold and the mortgage exception, and postpones the entry-into-force date by one year to 1 January 2023 to meet the legal certainty concern.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the purpose, the size of the problem, and the effectiveness of the bill, asking for evidence on how many shareholder debts are non-arm's length or disguised dividends and how often tax is permanently waived.
The Afdeling advised respecting existing debts, which taxpayers may rely on in good faith, or at least providing a longer transition period; the government postponed entry into force by one year.
The Afdeling noted the bill is technically complex, does not simplify tax law, and that case-by-case enforcement might be preferable for a small number of cases.
The Afdeling asked why the EUR 500,000 threshold was chosen and why loans for the owner-occupied home are exempted, while the government defended the threshold as a balanced signal.
The Afdeling noted that tax treaties may need amendment to tax non-resident taxpayers on the imputed benefit.
The Afdeling made editorial remarks on the consistency between the text of article 4.43(4) Wet IB 2001 and its explanatory note, which were adopted.

35559.s: The bill implements Directive 2019/878/EU (CRD V) and parts of Regulation 2019/876 (CRR II) into the Dutch financial supervision act, covering prudential rules for banks and investment firms, remuneration, supervisory measures, and group supervision. It introduces a holding-approval regime for financial holdings, new capital conservation and leverage buffer rules, and expanded supervisory powers and cooperation duties for De Nederlandsche Bank.
35559.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new supervisory powers as necessary to implement the EU directive and regulation, which largely dictate content and leave limited national discretion.
q: Transposing the provisions of the amending regulation is not necessary because of its direct effect, and is also not permitted.
Omzetting van de bepalingen uit de wijzigingsverordening is vanwege de rechtstreekse werking daarvan niet nodig en ook niet toegestaan.
d: conditions for inspecting personal data at supervisor's office
exceptions to distribution bans for banks failing leverage buffer
content of notification and capital conservation plan
temporary prudential rules by DNB in consultation with minister
procedures for notifying changes to consolidating supervisor
p: DNB may suspend voting rights, order divestment, or designate another entity responsible for holding-level compliance where a holding fails approval requirements.
Supervisor must impose capital measures in specified circumstances and may set stricter conditions and interest-rate risk assumptions.
DNB grants or withdraws approval and exemption for financial holdings based on defined criteria and supervisor determinations.
Supervisor may share confidential information with IMF, World Bank, BIS and Financial Stability Board when statutory conditions are met.

parties: Asks for details on how the bill affects bank capital levels, remuneration rules, lidstaatopties and supervisory costs, and requests an integral revision of the Wet op het financieel toezicht that the Raad van State criticised for poor accessibility.

It seems to them that the large Dutch banks already meet the new leverage ratio, net stable funding ratio and total loss absorbing capacity requirements, all the more so as these have been known for some time.

Het komt hun voor dat de Nederlandse grootbanken inmiddels voldoen aan de nieuwe eisen aan leverage ratio, net stable funding ratio en total loss absorbing capacity, temeer omdat deze al geruime tijd bekend zijn.
Questions the growing complexity of the rules and the member-state options that hinder harmonisation, and asks about the timing of a second related bill.

They note that there is a increasingly complex system of laws and regulations which, now that member states can also use member-state options differently, has in certain respects not led to the intended harmonisation of capital requirement rules.

Zij merken op dat er sprake is van een steeds complexer systeem van wet- en regelgeving dat, nu lidstaten ook nog verschillend gebruik kunnen maken van lidstaatopties, in bepaalde opzichten niet heeft geleid tot de beoogde harmonisatie van de regelgeving op het gebied van kapitaalvereisten.
Asks whether the bill transfers more national sovereignty to Brussels and how the COVID-19 relaxation of capital requirements interacts with the bill.
Furthermore, the PVV members want to know whether certain amendments in the bill entail transferring more national sovereignty from member states to Brussels and, if so, which amendments these are.

Voorts willen de leden van de PVV-fractie weten of bepaalde wijzigingen in het wetsvoorstel gepaard gaan met het afdragen van meer nationale soevereiniteit van lidstaten aan Brussel en zo ja, om welke wijzigingen het gaat.

Supports completing the banking union and Basel III, but asks for a timeline of Basel agreement, the Commission proposal, and how the pillar 2 guidance will be applied in practice, including what 'herhaaldelijk' means.
How should the word 'repeatedly' be read in this context?
Hoe moet het woord «herhaaldelijk» in deze context worden gelezen?

Criticises the transfer of direct supervision to the ECB as a sovereignty transfer, the looser supervisory framework for investment firms, shareholder approval of bonus caps up to 200%, and the lack of supervisory capacity.
Why was it chosen to allow shareholders, owners or partners of the undertakings to approve a bonus cap of up to 200% of annual remuneration?
Waarom is ervoor gekozen toe te staan dat aandeelhouders, eigenaren of vennoten van de ondernemingen daar een bonusplafond van maximaal 200% van de jaarlijkse beloning kunnen goedkeuren?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division issued critical remarks on the Implementatiewet kapitaalvereisten 2020, notably on the misapplication of a member-state option for bonus exemptions, the scope of financial holding approval, and the necessity of personal data exchange. The Minister's reply largely accepted the remarks on delegation, scope, and data protection, but rejected the call to set a transitional timeline for Wft accessibility and kept the 10% threshold with added justification.
concerns: The bonus-cap option was regulated via a DNB supervisory regulation lacking a sufficient statutory basis; the Minister moved the rule into the Wft itself as Article 1:117(5).
The 10% threshold for the staff exemption misapplied the member-state option; the Minister justified it with added explanation rather than reverting to the directive's 33%.
Absence of a transitional period for subsidiaries newly placed under the bonus cap raises property-protection concerns; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on this point.
Scope of holding approval and ECB versus DNB competence was unclear; articles were amended and the explanatory memorandum clarified which supervisor decides.
The scope of the intermediate EU parent requirement was too broad; it was restricted to institutions seated in the Netherlands.
Personal data exchange with international bodies needed justification and safeguards; a delegation basis and limits on categories of data were added.
The Afdeling asked for a timeline and conditions for structurally improving Wft accessibility; the Minister declined, judging a full overhaul disproportionate.

35568.s: The bill restricts the Dutch corporate income tax liquidation and cessation loss schemes by capping losses above EUR 5 million unless the subsidiary or activity is in the EU, EEA, or a designated associated state, and by imposing a three-year deadline for completing liquidation or ceasing profits, with a counter-evidence exception. It also sets transitional rules for pre-2021 cases and entry into force on 1 January 2021.
35568.j: The memorandum justifies the restrictions as preventing long-delayed loss deduction and abuse, and the ministerial designation of associated states as keeping the rule in line with EU freedom of establishment.
q: The liquidation loss is not taken into account at an amount higher than EUR 5,000,000, unless
Het liquidatieverlies wordt niet tot een hoger bedrag dan € 5.000.000 in aanmerking genomen, tenzij
d: ARTIKEL I, B.2 (art. 13d, tweede lid, sub a.2)
designating non-EU states with EU association agreements
designating non-EU states with EU association agreements for cessation losses
p: ARTIKEL I, B (art. 13d, tweede lid, including counter-evidence rule)
Tax authorities must assess whether subsidiary liquidation was aimed at avoiding or deferring tax, shifting a burden of proof onto taxpayers in a counter-evidence rule.

parties: Asks about effects on SMEs, comparison with neighbouring countries, budget sensitivity and transitional rules, without raising checks on the executive.
Can the government indicate how it is prevented that SME companies are disproportionately affected?
Kan de regering aangeven op welke manier voorkomen wordt dat mkb-bedrijven onevenredig geraakt worden?

Welcomes the anti-avoidance aim but worries the conditions may discourage legitimate investment, asks for justification of the territorial and quantitative conditions and warns that fraus legis is an insufficient tool against splitting investments.

They consider fraus legis insufficient as a basis for this because it addresses generic incorrect application of the law, whereas an explicit and specific anti-abuse provision would be more appropriate.

Zij achten fraus legis als basis hiervoor niet toereikend omdat dit generieke onjuiste wetstoepassing bestrijdt, terwijl een expliciete en specifieke antimisbruikbepaling hier meer op zijn plaats zou zijn.
Sees the bill as a balanced approach tackling tax avoidance while keeping an attractive investment climate, and asks factual questions about affected companies and EU comparisons.
The D66 members consider this bill a balanced approach to preserving an attractive investment climate.
De leden van de D66-fractie beschouwen dit wetsvoorstel als een evenwichtige aanpak voor het behouden van een aantrekkelijk vestigingsklimaat.
Welcomes the government taking over the initiative bill and asks how the Tax Authority will monitor splitting of investments and whether anti-abuse measures will be needed.
How will the government monitor whether investments are split by companies to use the threshold multiple times?
Hoe gaat de regering monitoren of investeringen bijvoorbeeld worden «opgeknipt» door bedrijven om meerdere malen gebruik te maken van de franchise?
Broadly satisfied with the implementation of the initiative bill, considers it necessary to stop profit shifting, and asks for comparisons and the test of control criteria against EU case law.
This law repairs this imbalance and the PvdA members therefore consider this law absolutely necessary.
Deze wet repareert deze onevenwichtigheid en de leden van de PvdA-fractie achten deze wet dan ook hoogstnoodzakelijk.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft Dutch corporate tax bill restricting the liquidation and cessation loss schemes, raising concerns about the start of the three-year period, the counter-evidence rule, the meaning of decisive influence, and retroactive effect. The government's reply accepted clarifications and amendments on several points while defending the absence of transitional rules for the quantitative and territorial conditions.
concerns: The start of the three-year period was unclear when the business ceased in a different calendar year than the decision; the bill was amended so the earlier moment governs.
The stringent counter-evidence rule referring generally to taxation was unclear and burdensome; the government limited it to corporate income tax but kept the heightened burden of proof.
The notion of qualifying interest based on decisive influence lacked clarity; the government referred to case law and the facts of each case without further elaboration.

Material retroactive effect of the quantitative and territorial conditions on ongoing liquidation trajectories raises legal certainty concerns; the government declined transitional rules, citing the announcement on Prinsjesdag 2019.
Redactional comments on wording, such as replacing calendar years with years and clarifying delegation grounds, were largely adopted.

35577.s: The bill raises the tax-free allowance in box 3 wealth tax, raises the box 3 rate to 31%, and changes the return-base brackets, while requiring the tax inspector to issue appealable decisions stating the return base (above EUR 31,340) and green investments, so that income-dependent benefits can continue to rely on the wealth test. It also updates related benefit laws (zorgtoeslag, kindgebonden budget, rechtsbijstand, eigenwoningbezit) and extends information-gathering powers to these decisions.
35577.j: The memorandum justifies the new information powers by the need to verify wealth for tax control and to let benefit administrators continue relying on the wealth test, and it stresses that decisions are appealable.
q: What is also new is that the decision is established as a decision open to objection and appeal.
Nieuw is ook dat de beschikking wordt vastgesteld in een voor bezwaar en beroep vatbare beschikking.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel E (artikel 9.4a, eerste lid)
inspector's determination of return base and green investment amounts
Artikel IV (artikel 2a Wet op de zorgtoeslag, derde lid)
raising the zorgtoeslag wealth thresholds by general administrative order
Artikel VI en VII (Wet uitkeringen burger-oorlogsslachtoffers / vervolgingsslachtoffers)
amount of capital income exempted from benefit calculation
p: Artikel I, onderdeel E (artikel 9.4a) en Artikel II (AWR artikelen 7a en 56a)

The tax inspector receives extended powers to request wealth information and to revise return-base decisions, including on the basis of facts the taxpayer acted in bad faith about, with the decisions appealable.
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 9.6, vierde lid)
Decisions under the new article are deemed part of the assessment, so appeals against refusals of ex officio reduction cover the whole assessment.
Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 9.4, eerste lid, onderdeel c) en artikel 9.4a, derde en vierde lid
The inspector may revise return-base decisions upward if there is a suspicion of an understated amount, with only limited restriction on facts the inspector already knew of.

parties: Asks whether the bill is legally sustainable given earlier court rulings on the wealth-return tax and requests calculations of effects.
The VVD members ask about the sustainability of the present bill in view of earlier court rulings on the wealth-return tax.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen naar de houdbaarheid van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel ten opzichte van de eerdere juridische uitspraken rond de vermogensrendementsheffing.
Asks what research preceded the bill and how it affects ongoing procedures on the box 3 tax.
Can the government explain to what extent it expects this to affect ongoing or future procedures on the box 3 tax?
Kan de regering nader toelichten in welke mate zij verwacht dat dit al dan niet invloed heeft op reeds lopende dan wel nog op te starten procedures omtrent de box-3-heffing?
Argues the box 3 burden remains unjust, notes legal problems and asks how the government will respond to Supreme Court rulings.
How does the government intend to respond to the Supreme Court rulings, which have repeatedly found a violation at the level of the system?
Hoe gaat de regering om met de arresten van de Hoge Raad, waarin meermaals is geoordeeld dat sprake is van een schending op stelselniveau?
Sees the bill as an interim step toward taxing real returns and asks about administrative burdens on taxpayers who must file.
These members note it is positive that fewer taxpayers suffer from forfait taxation of wealth returns, but regard this as an interim solution.
Deze leden constateren dat het positief is dat minder belastingplichtigen last hebben van het forfaitair belasten van rendement op vermogen, maar beschouwen dit als tussenoplossing.
Criticises the weakened bill, especially the exemption of debt, and asks why leverage is no longer discouraged.
The GroenLinks members are very critical that debts are exempted for tax purposes in the present bill.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie zijn zeer kritisch over het gegeven dat schulden in het onderhavige voorstel fiscaal ontzien worden.
Calls the bill a disappointing compromise that ignores the Supreme Court ruling and imposes fundamental injustice on savers and letter-of-claim victims.
According to the SP members, this bill leaves a fundamental injustice in place.
Met dit wetsvoorstel blijft naar de mening van de leden van de SP-fractie een fundamenteel onrecht bestaan.
Accepts the bill as limiting harm to small savers but stresses that legal sustainability requires further reform toward real returns.
The need for further reform to keep the box 3 scheme legally sustainable has not disappeared.
De noodzaak voor een verdergaande hervorming om de box 3-regeling ook juridisch houdbaar te houden/maken is daarmee echter niet weg.
Asks whether the measure is a real step toward real-return taxation and what additional short-term options exist after objections such as the Supreme Court's.
The SGP members also ask for more insight into what additional short-term steps are possible toward taxation based on real returns.
Tevens vragen de leden van de SGP-fractie naar meer inzicht in wat op korte termijn additioneel mogelijk is om te komen tot een heffing op basis van werkelijk rendement.
Considers box 3 untenable when taxpayers pay more than their actual investment income and asks about the consequences of Supreme Court rulings.
They consider the design of box 3 untenable as long as taxpayers in some cases must pay more tax than the investment income they receive.
Zij achten de vormgeving van box 3 onhoudbaar zolang belastingplichtigen in voorkomende gevallen meer moeten afdragen aan belasting dan wat zij aan «vermogensinkomsten» genieten.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill raising the box 3 tax-free allowance to €50,000 and the box 3 rate to 31%, criticising the postponement of a structural box 3 reform, the non-harmonised asset concept in means tests, the heavy implementation burden on the Belastingdienst, and the broad data collection via tax returns, and advising not to submit the bill unless adapted. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely rejects the objections, defending the bill's cost-benefit balance while making some clarifications and technical and drafting amendments.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that the postponement of a structural box 3 reform to a distant horizon undermines public support and government credibility, given the Hoge Raad ruling on the rechtstekort, and asks what can be done sooner.

The Afdeling asks for justification of abandoning the harmonised asset-concept in means tests and the introduction of two decisions, which complicates the framework; the government explains its reasons and clarifies the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asks for more substantive discussion of the Belastingdienst's critical implementation test, which flags IT and process risks; the government judges the risks manageable and treats the bill as implementable.

The Afdeling questions whether the small benefit of up to €106 per taxpayer justifies the many legislative changes and implementation complications, and asks the government to reconsider the trade-offs; the government concludes the benefits clearly outweigh the side effects.

The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to address GDPR principles (lawful basis, purpose limitation, data minimisation) for requiring box 3 asset data from non-taxable persons; the government supplemented the memorandum but argues all invitees are taxpayers.

The Afdeling asks how the inspector can enforce correct and complete return information when it does not affect tax owed, and whether the penalty regime suffices; the government says the existing penalty regime is adequate.
The Afdeling makes technical and redactional remarks on consistency between the bill text and explanatory memorandum, terminology, and cross-references, which the government largely adopted.

35595.s: The bill amends the Verzamelwet Brexit to extend a temporary delegation basis for social security laws (Wlz and Zvw) beyond the transition period, allowing the UK to be treated as an EU member state for a set period by general administrative order subject to later parliamentary approval. It also removes or adjusts several provisions in the Wlz, Zvw, income tax and wage tax laws that refer to EU-linked rights under the Withdrawal Agreement and makes the effective dates retroactive.
35595.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to prepare for the end of the transition period and to prevent disproportionate disadvantage to insured persons in the UK and the Netherlands.
q: By general administrative order it may be provided in the Wlz and Zvw that the United Kingdom, after withdrawal from the EU, is still treated as an EU member state for the application of those laws for a specified period.

Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kan in de Wet langdurige zorg en de Zorgverzekeringswet worden bepaald dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk na de terugtrekking uit de Europese Unie voor de toepassing van die wetten gedurende een daarbij aangegeven periode nog als EU-lidstaat wordt aangemerkt
d: treating UK as EU member state for Wlz and Zvw purposes and transitional rules
submission of approval bill to Tweede Kamer within eight weeks
p: Allows the government to alter the application of social security statutes to UK residents by general administrative order, but the order must be submitted for parliamentary approval and withdrawn if rejected.

parties: Worries that the Belastingdienst's systems may not be adjusted in time, so taxpayers might be misdirected to the wrong scheme, possibly paying too much tax or being wrongly seen as fraudsters.
The final verdict of the implementation test states that the proposal is feasible provided it is accepted that the tax return systems may not be adjusted in time.
In het eindoordeel van de uitvoeringstoets staat dat «het voorstel uitvoerbaar [is] mits wordt geaccepteerd dat de aangiftesystemen mogelijk niet tijdig zijn aangepast.
Criticises article X's catch-all power, which takes its input mainly from Brussels, and asks which EU measures after the transition period could rely on it.
Partly because the input for this provision and its use come mainly from Brussels, one of the most undemocratic bodies that exists.</evidence_en>
Onder andere doordat de input voor deze bepaling en het gebruik ervan voornamelijk uit Brussel komt, één van de meest ondemocratische instanties die er bestaat.

Argues that the derogation power in article X undermines the primacy of the legislature and the legality principle, asks for an explicit acknowledgement of this, and questions whether Parliament could be sidelined if the Eerste Kamer rejects the bill after January.

The derogation possibility undermines the primacy of the legislature and a core element of the rule of law which, under the legality principle, requires government action to rest on a prior general regulation.</evidence_en>

De derogatie-mogelijkheid doet afbreuk aan het primaat van de wetgever en aan een kernelement van de rechtsstaat dat krachtens het legaliteitsbeginsel eist dat overheidshandelen dient te berusten op een voorafgaande algemene regeling.
Welcomes that safeguards added by the Chamber remain in place, but questions the proportionality and the six-month duration of the far-reaching temporary powers of article X.
However, they consider it important that a law like this, with temporarily far-reaching powers, is proportionate.</evidence_en>
Wel vinden zij het van belang dat een wet als deze, met tijdelijk vergaande bevoegdheden, proportioneel is.
Finds it worrying that the government extends the omnibus law's temporary arrangements, especially the catch-all authorisation, and demands a guarantee that this is the last time it is used.
Asks whether there is clarity on how possible care arrangements after the transition period will be made, to offset disadvantage for insured persons.
Is there already some clarity on how those possible arrangements will then be made, ask the PvdA members?</evidence_en>
Is er al enige duidelijkheid over hoe die mogelijke voorzieningen dan getroffen zullen worden, zo vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie?
Asks why acute intervention through article X is still needed given the longer preparation period, and whether situations could instead be regulated by specific statutory provisions.
the question arises where the government's need for urgent intervention in a given area still lies.</evidence_en>
doemt de vraag op waar de noodzaak tot acuut ingrijpen van de regering op een bepaald terrein dan nog in is gelegen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised a targeted drafting change to article X of the Verzamelwet Brexit, replacing a 'mutatis mutandis' reference with a direct amendment of paragraph 1 so that temporary powers can be used in the six months after the transition period ends. The minister's nader rapport accepts the advice, makes the change, and adds further editorial corrections, a retroactivity clause, and the advisory's formatting suggestions in part.
concerns: The Afdeling advised amending article X, paragraph 1 directly rather than applying it by analogy through a new paragraph 11, to avoid misunderstanding and clarify the delegation basis.

The Afdeling advised a separate general and article-by-article part of the explanatory memorandum, the government's redactional suggestions were followed except that splitting the explanatory memorandum was not adopted.

35650-III.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of General Affairs as a second supplementary budget, lowering expenditure on policy article 1 by 2,174 thousand euro and changing commitments and revenues accordingly. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 1 December 2020.
q: The expenditure under this article is adjusted downward by € 2,174,000.
De uitgaven op dit artikel worden met € 2.174.000 neerwaarts bijgesteld.

35658.s: The bill designates the Minister of Education, Culture and Science and the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport as national authorities and selects national agencies and an independent audit body to implement the Erasmus+ and European Solidarity Corps regulations. It also allows the ministers to attach conditions to designations, withdraw them, and issue further coordination rules by ministerial regulation.
35658.j: The memorandum justifies excluding Kaderwet powers by pointing to the task division already set out in the EU regulation, which leaves no room for national rules or annulment.
q: A power to annul a decision of a zbo would conflict with the task division laid down in the Erasmus regulation.
Een bevoegdheid om een besluit van een zbo te vernietigen is in strijd met de, hiervoor toegelichte, in de Erasmusverordening neergelegde taakverdeling.
d: conditions attached to national agency designation
coordination rules between national authorities and agencies
p: The minister may withdraw a national agency designation and appoint another agency for the rest of the programme period if the agency no longer meets requirements.
Several articles of the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, including ministerial annulment and intervention powers, do not apply to the national agencies.

parties: Asks for justification of Dutch position, participation figures, and whether budgets were fully spent in 2020.
Were both amounts fully used in 2020, or is there underspending?
Zijn beide bedragen volledig benut in 2020 of is er sprake van onderuitputting?
Has no objections to the bill but asks how talks with the United Kingdom on a replacement student exchange are progressing.
What is the status of this consultation?
Hoe staat het met dit overleg?
Asks whether private legal persons may be designated as national agencies and whether this fits the state's financial and steering relationship.
Does that fit within the financial and steering relationship of the state with the organisations concerned?
Past dat binnen de financiële relatie en de sturingsrelatie van het Rijk met de betreffende organisaties?
Questions the stated aim of strengthening European identity and whether the Solidarity Corps could displace paid work or internships.
This is all admirable, these members think, but could it not lead to displacement on the labour market or a reduction in possible internship places?
Dit is uiteraard allemaal bewonderenswaardig menen deze leden, maar kan dit niet leiden tot verdringing op de arbeidsmarkt of een vermindering van mogelijke stageplaatsen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the need for national rules on the Erasmus+ and European Solidarity Corps programmes, but asks that the explanatory memorandum clarify why a statutory basis for designating the national agencies is needed now and why private-law independent administrative bodies were chosen, plus a drafting remark on article 3(6). The government's reply states the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented on these points and the drafting remark was adopted.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should explain why a statutory basis is needed now for designating national agencies that have long performed these tasks.
The memorandum should justify the choice for private-law independent administrative bodies (zbo's) as the form for the national agencies.
Article 3(6) should also provide that article 19(3) of the Kaderwet zbo's does not apply.

35667.s: The bill amends the Wvggz (compulsory mental health care) and the Wzd (care and coercion for psychogeriatric and intellectually disabled clients) to simplify implementation and fix technical omissions. Key changes include requiring the BSN for inspection oversight, allowing the court to suspend its decision deadline for expert examinations, and converting several administrative fines into orders under penalty.
35667.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers and delegations by the need for effective inspection oversight, workable court procedures and simplified enforcement, and it notes that the inspectorate supports the changes.
q: It is of great importance that the inspectorate can exercise good and effective supervision over the implementation of compulsory care under the Wvggz and involuntary care under the Wzd.
Het is van groot belang dat de inspectie goed en effectief toezicht kan houden op de uitvoering van verplichte zorg in de Wvggz en onvrijwillige zorg in de Wzd.
d: rules on drawing up, adopting and evaluating care plans
ARTIKEL II, Q (artikel 19, nieuw derde lid)
care provider policy plan with client council advice
p: ARTIKEL I, I (artikel 6:6, nieuw lid 2) and ARTIKEL I, J (artikel 6:2, nieuw vierde lid)
Allows the judge to postpone the decision deadline for expert examinations, extending existing care orders until the ruling; this expands judicial discretion rather than reducing it.
ARTIKEL I, KK (artikel 13:4) and ARTIKEL I, JJ (artikel 13:3a)
Enables oral orders by the public prosecutor and oral authorisations by the investigating judge in urgent cases to locate persons who have evaded care, with written confirmation within three days.
ARTIKEL I, KK (artikel 13:4, invoking administrative fines and penalties)
Shifts enforcement from punitive fines toward reparatory orders under penalty, with serious cases referred to prosecution.
Allows the mayor to enforce orders within 24 hours, use care workers and police, enter premises and search persons and dwellings without consent when reasonably necessary.
ARTIKEL II, B (artikel 3, vijfde en achtste lid)

Removes the requirement that a representative be legally competent or that the treating physician not be the representative, and makes representation of incapable clients fall to a non-involved expert.

parties: Asks how quickly judges handle petitions and whether a care order remains valid while a new petition is pending, which could disadvantage the person concerned.
Is it correct that the care order in this case remains valid until the judge has decided on the new petition?
Klopt het dat de zorgmachtiging in dit geval geldig blijft totdat de rechter een beslissing heeft genomen over het nieuwe verzoekschrift?
Worries that simplification conflicts with the legal certainty of people subject to coerced care, and questions dropping the decision deadline and the second independent medical certificate.
Coerced care requires care, with the rights and freedoms of those involved guaranteed as well as possible.
Gedwongen zorg vereist zorgvuldigheid, waarbij de rechten en vrijheden van betrokkenen zo goed mogelijk gewaarborgd dienen te worden.
Supports keeping the client central and reducing administrative burden, but questions whether the judiciary is equipped for the flexibility granted and whether client legal position is protected.
According to these members, it is of the greatest importance that the client is central in the vulnerable situations these laws concern.
Volgens genoemde leden is het van het grootste belang dat de cliënt centraal staat in de kwetsbare situaties waar deze wetten betrekking op hebben.
Asks who appoints the independent expert who decides when the client's representative and a professional disagree, and whether parties have a say in that choice.
Who may exactly be given this role of independent expert? Do the parties have a say in who is chosen as independent expert?
Wie mag deze rol van onafhankelijke deskundige precies krijgen? Hebben de partijen er inspraak in wie wordt gekozen als onafhankelijke deskundige?
Has long opposed the Wzd on feasibility grounds and calls the simplification modest, asking the government to consult sector organisations again about remaining problems.
However, they see that the vast majority of the bill concerns small technical legal amendments and that the proposals to simplify the Wzd's feasibility are rather limited.
Zij zien echter dat het overgrote deel van het wetsvoorstel kleine wetstechnische wijzigingen betreft en dat de voorstellen ter vereenvoudiging van de uitvoerbaarheid van de Wzd nogal beperkt zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a technical amendment bill to the Wet verplichte geestelijke gezondheidszorg and the Wet zorg en dwang, finding no substantive remarks and recommending submission to the House. The government's reply (nader rapport) states that the advisory division raised no substantive points and that only some editorial improvements were made.
concerns: The advisory division made no substantive remarks and the government adopted some editorial improvements to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35685.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) through a second supplementary budget, adding 20,000 thousand euro to the policy articles, mainly for specific adjustments to the economic support and recovery package. It takes effect on 1 January 2021 or the day after publication, with retroactive effect to 1 January if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35739.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, adding extra funds for final exams in secondary education and rapid COVID-19 test pilots in primary education. It sets figures in thousands of euros and takes effect retroactively from 22 February 2021.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35748.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, adding a 1,110,000 thousand euro expenditure line for the public transport availability fee (beschikbaarheidsvergoeding OV-sector). It takes effect the day after publication and is retroactive to 1 January 2021.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35757.s: The bill amends the Drinkwaterwet to extend the weighted average cost-of-capital period and the maximum equity share for drinking water companies from two to three years, bring forward the tariff compensation year, and clarify rules on signalling parameters for drinking water and surface water. It also adds a ministerial power to set microbiological or chemical quality requirements by ministerial regulation where needed to protect public health.
35757.j: The memorandum justifies the new ministerial power by the need to respond to emerging substances that require quality requirements faster than a Dwb amendment would allow, and subjects that regulation to a voorhang procedure.
q: The intended amendment of the Dwb will be submitted to both chambers of the States General via the voorhang procedure under article 1, paragraph 7, of the Dww.
De voorgenomen wijziging van het Dwb wordt via de voorhangprocedure op grond van artikel 1, zevende lid, van de Dww aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal voorgelegd.
d: I-D (art. 21 Dww, derde lid, onderdeel d)
remedial measures and investigation on drinking water quality breaches
temporary exemptions from chemical parameter requirements granted by minister or inspector
quality requirements for surface water used for drinking water production
I-D (Dwb ministerial power, via art. 21 derde lid Dww)
emergency microbiological or chemical quality requirement for drinking water
p: I-B (art. 10 Dww, tweede en derde lid)
Allows the minister to extend a set WACC period by up to two further calendar years, limited to cases where continuity or safety of supply requires it.
Gives the minister or inspector power to grant temporary exemptions from chemical quality parameters where public health interests do not oppose it.

parties: Asks about the timing of the WACC extension, the long-term framework and whether the changes secure sufficient investment capacity.
These members ask what this exploration entails.
Deze leden vragen wat deze verkenning behelst.
Welcomes the bill as part of a broader reform but asks for timelines on further research and a totaalpakket of structural measures.
Finally, these members ask when the government will inform the House about all structural and long-term solutions to the financing problems of drinking water companies as a package of measures.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen tenslotte wanneer de regering de Kamer over alle structurele en langetermijnoplossingen voor de financieringsproblematiek van de drinkwaterbedrijven informeert als een totaalpakket van maatregelen.
Asks for guarantees that tariffs will not rise and whether the government retains enough influence over the drinking water monopoly.
The PVV members ask the government whether, with this WACC methodology, it still has sufficient influence over the monopoly of drinking water companies.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen aan de regering of zij met deze WACC-methodiek nog voldoende invloed heeft op het monopolie van drinkwaterbedrijven.
Asks about the timing of the framework, the WACC level needed, and the government's oversight of wastewater discharges and precautionary principle.
These members ask why the Minister does not decide in the short term to extend the current WACC.
Deze leden vragen waarom de Minister niet op korte termijn besluit tot verlenging van de huidige WACC
Raises concern about drinking water contamination from soil energy boreholes and asks for stricter and more thorough supervision.
At the same time, these members also want the government to ensure stricter and more thorough supervision.
Tegelijkertijd willen deze leden ook dat de regering zorgdraagt voor een strenger en uitvoeriger toezicht.
Supports the change but asks the government to examine how polluters, not consumers, can be made to pay avoidable treatment costs.
These members ask the government to examine how drinking water consumers can be prevented from bearing the avoidable costs caused by permitted or avoidable pollution.
Deze leden vragen de regering om te onderzoeken hoe kan worden voorkomen dat de drinkwaterconsumenten moeten opdraaien voor de vermijdbare kosten veroorzaakt door vergunde of vermijdbare vervuiling.
Asks whether the proposals sufficiently resolve financing problems and when structural solutions will be communicated.
These members are also very curious when the government will inform the House about structural solutions to the financing problems of the drinking water companies.
Deze leden zijn ook erg benieuwd wanneer de regering de Kamer informeert over structurele oplossingen voor de financieringsproblematiek van de drinkwaterbedrijven.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering had no remarks on the draft amendment to the Drinkwaterwet extending the water companies' cost-of-capital period and clarifying signalling parameters, and advised submitting it to parliament. The minister's nader rapport confirms the advice was taken note of and explains technical changes, including dropping an earlier accelerated deadline and extending the current WACC by two years via a separate amendment.

35775.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and its member states and Japan, signed in Tokyo on 17 July 2018, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. The explanatory memorandum notes the agreement covers both EU exclusive and shared competences, that provisional application of parts began on 1 February 2019, and that it contains no provisions directly binding on individuals.
35775.j: The memorandum justifies approval by reference to the EU's competences under the Treaty on the Functioning of the EU and the Council decision on signature and provisional application, with no new executive powers claimed.
q: In the government's view, the Agreement contains no provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution that directly grant rights to or impose obligations on legal subjects.

Naar het oordeel van de regering bevat de Overeenkomst geen een ieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van de artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet, die aan rechtssubjecten rechtstreeks rechten toekennen of plichten opleggen.

parties: D66 has no further questions on the agreement.
These members have no further questions.
Deze leden hebben geen verdere vragen.

CDA asks how investor-state dispute settlement is being negotiated, notes the EU favours an investment court while Japan prefers arbitration, and asks about a multilateral dispute court and evaluation of the agreement.
Officially, the EU and Japan are still negotiating over investor-state dispute settlement.
Officieel wordt er nog steeds onderhandeld tussen de EU en Japan over geschillenbeslechting tussen investeerders en staten.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the bill approving the EU-Japan Strategic Partnership Agreement and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Foreign Affairs forwards the advice and confirms the bill is sent to parliament without changes.

35784.s: The bill proposes a constitutional amendment adding to Article 17 of the Constitution a right to a fair trial within a reasonable time before an independent and impartial judge, when rights and obligations are determined or a criminal charge is assessed. It completes the second reading required after the 2018 declaratory act and refers to the earlier parliamentary documents for further explanation.
35784.j: The memorandum justifies the amendment by pointing to the completed first reading after the 2018 declaratory act and refers to earlier documents for the substantive reasoning.
q: With the publication of the Act of 21 February 2018 (Stb. 2018, 88), the first reading of this constitutional proposal has been completed.
Met de bekendmaking van de wet van 21 februari 2018 ( Stb. 2018, 88 ) is de eerste lezing van dit grondwetsvoorstel afgerond.

parties: Supports enshrining the right to a fair trial in the Constitution and raises no questions.
Because it concerns a fundamental right, the VVD fractie considers it a good thing that the right to a fair trial is now also enshrined in our Constitution.
Daar het om een fundamenteel recht gaat, achten de leden van de VVD-fractie het een goede zaak dat het recht op een eerlijk proces nu ook in onze Grondwet wordt vastgelegd.

Asks how the provision relates to ECHR Article 6, whether it is a subjective right enforceable in court, how it interacts with the review ban in Article 120, and what positive obligations and effects on legal aid, court fees and case duration follow.
Furthermore, these members ask the government to what extent the review ban laid down in Article 120 of the Constitution stands in the way of full enforcement of this fundamental right by citizens.
Voorts vragen deze leden de regering in hoeverre het toetsings-verbod als neergelegd in artikel 120 Grondwet aan (volledige) effectuering van dit grondrecht door burgers in de weg staat.
Supports constitutional anchoring of an independent and impartial judge for all legal areas and asks for further reflection, in light of the Kinderopvangtoeslag inquiry.
These members agree that a right to a fair trial before an independent and impartial judge for all legal areas should be constitutionally anchored.
Deze leden onderschrijven, dat een recht op een eerlijk proces voor een onafhankelijke en onpartijdige rechter voor alle rechtsgebieden grondwettelijk verankerd behoort te zijn.
Has not changed its view since the first reading and sees no reason for further remarks.
They see no reason to make further remarks.
Zij zien geen aanlei-ding voor het maken van verdere opmerkingen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division issued an opinion on a bill amending the Constitution to add a provision on the right to a fair trial, and made no remarks on the proposal, advising its submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport simply forwards the bill, so no substantive reply to objections was needed.

35793.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H), adding a second incidental supplementary budget for food aid, a fifth tranche of liquidity support for Aruba, and support measures for Caribbean Netherlands. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the act retroactive to 12 March 2021.
q: For the BES-fonds measures, this second incidental supplementary budget does not invoke paragraph 2 of article 2.27 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016. Formal authorisation by the States General will be awaited.

Voor de maatregelen voor het BES-fonds wordt in deze tweede incidentele suppletoire begroting geen beroep gedaan op lid 2 van artikel 2.27 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016. Hierbij zal gewacht worden op formele autorisatie van de Staten-Generaal.

35829.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the 2020 special agreement among France, Belgium, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom on security controls for trains through the Channel Tunnel, enabling a direct Eurostar train connection from the Netherlands to London. The memorandum explains that the agreement provides for security screening at Dutch stations, supervised by the ILT and monitored by the Intergovernmental Commission for the Channel Tunnel.
35829.j: The memorandum justifies the treaty approval by the need to realise a direct train connection to London and explains the bilateral and multilateral oversight arrangements.
q: The Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport (ILT) is designated at national level to supervise these security measures.
De Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) is op het nationale vlak aangewezen om toezicht te houden op deze beveiligingsmaatregelen.

parties: Asks on what grounds the IGC may ban trains from the tunnel and whether differing national data-exchange rules could weaken security.
These members wonder on what grounds the IGC can prohibit trains from accessing the tunnel.
Deze leden vragen zich af op basis van welke gronden de IGC treinen de toegang tot de tunnel kan verbieden.
Supports the direct link but asks why basic security principles are in a non-binding declaration rather than the law and how the ILT supervises NS measures.
The D66 members wonder why the basic principles of the security measures for trains through the Channel Tunnel are laid down in a declaration of intent rather than in the law.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen zich af waarom de basisprincipes van de beveiligingsmaatregelen voor treinen die door de Kanaaltunnel rijden zijn gelegen in een intentieverklaring in plaats van in de wet.
Asks for experience since provisional application and whether the IGC or Joint Security Committee has given feedback on Dutch compliance.

Finally, these members ask whether the Intergovernmental Commission for the Channel Tunnel (IGC) and/or the Joint Security Committee (JSC) have already given feedback on Dutch compliance with the Special Agreement.

Tot slot vragen deze leden of de Intergouvernementele Commissie voor de Kanaaltunnel (IGC) en/of het Joint Security Committee (JSC) al feedback hebben gegeven op de Nederlandse naleving van de Bijzondere Overeenkomst.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised on a bill approving the Bilateral Agreement between France, Belgium, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom on security issues concerning trains through the Channel tunnel, raising no remarks. The government's reply (nader rapport) is limited to noting that the bill gave no occasion for substantive remarks and forwarding it to parliament.

35830-III.s: This is a Slotwet (final budget adjustment act) for fiscal year 2020 that amends the departmental budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, the Commission for Oversight of Intelligence and Security Services, and the agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie. It records the final realised expenditure and revenue figures against the budgeted amounts, with the act taking effect the day after publication and applying retroactively to 31 December 2020.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35838.s: The bill implements the EU Cybersecurity Act's certification framework in the Netherlands by designating the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate as national cybersecurity certification authority. It requires conformity assessment bodies to notify and obtain ministerial approval for high-assurance certificates, and grants the Minister enforcement powers including binding instructions, certificate revocation, administrative fines up to EUR 900,000 and orders under administrative coercion.
35838.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for proper execution of the EU regulation and presents the open-government exclusion as protecting public security and confidentiality of sensitive cybersecurity information.
q: The Public Access to Government Act does not apply to data on high-assurance cybersecurity certificates obtained by the national certification authority.
De Wet openbaarheid van bestuur is niet van toepassing op gegevens inzake cyberbeveiligingscertificaten voor zekerheidsniveau hoog
d: rules on notification of high-assurance conformity assessment
cases where research plan needs no approval
further rules on approval of research plans
further rules on approval of research reports and certificates
rules implementing the cybersecurity regulation and EU implementing acts
designation of provisions of the regulation whose breach is prohibited
designation of supervisory officials by ministerial decision
rules on fees charged to beneficiaries of ministerial services
p: Excludes high-assurance certification data held by the authority from the Public Access to Government Act, limiting citizens' access to information about the executive's oversight.
Gives the Minister power to issue binding instructions requiring corrective measures within a reasonable period.
Allows the Minister to revoke approval of high-assurance certificates that do not comply with the regulation or certification scheme.
Authorises the Minister to impose orders under administrative coercion to enforce the act and the regulation.
Authorises administrative fines of up to EUR 900,000 per infringement imposed directly by the Minister.
Allows costs of supervising compliance to be charged to regulated parties, an option the memorandum leaves open for later use.

parties: Asks whether self-assessment by manufacturers without independent review is adequate, and how sanctions and certificate withdrawal are used.
How does the government assess this possibility in the context of independent review and thereby also the effectiveness of this bill?
Hoe beoordeelt de regering deze mogelijkheid in het kader van onafhankelijke toetsing en daarmee ook de doelmatigheid van dit wetsvoorstel?
Asks about the five-yearly ENISA evaluation and how updates will be handled, and why update rules are not in the bill itself.
The D66 members would like further explanation of why it was not chosen to lay down the handling of updates or hacks in the bill.
De leden van de D66-fractie horen graag een nadere toelichting waarom er niet voor gekozen wordt om de omgang met updates of hacks vast te leggen in het wetsvoorstel
Asks whether the Agency has enough capacity, whether the AIVD advice is non-binding and creates security risks, and about delays in the approval procedure.
Can the government further justify the choice of the AT as implementing body?
Kan de regering de keuze voor het AT als uitvoerder nog eens beargumenteren?
Questions why sovereignty is transferred to the Commission and what the regulation will actually achieve for cybersecurity.
They ask where the need for this transfer of sovereignty comes from.
Zij vragen waar de behoefte voor deze soevereiniteitsoverdracht vandaan komt.
Argues voluntary certification leaves unsafe products on the market and asks why mandatory certification under Article 56 was not used.
Why was a more mandatory character of cybersecurity certification not chosen in the regulation?
Waarom is er in de verordening niet gekozen voor een meer verplichtend karakter van cyberbeveiligingscertificering?
Asks who is responsible for oversight of cybersecurity when uncertified products are used, since the national authority cannot intervene.
These members ask who bears responsibility for correct cybersecurity certification of ICT products, services or processes.
Deze leden vragen bij wie de verantwoordelijkheid ligt van correcte cyberbeveiligingscertificering van ICT-producten, -diensten of -processen

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Dutch implementation bill for EU Cybersecurity Regulation 2019/881, raising concerns about the ambition for certification given delayed EU mandatory schemes, unclear rules on updates and hacks affecting certificates, and the withdrawal of certificate approval. The minister's reply largely accepts the points, clarifies the memorandum, adds a passage on how withdrawal relates to issued certificates, and amends article 11.
concerns: Unclear effect of updates and hacks on certificate validity and scope threatens the regulation's workability, so the government should seek clarity quickly at EU level.
The government's ambition to develop certification schemes promptly sits uneasily with EU mandatory certification only being considered by 2023, requiring explanation of interim risk management.
Consequences of withdrawing a certificate approval for end users and the relation to already issued certificates needed clarification in the explanatory memorandum.
Redactional remarks on transposition table and explanatory notes were all adopted in the memorandum.

35865.s: The bill amends the Telecommunications Act to implement the EU Electronic Communications Code (Directive 2018/1972) and the BEREC Regulation, updating definitions, spectrum licensing, number portability, co-location and shared use, access and interconnection obligations, and assigning several tasks previously held by the minister to the ACM as national regulator. It also introduces new access rules for civil infrastructure, mobile local access and shared-use of public infrastructure for small cells.
35865.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and expanded regulator powers as necessary to implement the EU Code and BEREC Regulation and to secure investment, competition and consistent regulation across the EU.
q: Article 5 of the Access Directive contains a list of specific situations in which regulation may be applied.
Artikel 5 van de Toegangsrichtlijn bevat immers tevens een opsomming van specifieke situaties waarin tot regulering kan worden overgegaan.
d: rules on duration of spectrum licences for wireless broadband
exemptions from prior consent for spectrum leasing and related rules
costs of shared use of facilities and coordination of civil works, after hearing ACM
technical characteristics of small-cell access points and fees for public infrastructure access
further rules on application of access and interconnection obligations
rules on number portability conditions and compensation of subscribers
protection of public health against electromagnetic fields from radio spectrum use
p: Gives the national regulator broader discretion to impose access, interconnection and interoperability obligations, including a catch-all power, subject to objectivity and proportionality requirements.

Allows any local or national authority to impose co-location or shared-use obligations in specific areas for environmental, health, safety or spatial planning reasons, with the general administrative procedure applying.
Allows spectrum licences to be leased with ministerial consent, with the lessor made liable for compliance and consent exempted in cases set by decree.

parties: Asks how the obligation for municipalities to make public infrastructure available fits with their competence over public space and who is responsible for maintenance.
The VVD members ask how the government assesses this obligation for public authorities, looking for example at municipal competence and responsibility for organising public space.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe de regering deze verplichting voor overheidsinstanties beoordeelt, kijkend naar bijvoorbeeld de gemeentelijke bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid voor het inrichten van de openbare ruimte.
Has no further questions or comments on the bill.
These members currently have no further questions or comments on this.
Deze leden hebben hier op dit moment geen verdere vragen of opmerkingen over.
Asks whether municipalities have sufficient money and knowledge for their new tasks and how it is ensured local governments are not burdened with tasks they are not equipped for.
How is it ensured that local governments are not confronted with tasks for which they are not really equipped?
Hoe is geborgd dat lokale overheden niet met taken geconfronteerd worden, waarvoor zij eigenlijk niet zijn toegerust?
Asks what the impact on consumers and on municipal decisions to force shared use or colocation will be, and what lessons were learned from the Segbroek case.
What lessons have been learned from the Segbroek case?
Welke lessen zijn geleerd van de casus Segbroek?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft bill implementing the EU Telecom Code, raising concerns about overlap between chapters 5, 5a-5c, 6 and 6a of the Telecommunications Act, the competence to impose colocation, the legal nature of a cost-sharing scheme, unclear authority designation, supervision of number-independent services, and several drafting and implementation points. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted some points, partly followed others, and explained why it did not adopt some recommendations, such as a rank order of authorities and a transposition table.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for clarity on overlap and possible concurrence between the chapters of the Telecommunications Act and on the criterion for choosing the least intrusive instrument; the government expanded explanation in the memorandum but argued the overlap concern was adequately addressed.

The Afdeling asked for clarification of the legal nature (general binding rule or concretising general decision) of the cost-sharing scheme and its relation to other cost-compensation rules; the provision was amended and the memorandum explains the character of the scheme.

The Afdeling found the designation of the competent administrative authority for imposing colocation or shared use too open-ended and asked for clearer criteria; the government clarified the provision but rejected the advice to add a rank order among authorities.

The Afdeling noted that supervision of number-independent interpersonal communication services is hampered because providers cannot be required to register, and asked how the government will address this implementation problem; the government agreed to raise it at EU level.

The Afdeling asked for explanation of how regulation 2018/1971 (BEREC) is implemented and of the ACM's cooperation with BEREC; a short passage was added, but the government said most provisions need no further national implementation.
The Afdeling asked for clarification of what counts as a licence granted free of charge, which cannot be leased; the memorandum now defines this and the bill delegates detail to an AMvB.
The Afdeling asked the memorandum to address the consequences of the missed transposition deadline of 21 December 2020; a passage was added explaining the delay and its limited effects.

The Afdeling made several drafting remarks on definitions and wording; some were adopted (definitions of equipment and bundle, Article 5b.1), while others such as the network operator definition and a transposition table were not adopted.

35874.s: The bill amends the Temporary COVID-19 Measures Act so that any royal decree extending its measures must be approved by a statute submitted to the House of Representatives after publication, replacing the previous light pre-tabling procedure. It also drops the requirement that the Council of State be heard on the approval bill and makes a related change to the Public Health Act regarding Council of State advice every three months.
35874.j: The memorandum justifies the approval-by-statute procedure as giving Parliament binding say over extensions and the omission of Council of State advice as avoiding duplication with advice already given before the extension decree.
q: For this reason, Article VIII(4) of the Twm provides a pre-tabling procedure for both the House of Representatives and the Senate on the extension decree.
Om deze reden is in artikel VIII, vierde lid, van de Twm voorzien in een voorhangprocedure voor zowel de Tweede als de Eerste Kamer over het verlengingsbesluit.
d: extension of temporary COVID-19 measures by royal decree
p: Article I (VIII(4)-(5) Tijdelijke wet maatregelen covid-19)

Replaces the light pre-tabling procedure with a post-publication approval requirement, giving both Houses binding power to end extensions, though the Council of State hearing on the approval bill may be omitted.
Replaces the three-monthly Council of State advice requirement with a link to the temporary Act, reducing the frequency of independent advisory review of measures.

parties: Asks what parliament can still influence under the new approval procedure and whether it can keep parts of the law after rejection.
Can the government explain what options the House and Senate currently have regarding parliamentary control, and which they will no longer have?
Kan de regering uitleggen welke mogelijkheden de Tweede en Eerste Kamer op dit moment hebben als het gaat om parlementaire zeggenschap?

Sees parliamentary control over the COVID measures as essential, but warns against making the process too complex and asks whether the new procedure removes the ability to select individual provisions.
These members consider parliamentary control over the Temporary COVID-19 Measures Act essential because these measures may affect fundamental rights.
Deze leden vinden parlementaire controle bij de Tijdelijke wet maatregelen covid-19 essentieel omdat deze maatregelen grondrechten kunnen raken.
Welcomes that the Senate must now approve extensions but regrets that this is added only afterwards in the law.
These members find it positive that this is now the case, but regret that it is only being added to the law afterwards.
Deze leden vinden het positief dat dit nu wel het geval is, maar betreuren dat het pas achteraf in de wet wordt opgenomen.
Worries that dropping the advance procedure weakens parliament's ability to shape the content of an extension and asks how parliamentary involvement will be guaranteed beforehand.
Values orderly legislative procedures with distinct responsibilities of the two chambers and asks what the bill means for each chamber.
They ask the government to set out precisely what consequences this bill has for both distinct chambers.
Zij vragen de regering om nauwkeurig te schetsen welke gevolgen dit wetsvoorstel heeft voor beide onderscheiden Kamers.

Stresses constitutional justification and proportionality of rights restrictions and welcomes stronger parliamentary involvement, but asks whether parliament can amend provisions and how quickly the approval bill must be submitted.
With the proposed amendment to the Twm, this involvement is further strengthened.
Met de nu voorgestelde wijziging van de Twm wordt deze betrokkenheid verder versterkt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill adding a post-enactment approval procedure (nahang) for the COVID-19 extension decree, alongside the existing pre-enactment procedure, is poorly justified and should be revised, and that omitting its own advisory role is unjustified. The government's reply accepts the Afdeling's points: it drops the pre-enactment procedure in favour of the approval bill, makes the omission of advice facultative rather than mandatory, and amends the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: Combining a pre-enactment (voorhang) and post-enactment (nahang) parliamentary procedure for the extension decree is problematic and insufficiently justified, creating risks of deadlock; the government dropped the voorhang procedure in favour of the nahang approval bill.

Omitting the Afdeling's advice on the approval bill is inconsistent with the restrictive reading of Article 73(1) of the Constitution; the government made the omission facultative and amended the explanatory memorandum.
